[[Category:Characters]][[Category:Base Only Characters]] {{DISPLAYTITLE:'''Aspiring Mangaka'''}} {{Character2 |title1={{Aspiring Mangaka}} |cost=Free |awakening='''Foresight''' |special='''Clairvoyance''' |hp=85 |image1=Mangaka.png |previous={{Star Rage}} |next={{Lucky Coward}} }} {{Quote|"Spare me any speeches about life. I've learned everything important from manga."|Charles Bernard ({{Aspiring Mangaka}}) to Kinji Hakari ({{Restless Gambler}})}} ==Description== Aspiring Mangaka is the 14th [[Characters|character]] and 3rd [[Characters#Base Only|base-only]] that was added to ''Jujutsu Shenanigans.'' ===Origin=== {{Origin |Aspiring Mangaka is based off of {{Jjk|Charles Bernard}}, a character from ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. |{{Jjk|Charles Bernard}} was a beginner mangaka forced into the Culling Game, using his G Warstaff that allows him to see into the future of his enemies by drawing their blood into the cursed tool's tip. Despite his frustration that sorcery has ruined his passion and future, he retains his ambition of becoming a manga artist regardless of entering the jujutsu world, hence the title: "Aspiring Mangaka". }} ==Moveset== |-|Base= {{Ability |Type=COSMETIC |Type Color=mediumpurple |Name='''G-Warstaff''' |Blockable=y |Interruptible=y |Cannot Bypass Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Description=The user holds a G-Warstaff. Both its trail and tip start out as white, though they will gradually become more red with the enemy's blood as the user's Awakening Bar fills. When holding an item or emoting, the G Warstaff will be glued to the player's back. |Stat 1=EFFECT |Stat 1 Value=Grants a cursed tool cosmetic with varying trail colors depending on the user's Awakening meter |Image=AspiringMangakaMeleeDemonstrationReupload.gif}} {{Ability |Type=PASSIVE |Type Color=purple |Name='''Oracle''' |Description=When blocking an enemy’s attack within 0.05 seconds of impact, the user will evade the strike while leaving an afterimage behind, regardless of which side the attack landed on. This passive only activates on blockable attacks by rendering them blockable from all sides, but it can be enhanced in some ways: *The default perfect-block window increases as Awakening accumulates, up to 0.15s when the Awakening bar is at the maximum. *If the attacker was marked by Clairvoyance, then the perfect-block window will increase by 0.1s, capping at 0.25s with a full Awakening Bar. *Moreover, parrying an attack from a marked enemy will reward the user with 5% extra Awakening. |Stat 1=EFFECT |Stat 1 Value=Grants a 360° perfect block, with a window ranging from 0.05 to 0.25 |Image=Oracle.gif}} {{Ability |Type=SPECIAL |Type Color=orange |Name='''Clairvoyance''' |Unblockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Description=While hovering their cursor over an opponent within 35 studs, the user can mark their torso with a glowing manga panel for 25 seconds in order to peer into their future, resulting in several disadvantages that the target will suffer from: *The user can force side/back dash every 4 seconds. This excludes ragdoll cancel but locks the target's camera then puts their side dash on cooldown. *The parry window increases by 0.1s for all of the target's incoming blockable attacks, and rewards the user with 5% Awakening for each perfect block. *Despair's speed will remain the same on block. *Sacrilege's ragdoll duration will become longer by half a second if ragdolled. *Foresight will play its cutscene variant when landed. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=None, lasts for 25s |Stat 2=AWAKENING COST |Stat 2 Value=5% (unrequired) |Stat 3=COOLDOWN |Stat 3 Value=25s |Image=Clairvoyance.gif}} {{Ability |Type=SPECIAL VARIANT |Type Color=orange |Name='''Clairvoyance:''' '''Prediction''' |Unblockable=y |Interruptible=y |Cannot Bypass Ragdoll=y |Description=While facing a marked enemy, the user can force them to side dash or back dash every 4 seconds by pressing their special. A forced dash can only be triggered while the opponent isn't ragdolled or using a skill, but whenever it is activated, the user may be able to get the upper hand on the target, seeing as: *The dash will lock the target's camera in place and force them to go as close as they could to the user's position without going forwards, before putting their side dash on cooldown. **The dash's direction will be previewed to the user by a white outline, while the target will only see themselves flash whenever a dash is forced. *Both players will be stunned for a very brief moment. However, the user's own stun ends 0.1 seconds earlier than the marked target's. |Stat 1=COOLDOWN |Stat 1 Value=4s |Image=ClairvoyancePrediction.gif}} {{Ability |Name='''Despair''' |Semi Blockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Description=The user sends rapid thrusts of their cursed tool forwards before winding back an unblockable slash to send the enemy flying back. The move will slow down if it misses or gets blocked by an unmarked target. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=16.1, 15 for thrusts, 1.1 for last hit |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=16s |Image=Despair.gif}} {{Ability |Name='''Shut Up!''' |Blockable=y |Interruptible=y |Cannot Bypass Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Description=The user turns their G Warstaff backwards to pierce the torso of whoever is behind them. If successful, they will stare down the target while gaining i-frames before spinning them to the front and kicking them away with long stun while the user's front dash goes off cooldown. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=7, 3 for stab, 4 for kick |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=16s |Image=ShutUp!.gif}} {{Ability |Type=MELEE COUNTER VARIANT |Type Color=blue |Name='''Shut Up!''' |Blockable=y |Interruptible=y |Cannot Bypass Ragdoll=y |No Evasive=y |Melee=y |Description=If the user is hit by a melee attack during the windup, then the move will function in a counteresque manner by speeding up the thrust and losing its endlag on miss. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=7, 3 for stab, 4 for kick |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=16s |Image=ShutUp!HIT.gif}} {{Ability |Type=AIR VARIANT |Type Color=red |Name='''Shut Up!''' |Unblockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Description=Using the move while airborne will cause the user to hop upwards while winding up a heavy slam with their G Warstaff, crushing targets beneath them. The move will automatically end if the user does not reach the ground in time. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=12 |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=16s |Image=ShutUp!Variant.gif}} {{Ability |Type=INTERRUPTION AIR VARIANT |Type Color=red |Name='''Shut Up!''' |Unblockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |No Evasive=y |Melee=y |Description=If the slam interrupts an enemy’s attack, the target will get slammed face-first into the floor. Despite appearing to be ragdolled, this state is only visual and any attack will still land. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=12 |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=16s |Image=ShutUp!VariantHit.gif}} {{Ability |Name='''Eye Catching''' |Type=BULLET COUNTER |Type Color=blue |No Evasive=y |Description=The user crosses their arms momentarily, going into their block stance. If hit by a melee or bullet attack, the user will spin around to dodge the attack and knock down the assaulter all while keeping the move off cooldown. Any blockable explosion/swarm attacks will be kept at bay without triggering the counter. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=9 |Stat 2=COUNTER WINDOW |Stat 2 Value=0.75s |Stat 3=COOLDOWN |Stat 3 Value=14s, none if landed |Image=EyeCatching.gif}} {{Ability |Name='''Sacrilege''' |Unblockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |No Evasive=y |Melee=y |Description=The user twirls their spear before thrusting it and dashing 20 studs forwards. If the dash connects, they express their anger with the target as 2 text boxes appear: "Stop desecrating this work!" and "Did you even read the original properly?!" while pulling their tool out of the target, punching them, spinning them, and kicking the target away.
This move's ragdoll duration will be extended by 0.5s on ragdolled opponents marked by the special, while missing the dash will result in 0.85s of endlag. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=12, 6 for thrust, 6 for kick |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=16s |Image=Sacrilege.gif}} {{Background|Charlespentip.png}} |-|Awakening Move= {{Ability |Name='''Foresight''' |Type=AWAKENING MELEE COUNTER |Type Color=navy |No Evasive=y |Description=Upon activation, the user will hold their spear vertically in a defensive position. If hit by a melee attack, they will block it and knock the target upwards and away with a smack of their tool's handle. Unlike other counters, the counterattack is unable to hit other targets. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=40 |Stat 2=COUNTER WINDOW |Stat 2 Value=1s |Stat 3=AWAKENING REFUND |Stat 3 Value=40% on hit/miss,
80% if interrupted |Image=Foresight.gif}} {{Ability |Name='''Foresight''' |Type=AWAKENING MELEE COUNTER |Type Color=navy |No Evasive=y |Description=If the attacker is marked by Clairvoyance or has less than 40 HP, a cutscene will initiate consisting of the user reacting by pushing their staff against the target then seeing a glimpse into the future, letting out a chuckle as they block all of the target's incoming punches and pierce through them with their spear. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=115 for pierce |Stat 2=HEALING |Stat 2 Value=21.25 HP if landed |Stat 3=COUNTER WINDOW |Stat 3 Value=1s |Stat 4=AWAKENING REFUND |Stat 4 Value=40% on miss,
80% if interrupted |Image=ForesightVariant.gif}} {{Background|FORESIGHT.png}} |-|Finishers= {{Ability |Name='''Despair''' |Semi Blockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Description=The user thrusts their spear into the opponent repeatedly before slamming them into the ground. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=3 for slam |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=16s |Image=DespairFinisher.gif}} {{Ability |Type=AWAKENING MELEE COUNTER |Type Color=navy |Name='''Foresight''' |No Evasive=y |Description=If the attacker has 40 HP or less, Foresight's signature cutscene will initiate regardless of whether the opponent is marked with Clairvoyance or not, causing the opponent's demise while rewarding the user with 20% HP and using up their entire Awakening bar as usual. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=115 |Stat 2=HEALING |Stat 2 Value=21.25 HP if landed |Stat 3=COUNTER WINDOW |Stat 3 Value=1s |Stat 4=AWAKENING REFUND |Stat 4 Value=40% on miss,
80% if interrupted |Image=ForesightVariant.gif}} ==Pros & Cons== {{ProsCons |pros= *Great defensive capability with 3 counters: Shut Up!, Eye Catching, and Foresight, as well as perfect blocking. *Both the special and the perfect block passive work in tandem pretty well, as both deny the enemy's side dash M1s. *Despair allows you to back out or walk around the opponent if it ends up being blocked. *Shut Up! can shut down aggressive opponents by threatening and punishing them with unescapable combos using either variant. *Sacrilege is a decent tool to punish passive play or to surprise opponents in range due to its short windup and block bypass. |cons= *Base-only moveset with 85 Max HP and reliance on long combos to deal significant damage. *Punishable endlag on all moves, except for Shut Up! variants. *The G-Warstaff effects gradually turns red as your Awakening fills. This visual makes it obvious when you have Foresight ready, causing wary opponents to play more carefully to render your melee counter more difficult to land. *A decent amount of endlag if dash is missed. }} ==Combos== {{Combo |sequence1=---- |damage1='''''This character Combos are currently being reworked.
Please don't add any combos whatsoever.''''' |notes1=---- }} ==Tips & Techs== ===Tips=== *While the perfect block passive initially seems like just a 360 degree block, it acts as a direct counter to moves with chip damage on block like Reversal Red. *The best way to use Clairvoyance is to position yourself in a way that the opponent will be dashing to your attacks during their own move to surprise them into a combo. Using it during an M1 trade is also helpful in tearing down the opponent's ability to dash around block. *Shut Up! can be successfully timed with an uppercut, and if you are near a wall, pushing an enemy to it will reduce the knockback and allow you to extend without needing to dash. *When countering a projectile with Eye Catching, the user's travel speed toward the target scales with distance (moving faster the farther away they are), though this path can be obstructed by terrain; this does not stop the attack, but will prevent the user from reaching the attacker's position. *Sacrilege's hitbox can miss ragdolled or uppercutted targets at times despite being able to bypass ragdoll. A good way to ensure it lands is by using after 4 M1s, Despair, or one of your counters. **Additionally, looking in a specific direction during the counter allows the user to push the target in that direction. This can be useful to guide opponents closer to extend into moves other than Sacrilege. *Eye Catching behaves differently depending on the type of attack that was countered: **On Melee and Bullet attacks, its hit will land and the move's cooldown will reset. **Explosive and Swarm attacks cannot be countered, but if they are blockable (Toad, Piercing Blood..), the counter will function as a regular block, shutting them down. The move still acts as if it was whiffed by punishing you with endlag. *Aspiring Mangaka's block animation is the same as his Eye Catching animation. **A good Aspiring Mangaka may block instead of countering in order to make you think they have wasted their counter. **However, there are ways to tell the difference between the block and the counter. After Eye Catching is missed, the user will go into a basic position with no animation whatsoever. However, due to having a different idle animation, if they feint it with a block, their hand will go back instead of not going back like with Eye Catching. ===Techs=== |-|Beginner= ===='''Roundabout'''==== If Despair is blocked by an opponent, you can circle around them to try to throw them off and catch them in the barrage, and deny the counter/punish window that opens before the last hit. ===='''Sacrilegious'''==== You can use Clairvoyance on a marked enemy and use Sacrilege while they are being affected by the Special, aiming where they'll dash to and making for a rather consistent way to approach the enemy. However, this can be taken advantage of by the opponent as they can counter Sacrilege if they have one ready to use. ===='''Sacrilege Catching'''==== After landing Eye Catching, you can confirm the stun it inflicts into Sacrilege without the risk of being countered or punished. |-|Intermediate= ===='''180 Upper-Shut'''==== You can connect and extend your combo using Shut Up! after your light attack uppercut by turning 180 degrees, then using Shut Up! to catch the enemy right before they hit the ground. ===='''Fakeout'''==== By standing still while blocking for a short time, you can trick the opponent into trying to punish you before really using Eye Catching, almost always guaranteeing your counter being landed. Note that Eye Catching lasts about a second, and that this isn't very viable if the opponent starts to adapt to your tricks or if your cooldowns are visible. ===={{WdsTooltips |toggle = {{{basic-tooltip|'''Follow-up Despair'''}}} |content = [[File:Follow-Up_despair_gif.gif|frameless|160x90px]]}}==== When catching enemy with Sacrilege while the enemy is ragdolled and marked with Clairvoyance, they will have longer ragdoll time than usual. This can be taken advantage to confirm Despair by sidedashing and using the ability, and it can be done near a wall to be more consistent. Doing this while the opponent isn't marked leaves a small opening where they can block. ===='''Punch Catching'''==== While your opponent is blocking, you can m1 once or twice on their block to bait a reaction, and immediately use Eye Catching. This also works with Shut up! if you turn 180° very fast. Against higher level players, you could expect a side-dash m1 after they blocked, in which case you can use the very risky normal Shut Up! in hope to catch them. This tech is NOT foolproof, and is to be used as a mixup with side-dash m1s and other close-range options. |-|Advanced= ===='''Desperate Downslam'''==== After Despair, there is a window that allows for an M1 string (while running toward the enemy to close more distance) before sidedashing and performing a downslam. This is usually untrue and inconsistent to pull off depending on your ping or how quick you are. ==Trivia== *{{Aspiring Mangaka}} is the only character to have text boxes in a base move and 3 counters in the same moveset. **He's also the first character to have an awakening variant (preceding {{Honored One}}, {{True Cannon}}, and {{Black Death}}). **Additionally, he's the third character to have 85 Max HP (4th character if pre-buff {{Locust Guy}} counts). *During Foresight's cutscene, the user will switch to their equipped [[Awakening Outfit]] until the cutscene concludes. **This sets {{Aspiring Mangaka}} as one of the three base-only characters to be able to benefit from the [[Awakening Outfit]] gamepass, the others being {{Crow Charmer}} and {{Black Death}}. **Interestingly, if the opponent leaves the game mid-execution, then the {{Aspiring Mangaka}} user will forever stay in their [[Awakening Outfit]] until they successfully counter someone using Foresight's cutscene again or reset/change character. *{{Aspiring Mangaka}}'s 2026 April Fools name (tatsuki fujimoto) is based [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tatsuki_Fujimoto Tatsuki Fujimoto], a mangaka responsible for multiple hit shonen manga, with his most notable being [https://chainsaw-man.fandom.com/wiki/Chainsaw_Man_Wiki Chainsaw Man]. **The name was possibly chosen due to Chainsaw Man's ending being negatively received, similar to how barely anyone wanted to read {{Aspiring Mangaka}}'s manga. *The art of Unlicensed Rhythm Game's "Pass On" shows {{Aspiring Mangaka}} taking the place of Ryōshū from Limbus Company. *The name of {{Aspiring Mangaka}}’s move, “Eye Catching” could be a reference to anime eye catchers. ==Gallery== File:CharlesBernard.jpeg|Charles Bernard, the inspiration for Aspiring Mangaka. (pronounced: Shine!, and means "Die!"), causing the target to explode in a blood splatter. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=Insta-kill |Image=SwordCursedSpeechFinisher.gif}} ==Pros & Cons== {{ProsCons |pros= *Gains a secondary moveset in base and awakening that strengthens combos and allows for different playstyles and more complex setups. *Able to easily bypass ragdoll and start combos off of it. *Has a one shot move in awakening, a domain expansion, and the potential for 7 additional moves on top of Rika's moveset. *Outburst has several uses, ranging from defensive (evading punishes, parrying..) to offensive (dealing high damage, extending combos, baiting ragdoll cancel..). |cons= *Lower Max HP and lengthy cooldowns. *Second Wind's endlag remains punishable on the second use, and its hitbox can sometimes miss players despite clearly colliding with them. *Authentic Mutual Love lacks a lethal sure-hit effect, and won't be much of an advantage if you aren't constantly picking up katanas, which remain counterable. }} ==Combos== |-|Base= {{Combo |sequence1=---- |damage1='''''This character Combos are currently being reworked.

Please don't add any combos whatsoever.''''' |notes1=---- }} ==Tips & Techs== ===Tips=== *Remember that Outburst can deflect both melee and ranged hits, with basically no downsides except not being able to hit your opponent right after. *It's very easy to gain moves to copy without even fighting as simply using Rika moves on corpses will save the target's technique. *Elbow Rush used to be unable to hit airborne ragdolled opponents, but this has been changed after {{V|1.76}}, as it can be chained after uppercuts and even Energy Ripple. *Adaptation will not be able to work in Honored One's Infinite Void when used through Copy. ===Techs=== |-|Beginner= ===={{WdsTooltips |toggle = {{{basic-tooltip|'''True Love Ladder'''}}} |content = [[File:TRUE LOVE LADDER.gif|frameless|240x240]]}}==== Successfully landing Jacob's Ladder during the awakening domain guarantees a confirmed hit for the True Love Beam, as the stun prevents opponent evasion. This synergy ensures a guaranteed high-damage combo. ===='''Quickfeint'''==== By M1ing and feinting it with rika launch the user will use rika launch like normal but it will do its shorter cooldown from feinting. |-|Intermediate= ===='''Elbow Slam'''==== Swapping to your Rika moveset during Elbow Rush lets you instantly use Rika Downslam or Rika Slam after knocking a target away, keeping them ragdolled next to you for a combo with your other skills. ===='''Rika Dash'''==== Using Rika Launch during the endlag of a frontdash and M1ing lets you effectively extend your front dash and surprise enemies. You can also use second wind instead of an M1 for extra distance or as a general mixup. |-|Advanced= ===='''Doubleslam Surf'''==== Make sure you are positioned on top of a ragdolled target. Using one M1 into Rika Smash into using the rest of your M1s while midair allows you to surf on the target and downslam them midair. ==Trivia== *{{Cursed Partners}} is the third character to be based on more than one ''Jujutsu Kaisen'' character, the others being {{Vessel}}, {{Switcher}} and {{Crow Charmer}}. **Though in this case, Rika is portrayed as the character's special and secondary moveset rather than an Awakening. *Anytime she is summoned, Rika will say "Yuta" in a faint voice. **When using an emote, Rika will perform the [[Emotes|"Eggrolled"]] emote, indirectly prohibiting her from being able to move and attack. If the emote used was [[Emotes#Traversal|"Dead Wrong"]], then she will do the same dance. ***To prevent this, you can instead summon Rika after using an emote, allowing her to move and attack. *After landing a copied Adaptation (from {{Mahoraga}}), the player will gain a smaller sized Adaptation Wheel over their head. *When Resolute Black Flash's finisher is triggered, a snippet from ''Jujutsu Kaisen Zero's'' '''The Real You''' will play, which was composed by both Hiroaki Tsutsumi and Toft Willingham. *Jacob's Ladder is the first move to drain the target's Awakening meter (WIth the second being [[Head of the Hei|Head of the Hei's]] Bleedout move when used on [[Blood Manipulator]]). Moreover, it can bypass all i-frames, including the ones provided by Free Build or Unlicensed Rhythm Game. **The "True Love" Awakening originates from a ''Jujutsu Kaisen 0'' scene, where Yuta vowed his life to Rika in exchange for her to unleash the full extent of her power, the True Love Beam, while calling it an act of true love. **The name "True Love" also stands for the [[Gamemodes#Casual Duels|Casual Duels binding vow]]. *Authentic Mutual Love's voiceline used to have the same voiceline as {{Perfection}}'s Self Embodiment Of Perfection's, which was a snippet of ''Mahito's 0.2 Embodiment Of Self-Perfection'' taken straight from the ''Jujutsu Kaisen anime''. **In {{V|1.63}}, the voiceline was changed to another snippet of Mahito casting his domain. **The domain's music is called '''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u_cAOn7NXRI A Three-Cornered Fight]''' by '''Yoshimasa Terui'''. ***Before {{V|1.76}}, the domain would play '''We Are Stop The Attack''' by '''Yoshimasa Terui'''. It was likely changed as {{Salaryman}}'s awakening used the same theme. *{{Cursed Partners}}' [[Events#April Fools 2026 Event|2026 April Fools]] Name (my jjk oc) is based off of an image, describing Yuta Okkotsu as if they were an original character. Next to the description, an edited image of Yuji Itadori can be seen, with a sheath being drawn in the back. ==Gallery== File:Rika + Yuta anime.jpg|Yuta Okkotsu and Rika, the inspiration for Cursed Partners. Events.text:
{{DISPLAYTITLE:Events}} [[File:Peakevent.png|center|frameless|700px]] Many seasonal events have been hosted in ''Jujutsu Shenanigans'', each designed to celebrate key holidays throughout the year while offering players exclusive experiences and limited rewards. So far, the game has featured a total of 8 events (along with an upcoming one), with most of them altering the [[Map|main map]] in some way:
  • Christmas 2024
  • New Years 2025
  • April Fools 2025
  • Halloween 2025
  • Christmas 2025
  • New Years 2026
  • JJS x JSD Collab
  • April Fools 2026
  • Halloween 2026
[[File:RAGAChristmas.jpg|frameless|right]] *On November 10, this event introduced a winter atmosphere where all greenery, from trees to grass, was blanketed in white. A "Jolly" fun setting was also added to make the map look snowier. *The most notable and lasting change was '''{{Mahoraga}}'s summoning music being changed to fit the Christmas style. He would also appear to have a PNG image of a beard and Santa's hat on him. *This event lasted from {{V|1.40}} to {{V|1.41}}.
*On {{V|1.44}}, a timer was added above the park in the center of the map. It started counting down to 0:00 January 1st 2025 (GMT Time). Once this happened, fireworks were launched in the sky, and all players who were logged in received the [[Emotes#Limited|"3024"]] emote. *Tze has then announced that this event will be rerun again, which happened a few days later. *The timer counted down from 4 days to 0, all in the same update.
[[File:TopView.png|right|300px]] *To celebrate April Fools, the game has had its one of a kind "Everything Update", going back to its roots by reverting the usual Shinjuku-inspired map to [[Map#Center|an older map]] that was instead inspired by Apocalypse Rising 1. *The only other feature coming with this event was a [[Codes#Inactive Codes|code]] pointing out the game's anniversary, as April 2024 dated back to the game's full release. *This event started at {{V|1.53}}, and ended on {{V|1.54}}.
[[File:SpookyGraveyard.png|frameless|right]] [[File:Island.gif|frameless|right]] *On October 26th of 2025, the map was changed to accomodate the Halloween theme, with regular buildings getting a darker tint, and several carved pumpkins and pots scattered around the map. *The graveyard had the most notable change, as its middle headstone was replaced by a path way surrounded by a rib cage, leading into a portal. This portal would teleport players to a distant floating island with several halloween decorations and a shop. [[File:DoorOpen.gif|frameless|right]] *On top of this, wooden indestructible doors marked with carved pumpkins would appear around the map, blocking doorways. 6 of these doors would constantly spawn in every server with a 100 second timer. Once the timer on a door has finished, a prompt would appear on it, which needed to be held for 5 seconds. Doing so would open it and reward the player with "candy". *Candy was added as the new Halloween currency, shown in the bottom corner of your screen and obtainable in 8 different ways: [[File:Candies.png|frameless|right]] **Killing players, with each kill granting 1 candy. **Finishing [[Achievements|daily quests]], each quest giving 5 candy. **Winning [[Gamemodes#Roulette|Roulette minigames]], each win granting 7 candy. **Opening a door, each door granting 15 candy. **Using the [[Emotes#Limited|Trick or Treat emote]], allowing other players to gift candy (5, 25, 50 or 100). **Clicking the candy icon in the bottom corner, which would pull up 3 amounts of candy that are buyable using {{Robux}} (100, 500, 1000 for 49, 229, and 449 robux respectfully). [[File:Shopdude.png|frameless|center]] *Candy can be used to buy a random [[Emotes#Limited|Halloween limited emote]] and a new [[Items#Broom|broom item]] from a shop NPC on the new island. [[File:SPOOKYRAGA.png|frameless|right|200px]] **The first purchase from the halloween shop would grant the [[Emotes#Limited|Trick or Treat emote]], while the rest of the emotes cost 100 candy: Skeleton Hands, Pumpkin Show, Spider, Spooky Month, Thriller, Slasher, Pumpkin Carve, Crow, Dark Zone, Spooky Skeleton, Sinister Laugh. **The Broom costs 15 candy. *Similarly to the Christmas event, {{Mahoraga}} was decorated once again with a carved pumpkin on his face and a spooky summoning ritual audio. *The event concluded in {{V|11.6}} on November 8, and any candy after the event has been converted into in-game cash on a tiered scale: **1–1,500 candy: 1 candy = 1$ **1,501–4,000 candy: 2 candy = 1$ **4,001–8,000 candy: 3 candy= 1$ **8,001+ candy: 4 candy = 1$
File:SnowGuy1.png|The various snowmen on the map. File:SnowGuy2.png|The various snowmen on the map. File:SnowGuys.png|The various snowmen on the map. File:SnowGal.png|The various snowmen on the map. File:SnowSpawn.png|A fortress covering a spawn point. File:SnowYard.png|The graveyard's new look. File:SnowCafe.png|The cafe's new target. *On November 27, the game saw the return of the Christmas event in {{V|1.67}}, reintroducing last year's snowy atmosphere, this time with snowmen and snow fortresses spread in random spots around the map. **Additionally, snowpiles could be found all over the map, giving the [[Item#Snowball|snowball]] item once interacted with. **The cafe conveniently obtained a target hanged near its entrance for practice, which will spin when a snowball collides with it. *On {{V|11.68}}, the Christmas map was changed once again, optimizing snow and replacing the map center with a giant Christmas tree with several presents under it, given by Santa Tze who can be found hovering in the sky. **When interacted with, these presents give a random item. **Moreover, a limited-time christmas sale was applied on gamepasses, emotes, and victory flashes, reducing their costs by 20%. *During this, {{Mahoraga}} was once again decorated to fit the christmas style, along with its summoning ritual tune. *The New Years' countdown also came with this event, covering on one of the billboards.
[[File:NewYears2026.png|300px|right]] *Similarly to last year, a countdown to 2026 January was added into the game in {{V|1.67}}. *This time, the countdown has been placed on one of the tower's billboards, starting from November 27. **Being on a public, private, or custom server when the countdown ends will grant the "2026" emote, while turning on everyone's good night setting and launching fireworks for about 10 minutes (some fireworks can land on the ground, dealing around 30 unblockable AoE damage)
*On February 20 of 2026, several pillars and structures from the game Jump Showdown were scattered throughout the map, alongside a glowing red portal in the tunnel exit in the subway. Walking into this portal would take you into a giant room; also from Jump Showdown, with a glowing red knife in the center. **Picking up the glowing red knife would turn you into an upgraded form of the Cursed Child character as a boss battle. This boss would have three lives, and upon death a heart would fly out of your character, and hover towards the nearest player in their base moveset. When this collides with anyone, they will be turned into the boss. If there were no lives left, they would simply die as the soul of the boss attempts to repair their shattered heart.
Starting on April 1, for a couple of weeks, Jujutsu Shenanigans changed each character's name as a joke, many referencing popular media relating to the characters from the anime. *On October 23rd of 2026, the Shinjuku map was replaced with a new Halloween themed Shibuya location, featuring darker tinted buildings, and scarecrows of characters, pumpkins and pots scattered around the map. **The map's graveyard also showcased several statues, along with a path way surrounded by a rib cage, leading into a portal. Said portal will teleport players to a floating island above the map, with several halloween decorations and a shop. *On top of this, every server will feature special events that reward participants with candy. The exact settings of these events rely on the amount of players in the server, but an event will always happen 30 seconds after the previous has ended, with a chance to either be: **'''''Trick or Treat''''': Five to seven wooden indestructible doors marked with carved pumpkins will appear and get highlighted around the map, blocking doorways with a 100 second timer on them. Once the timer ends, all doors will get highlighted once again and a prompt will appear on them, which needs to be held for 5 seconds to give the interacting player their candy. However, there's a 12.5% chance for one of three outcomes to happen instead: ***A skeleton NPC will spawn and immediately attack the nearest player. This NPC has 50 HP, can block, dash, and only uses M1s (specifically {{Vessel}}'s). ***The door will aim a "Hollow Orange" move in a random direction. The ability is an exact copy of {{Honored One}}'s Hollow Purple, but the projectile resulting from the attack is orange, and does not deal any damage. ***The door will start running, becoming a fast entity with 1 HP that will constantly try to make distance between it and other players. **'''''Pumpkin Hunt''''': Up to 3 players will be chosen to have a pumpkin on their head and must hold on to it for 60 seconds (stacks the more players are chosen). A pumpkin holder is unable to run, and if ragdolled by an attack, their pumpkin will be transfered to whoever ragdolled them. Once the timer ends, all players who wore a pumpkin for at least 1 second will get candy. *Candy was added once again as new currency, shown in the bottom corner of your screen and obtainable in 9 ways: [[File:Candies.png|frameless|right]] **Killing players, with each kill granting 1 candy. **Finishing [[Achievements|daily quests]], each quest giving 7.5 candy. **Finishing [[Achievements|daily quests]], each quest giving 50 candy. **Winning [[Gamemodes#Roulette|Roulette minigames]], each win granting 7 candy. **Opening a door or getting hit first by its Hollow Orange, granting 15 candy. **Killing a skeleton or running door, granting 20 candy. ***If the player to summon the skeleton dies before killing it, no candy will be given and the skeleton will collapse. **Holding into the pumpkin, with each second equaling to 1 candy. **Using the Trick or Treat emote, allowing other players to gift candy (5, 25, 50 or 100). The emote is obtainable by making any kind of purchase at the Halloween Shop NPC on the floating island. **Clicking the candy icon in the bottom corner, which would pull up 3 amounts of candy that are buyable using {{Robux}} (100, 500, 1000 for 49, 229, and 449 robux respectfully). *Candy is a currency used to buy several cosmetics from the shop NPC on the floating island: **A random 2026 Halloween Emote for 100 candy, picked from a pool of 17 emotes: Brains…, Chainsaw Run, Don’t Be Afraid, Happy Halloween, Head Spin, I am a Human, Jumpscared, Let Me Go, Missing, Pyramid, Shaggy, Showtime, Skeleton, Spooky Disguise, The Ring, Thriller2, Zombie Goofy. **A random 2026 Halloween Skin for 100 candy, picked from a pool of 10 skins: ***{{Mahoraga}}: Pumpkin (Hat) ***{{Puppet Master}} (Absolute): Pumpkin (Hat). ***[[Kogane]]: Hockey Mask (Face), Fangs (Face), Pumpkin (Hat), Axe (Hat), Ghost (Hat), Pirate Hat (Hat), Witch (Hat), Candy Bucket (Neckwear), **The Broom for 15 candy. **A random 2025 Halloween Emote for 250 candy, includes: Skeleton Hands, Pumpkin Show, Spider, Spooky Month, Thriller, Slasher, Pumpkin Carve, Crow, Dark Zone, Spooky Skeleton, Sinister Laugh.

You're going to die.|Naoya Zenin ({{Head of the Hei}}), to Choso ({{Blood Manipulator}})}} ==Description== Head of the Hei is the 9th [[Characters#Early Access|Early Access]] and 16th [[Characters|character]] that was added to ''Jujutsu Shenanigans''. ===Origin=== {{Origin |Head of the Hei is based off of Naoya Zenin, a character from ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. |{{JJK|Naoya Zenin}} was a special grade 1 sorcerer and the youngest son of the previous head of the Zenin clan, {{JJK|Naobito Zenin}}, inheriting his "Projection Sorcery" technique. While he failed at becoming the next head of the Zenin clan, Naoya had already managed to become the leader of the clan's elite unit, the Hei, hence the title: "Head of the Hei". }} ==Moveset== |-|Base= {{Ability |Type=PASSIVE |Type Color=purple |Name='''Projectionism''' |Blockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Description=As head of their own squad, the user proves their superiority by applying several alterations to their fighting style: *A full set of M1 only deals 8 damage, with each M1 dealing 2 damage. *Regardless of their vertical movement, the user's final basic attack will always knock the target backwards with evadable stun. **On top of that, the hit will bypass grounded ragdolls, and cancel moves that are interrupted by ragdoll (Divine Dog: Totality, Blood Rain). *Instead of having a regular front dash, the user gains a second side dash. To make up for this, they can now dash in any direction using their two side dashes, with a downtime of 0.45s between the two. |Stat 1=EFFECT |Stat 1 Value=Reduces M1 damage to 8 (2 + 2 + 2 + 2), disables uppercuts and downslams, replaces front dash with a second side dash |Image=Projectionism.gif}} {{Ability |Type=PASSIVE |Type Color=purple |Name='''Frame Freeze''' |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Interruptible=y |No Evasive=y |Description=The applications of the "Projection Sorcery" cursed technique force all parties to abide by the 24 FPS rule, including the user.
Some moves will apply "Projection" on any target they hit, or on the user if they failed to land (either due to block, a miss, or interruption). This can be tracked on a meter lying under the affected player that drains passively at a rate of 2% per second, or 1.3% if the player is suffering from at least one Bleed stack.

Note that the user's own meter will not deplete passively and is even shared with the Projection applied by other {{Head of the Hei}} players, but can be reduced by landing moves.
Whenever the Projection affecting a player reaches or exceeds 100%, it will reset to 0% as the affected player freezes still in a glass frame for 3 seconds. Any hit the user's lands during this (excluding throwables) will break the target out of the frame, dealing 3 times its base damage.

The following attacks will apply Projection on any '''enemy''' they land on, depending on their current Projection meter progress:
*The final M1 will apply: **35% Projection on enemies with no meter. **30% Projection on enemies with 60% Projection or less. **100% Projection on enemies with more than 60% Projection. **40% Projection on enemies with a Bleed stack. *Projection Sorcery's variant will apply 35% Projection. *Projection Breaker will apply: **80% Projection on enemies with no meter. **35% Projection on enemies with any meter progress. **50% Projection on framed enemies. *Decisive Strike will apply: **30% Projection on enemies with any meter progress. **15% Projection on framed enemies. *Cursory Impact will apply 40% Projection (20% per hit), unless the target was framed. However, it cannot frame at all.

The following attacks will apply Projection on the '''user''' if no enemy was hit:
*Projection Breaker, Decisive Strike, and Cursory Impact will fill up the Projection Meter by 50% if missed, or by 45% if blocked. *Landing any of the aforementioned moves on an enemy will lower the Projection Meter by 20%. *Framing an enemy will reduce the Projection Meter to 0%.

They are able to teleport once again before the special goes on cooldown, though only if a target is in sight. The user's M1 count will reset after this. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=9 |Stat 2=PROJECTION |Stat 2 Value=35%, 80% at 0% Projection,
50% on frame |Stat 3=SELF PROJECTION |Stat 3 Value=50% on miss
45% on block |Stat 4=COOLDOWN |Stat 4 Value=18s |Image=ProjectionBreaker.gif}} {{Ability |Name=Bleedout |Unblockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Description=The user pulls out a sharp tanto blade and spins it around before quickly stabbing forwards towards the target's abdomen. Please don't add any combos whatsoever.''''' |notes1=---- }} ==Tips & Techs== ===Tips=== *Taking a moment before breaking an opponent out of a frame is a really strategic move, as it stalls for cooldowns and wastes the enemy's time if they were awakened. *The high mobility in this moveset can be either advantageous or not, depending on how the moves are deployed: **When using Decisive Strike, you could turn around to appear anywhere around the opponent and bypass their block, or simply extend the rush. Be careful as the enemy can still dash away at the last second, use a counter (or a melee armor attack such as Projection Breaker), or interrupt with an attack, especially one with tracking such as Divine Dog: Totality, Garuda Rebound or Rika Downslam. **Cursory Impact's variant can be used to confirm any move if the enemy has no ragdoll cancel, including the 4th M1. It can also be used to switch Decisive Strike to its homing variant by throwing the enemy in the air. **Projection Sorcery, Decisive Strike, and Cursory Impact have similar windups due to sharing the projection visual effect, so using the special in neutral, after an M1 set, or before using one of those attacks may be effective in baiting counters or evasives early. *You can override having no uppercut or downslam by using an [[Items|item]] such as Playful Cloud or Naginata to gain more versatility and better confirms for certain moves (such as Decisive Strike). However, you will lose the ability to apply Frame Freeze unless you're able to land Decisive Strike right after a Projection Breaker. *Vengeance’s counter frames last for quite a while, even to the point of being able to potentially activate the counter a bit after the stab lands or misses. **It can also just be used offensively alongside Bleedout to trigger Hemorrhage. The awakening lost can be replenished easily if the effect lasted a while before it got lifted. ===Techs=== |-|Beginner= ===={{WdsTooltips |toggle = {{{basic-tooltip|'''Rapid Impact'''}}} |content = [[File:I hear a hunter.gif|frameless|300x169px]]}}==== During Cursory Impact's teleport windup, jump while moving to lunge at players like a pouncing dog. This tech allows you to close a gap between you and your enemy and quickly hit them. ===='''Reverse Velocity Technique'''==== By using Decisive Strikes during a back dash, you remain in place for a while, allowing you to make the triple or double use much shorter. Great for catching people off guard. |-|Intermediate= ===={{WdsTooltips |toggle = {{{basic-tooltip|'''Projecting in the 90s'''}}} |content = [[File:90s.gif|frameless|300x169px]]}}==== Turn around 180 degrees then use Projection Breaker, then after the backwards dash, turn back around 180 degrees to face the enemy when you do the kick. It will take practice to get right, but you will be able to get more distance with Projection Breaker. |-|Advanced= ===='''Projection Uplift'''==== First, frame your opponent with m1s. Afterwards, walk up to your opponent before jumping onto their head and jumping again whilst still moving forward. At the peak of your jump, use Projection Breaker. If done correctly, your opponent will be launched into the air high enough to do Decisive Strike's homing variant. ===='''Man-made Skating'''==== Due to the nature of {{Head of the Hei}}'s 4th M1, it is possible to slide on top of the enemy and travel alongside them after landing it. This is effective in confirming Bleedout or messing up with the opponent's neutral. ==Trivia== *{{Head of the Hei}} is the first character to have both 90 HP and 75 HP. *Vengeance's cursed spirit form will always have red tendrils and a white Drakobloxxer face, while the "shell" will have the color of the user's torso when in their Awakening Outfit. **The user will also stay in their [[Gamepasses#Awakening_Outfits|Awakening Outfit]] for 25 seconds after using Time Cell Moon Palace, and shortly during Vengeance's cutscene. *Time Cell Moon Palace's eye follows the player around, and its iris gets bigger the closer they are to it. **Once cast, the domain plays Jujutsu Kaisen's [https://youtu.be/Phn3JwL4SkM?t=52 Looming Threat]. Specifically, it seems to be [https://youtu.be/JI_CfHE7qxA this exact loop] of the song. *Flash Freezing's frames act as separate entities, meaning any target attacks (such as Boogie Woogie), effects (such Clairvoyance) and finishers (such as Unlimited Purple) can be triggered using them. **This is also because every frame has 1e-08 HP (0.00000001), as they explode instantly from any attack. *{{Head of the Hei}}'s [[Events#April Fools 2026 Event|2026 April Fools]] name (bubble pop electric) is based off the song [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vZaiZAAIhoo Bubble Pop Electric] by Gwen Stefani, being a lyric found commonly in the chorus of the song. **The name was chosen due to the edits surfacing around platforms, using the song in tandem with clips of the fight between {{Jjk|Maki Zenin vs. Naoya Zenin|Maki Zenin and Naoya Zenin}}. This eventually devolved into him being called '''bubble pop electric''' in "larp culture." ==Gallery== File:NaoyaZenin.png|Naoya Zen'in, the inspiration for Head of the Hei. They were not mine, but yours.|Chara ({{Cursed Child}}) to the player (UNDERTALE)}} ==Description== Cursed Child used to be the third [[Characters#Overpowered|overpowered]] [[Characters|character]] that has been added into ''Jujutsu Shenanigans'' exclusively for the duration of the JJS x JSD collaboration event, and used to be available in the form of a boss character as well as a regular one. ===Origin=== {{Origin |Cursed Child is based off of ''[https://undertale.wiki/w/Chara Chara Dreemurr]''. |Spoilers=UNDERTALE |Cursed Child is based off of [https://undertale.wiki/w/Chara Chara Dreemurr] from the famous indie game, ''Undertale'' by Toby Fox. Serving as a major character and narrator, Chara is mainly known for being the first human to fall down to the Underground, a kingdom of monsters. Instead the Awakening Bar functioned similarly to {{Mahoraga}}'s Ritual: ***It would drain passively, lasting about 15 seconds when full. ***When fully emptied, the boss would lose health quickly. ***The boss's base moveset would switch over to its awakened one once the Awakening Bar reaches 5 seconds of Awakening time left, except for Reset, as its slot gets occupied by Bloody Mary. **The boss has 250 Max HP, and its health bar was visible on everyone's screens at all times with five red hearts under it, indicative of the boss's lives which shatter once lost. ***After the boss dies, a red heart (which is actually {{Cursed Child}}'s SOUL) will come out of the defeated player and search for a new player to become the boss. Awakened players are excluded and won't be chosen as hosts of the SOUL. ==Trivia== *Getting the first kill with {{Cursed Child}} would grant the [[Emotes#Limited|"Cursed Child"]] emote. This emote is no longer obtainable. *As part of the Jump Showdown X Jujutsu Shenanigans collab, the two games exchanged characters as well as a few buildings, with ''Jujutsu Shenanigans'' obtaining {{Cursed Child}} and ''Jump Showdown'' getting both {{Vessel}} and {{Strongest Of History}}. **Imed, a developer, has stated that this exchange wasn't permanent, and the characters were removed after about a month. *The music that played during Cursed Child's boss fight is called [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dAMBy1l4G1U HeartSever] while the one that plays during its awakening and final heart is called [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=euYxwYAiMUQ Blood Sonata]. *The Cursed Child character was a near exact copy from [https://www.roblox.com/games/18519254033/Jump-Showdown Jump Showdown]. The main differences is that unlike in Jump Showdown: **Feral Takedown was unblockable, and Lethal Wound's stabbing was sped up. **Bloody Mary and Fight had an increased ragdoll duration, lower endlag, and no finishers. **Check dealt no damage nor stun, and was a special with a set cooldown rather than an ability obtained by perfect blocking. **SINCE WHEN WERE YOU IN CONTROL used the Jump Showdown's "Death Awakening sequence instead of the normal one despite being unable to revive the user. **{{Cursed Child}} had no "Special Hell" ability. **Reset countered bullet attacks. **Atonement's non-cutscene hits were unable to bypass ragdoll, and the move did not halt awakening drain. ==Gallery== File:CharaInsp.png|Chara, the inspiration for Cursed Child. Build Mode/Workshop.text:
{{DISPLAYTITLE:'''Workshop'''}} {{BuildTabs}} The '''Workshop''' is a feature added to [[Private Servers]] in V1.72, which allows players to upload their own [[Build Mode]] creations and custom-made characters, sharing them with others as presets without the need of using the saves system. It is also the main tool for loading movesets in [[Gamemodes|Creator Clash]]. The Workshop is accessible through the PS menu's ''Workshop'' tab, or by toggling the ''Workshop Access'' PS server setting to add the workshop's icon to everyone's top bar. Once pulled up, the workshop will showcase 4 tabs displayed: Maps, Movesets, Favorites, and Uploads. The Workshop is the successor to the [[Presets]] menu. Instead of restricting access to specific creators coded into the game, the Workshop was opened to the public for all users to create and publish maps independently without needing a developer. |-|Downloading= [[File:WorkshopMap.png|350px]][[File:WorkshopMoveset.png|440px]]
*Both the Maps and Movesets tabs feature a list of custom builds/characters published by the community, shown in the form of cards. *The top of the tab includes a search bar, arrows to cycle through pages, an option to sort between new and trending (daily, weekly, and monthly) creations, and a download button to reload the list. Keep in mind that the search bar can not only be used to find creations, but even creators by adding an "@" before their name. A card's interface showcases several options: **'''Favorite''': Will favorite the creation, permanently saving it in the "favourites" tab (note that it can only hold up to 90 creations). Pressing it again will undo this action, and the number under the icon indicates how many players have starred said creation. **'''Report''': Used to send a report over to the game's moderators. Pressing this option will pull up a message that warns you of possible reprecussions from a fake report, before asking you to confirm it. **'''Donate''': Pulls up a donation list to the right, which allows you to send robux to the creator. The prices shown are based off of the gamepasses created by the receiver, who will obtain 60% of the donated robux. **'''Load''': After asking for confirmation, you will be respawned with the selected moveset or map. The base map's spawns will be removed automatically if a build was loaded. ***'''Custom Upload''': Exclusive to the Moveset tab, allows you to load a moveset using its import code obtained off of a Character Block, respawning you with the imported moveset. |-|Uploading= [[File:Upload1.png|center|frameless|400px]] *The Uploads tab will group up all of your current creations that have been posted on the workshop, able to navigate through it using the same interface as the other tabs. The top retains the same features (search bar, sorting..), while each published creation comes with 3 options: **'''Edit''': Access the creation's upload menu to allow you to change its data. Pressing this on the "New Upload" card will move over to the uploading menu described below to edit the creation's information. **'''Delete''': Removes the uploaded creation. **'''Load''': After asking for confirmation, will load the selected build in the server or respawn you with the selected character. **Additionally, the top right corner of each card will reveal the amount of users who starred the creation. [[File:UploadMap.png|frameless|350px]][[File:UploadMoveset.png|frameless|440px]]
*On the left side of the uploading menu, you're able to give its card a title, a description, and a background image (using IDs obtained off the [https://create.roblox.com/store/decals Roblox Creator Store], with a ratio of 9:4). These changes are previewed on a card on the bottom left of the screen. *On the right, you are obligated to pick the upload type depending on your creation: **'''Map''': The map that is currently loaded on your server will be published. The upload will not work if the map has no additional parts. **'''Moveset''': Has a blank space to paste a character's export ID, as the moveset must be made on a Character Block. Moreover, a list to the right will be pulled up, which allows you to pick an existing character to serve as the base for your custom character. *By default, all players can publish 2 creations in the workshop. However, you can buy an upload slot at the cost of 500$ or 50{{Robux}}. Deleting a creation will not restore the slot used for it. *You need over 50 kills to upload a moveset to the workshop.

If a swing is blocked, the user will remain in place. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=6 for first swing, 8 for second |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=18s |Image=Circling.gif}} {{Ability |Type=HOLD VARIANT |Type Color=red |Unblockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Name='''Circling''' |Description=By holding down the move's input, the user can strengthen their axe swings through 2 stages: *Holding the move for about 0.3 seconds will make the user glow in yellow, indicating that their second swing will be unblockable. *Holding the move for about 0.8 seconds will make the user glow in red, indicating that both of their swings will be unblockable. *Additionally, the enemy will be sent much higher than normal once they are ragdolled by the unblockable second swing, regardless of the stage. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=6 for first swing, 8 for second |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=18s |Image=CirclingCharge.gif}} {{Ability |Type=AIR VARIANT |Type Color=red |Blockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Name='''Dive Bomb''' |Description=If the user was at least 10 studs in the air, they will spin their axe around them in an attempt to grab nearby enemies with their weapon while propelling themselves upwards for about 20 studs. However: *Canceling this flight with Bird Control can still trigger its attacks if a target is aimed on and within 35 studs. *Canceling this flight with Spatial Transference will keep the move off cooldown. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=18s, none if feinted |Image=BirdControl.gif}} {{Ability |Type=DIRECTION: FORWARD VARIANT |Type Color=red |360 Blockable=y |Interruptible=y |Cannot Bypass Ragdoll=y |Bullet=y |Name='''Bird Control''' |Description=If the user was aiming at a target within 35 studs while walking forwards, the crow will be directed to the target, aiming to crash into them and lift them from the ground.

Keep in mind that the crow will disappear if the user gets ragdolled, and can end up hitting another enemy if they are standing in its way to the designated target. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=6 |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=18s |Image=BirdControlForwards.gif}} {{Ability |Type=DIRECTION: BACKWARD VARIANT |Type Color=red |360 Blockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Bullet=y |Name='''Bird Control''' |Description=If the user was instead walking backwards, the crow will put extra force into its attack, slamming the target on the ground where they stand.

The crow retains its targeting properties, but has a longer ragdoll duration than normal and does not reset Spatial Transference's cooldown. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=8 |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=18s |Image=BirdControlBackwards.gif}} {{Background|MeiMeiBG.png}} |-|Awakening Move= {{Ability |Type=AWAKENING ATTACK |Type Color=navy |Unblockable=y |Uninterruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Explosion=y |Name='''Bird Strike''' |Description=The user activates their cursed technique to call and command a crow, initially only seeing through its eyes at the cost of them staying vulnerable in place. Should the charmer use an M1 or their Awakening button, the crow will make a binding vow and give up its life for immense cursed energy after letting out a harsh caw and speeding forwards. Keep in mind that this Awakening won't immediately drain the bar, but instead deplete it by 5% for every second the crow is guided for. The user will only lose all Awakening after the bird makes a binding vow, then get it refunded based on the attack's success. |Stat 2 Value=16s |Image=ImpetusUpdraftFinisher.gif}} {{Ability |Type=AIR VARIANT |Type Color=red |Blockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Name='''Air Updraft''' |Description=The |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Name='''Circling''' |Description=The second swing breaks the target apart, sending their upper body flying without legs. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=12 |Bullet=y |Name='''Bird Control''' |Description=The user's servant puts all its weight and strength into crushing the target, until both explode leaving only blood and feathers behind. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=Insta-kill |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=18s |Image=BirdControlFinisher.gif}} ==Pros & Cons== {{ProsCons|pros= *Base moveset with low endlag and unpunishable combo paths. *Bird Control's flight allows you to cross long gaps or stay in the air for a significant amount of time. *Flock and Bird Control serve as safe poke tools in neutral, and Bird Control can even be used as a counter due to how difficult it is to interrupt. *Murmurate is an amazing combo starter due to its range and safety on block, along with how it can immediately initiate an air combo if feinted with the special. *Spatial Transference allows you to mitigate several risks of using your moves if you're able to land them, alongside give generally good mobility and combo routes. |cons= *Cannot air combo without correct positioning with the special. *Bird Control's flight variant is rarely useful in catching runners, and its other variants will only force the enemy to block for a moment rather than look out for the direction the crow is coming from. *Circling can be interrupted during its held windup or after block, while Murmurate leaves you open with only the spinning axe to defend yourself. }} ==Combos== {{Combo |sequence1=3 M1s + Murmurate + Spatial Transference (Forwards) + Bird Control (Back) + Circling |damage1=41 |notes1=A fully true combo, taking advantage of Murmurate's true ragdoll, then feinting the rest of the skill to land Circling at the same time as Bird Control's downslam. |sequence2=3 M1s Uppercut + Spatial Transference (Upwards) + Bounding + Impetus Updraft (Use Twice) + Murmurate + Spatial Transference (Upwards) + Bounding + Bird Control (Front) + Dive Bomb |damage2=75 |notes2=Murmurate reaches its maximum range to the left of the user, which allows it to extend after Impetus Updraft's third hit by side dashing and turning, and sets up for the rest of the combo that requires Bird Control's uppercut to reach Dive Bomb's full damage. |sequence3=3 M1s Uppercut + Spatial Transference (Upwards) + Bounding + Bird Control (Front) + Free Fall + Dive Bomb + Impetus Updraft (Use Twice) |damage3=70 |notes3=Barely requires any timing to perform and the target is basically always close to you, thus it's easy to land. |sequence4=3 M1s Uppercut + Spatial Transference (Upwards) + Impetus Updraft (Air) + Bird Control (Back) + Murmurate + Spatial Transference (Upwards) + Dive Bomb |damage4=62 |notes4=...I don't know what to say here. A hard combo to perform, but also flashy. }} ==Tips & Techs== ===Tips=== *Bird Control's interruptibility feature makes it a strong neutral tool if used as a counter. *Spatial Transference is an indispensable combo tool, as without it most skills would be unable to extend into each other and the user might even be forced to switch their strategy. **This is apparent with Impetus Updraft and Murmurate, since accessing an air variant is difficult with such hit endlag. ===Techs=== |-|Beginner= ===='''Spatial Retreat'''==== Spatial Transference can not only feint skills, but even front dashes. This makes it a viable option to evade punishment after a blocked dash if the opponent does not react in time. ===='''Murmnado'''==== As Murmurate follows the user's orientation, one can unshiftlock and start spinning their character to increase the attack's range or make the axe linger over a specific area. |-|Intermediate= ===='''Early Bird'''==== Timing Flock quickly after a jump allows the hop to not lose its momentum when blocked. On top of that, it grants enough height to stay over opponents and their block, and turning around during this case will set the user behind the opponent, letting Flock easily bypass block. |-|Advanced= ===='''Umbilical Cord'''==== Before catching the crow during Bird Control's flight, using Spatial Transference places the user in a semi-stunned state where a skill can be used twice at the same time. ==Trivia== *{{Crow Charmer}} is the first base-only character to ever be released through the Early Access gamepass. Previously, all base-only characters were released directly to the public for free. *Spatial Transference will use the player's selected [[Gamepass|Awakening Outfit]]. *Crow Charmer was mistakenly named "Crow Queen" in the Skill Builder, which is a scrapped name for the character that did not get picked due to losing a vote before the character's release. *Bird Control and Bird Strike's crows are the same ones that define [[Gamemodes#Roulette Overview|Roulette's]] spectator system, and in the [[Emotes|"Crow"]] emote. *Circling's aerial variant works similarly to Naginata's special, and is able to endlessly hold onto a target, similarly to Face Blitz, staying on a ledge and not allowing the axe to make contact with the ground. *{{Crow Charmer}} is the only one to not get a title change during April Fools 2026. *Spatial Transferance can be used to feint out of the karaoke machine. ==Gallery== File:MeiMeiJJK.png|Mei Mei, the inspiration for Crow Charmer. ==History== To read about all of the character's changes, expand the collapsible below.

(unmentioned) *[/] Reworked Impetus Updraft to be an air variant of a new move with a finisher. |- |{{V|1.75}} | *[/] Released to the public. *[/] Added a new Awakening: Bird Strike. |- |{{V|1.74.1}} | *[+] Reduced the fourth M1 windup by ~0.02s. *[+] Decreased the hold time for both of Circling's hold variants by 0.05s. *[+] Bird Control's flight can now be cancelled by M1s. *[-] Bounding now only works on ragdolled opponents. *[-] Increased the endlag on block for Gliding Flight. *[-] Made both of Bird Control's attacks blockable from all sides, and interruptible if the user was hit before the bird lands. *[/] Sped up Bird Control's flight by 30% but made it last for 30% less time. |- |{{V|1.74}} (extra) | *[/] Fixed Bird Control being FPS-dependant. |- |{{V|1.74}} | *[/] Added as Early Access. *[/] Added 4 base moves: Impetus Updraft, Circling, Gliding Flight, Bird Control. *[/] Added a special: Flock. |}

Born from humanity's negative emotions of natural disasters, Hanami wishes to rid the world of humanity because of how it mistreats nature. Their cursed technique, Disaster Plants, allows them to control the growth of nature and manifest plants out of thin air using cursed energy, hence the title: "Disaster Plants". }} ==Moveset== |-|Base= {{Ability |Name='''Arm Wrap''' |Type=COSMETIC/PASSIVE |Type Color=darkviolet |Blockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Description=As the user stands 1.25 times taller than others, their left arm is wrapped in white clothing which forces them to solely rely on their right one to attack. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=Insta-kill |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=17s |Image=FlowerBeamFinisher.gif}} ==Pros & Cons== {{ProsCons |pros= *Uppercuts have slightly increased hitbox sizes compared to other characters and can bypass ragdoll, making them much more lenient in neutral and combos. *Plant Guidance can be used as a spike set up, area denial or as a counter/block break. *Moderately low cooldowns on all abilities, with Plant Guidance being both the lowest and having the potential to be even lower using Bud Shot. *Has an unblockable front dash, a domain expansion and an ultimate beam in Awakening. *Empowered variants can all guarantee heavy damage, and are easily accessible using Cursed Buds to reduce Energy Absorb's cooldown, or by using Shining Sea of Growing Bramches. |cons= *Has no traditional front dash or movement options, losing out on mobility. *Uppercut or downslam cannot interrupt the enemy's action, which leaves you in an awkward spot. *Players will have a much easier time punishing you due to long endlag for some abilities. *Root Rampage's extra uses and Energy Absorb both cost awakening, reducing the total duration of the Awakening state. *Root Rampage can easily be interrupted, while its air variant can even be evaded by dashing at the last second. *Despite requiring the user's aim, Cursed Buds' shots have bad accuracy and thus won't always deal their full damage. *Flower Beam always puts Energy Absorb on cooldown }} ==Combos== |-|Base= {{Combos |sequence1=M1 + Lasso + M1 + Surging Thorns (Last hit miss) + Plant Guidance (Surging Thorns) If there is no ground beneath the user, then they will not appear. **Spikes, however, will appear regardless. *Aiming Root Rampage on indestructible ground makes it significantly easier to chain its hits as the roots will not pass through it. *By using a weapon such as Playful Cloud, you can override having a single M1 to gain more combo potential and damage. This does weaken your neutral a bit due to losing the extended uppercut range, and it also replaces your front dash with one more similar to the default chase. ===Techs=== |-|Beginner= ===='''Swarm Slam'''==== Downslamming an opponent right after you hit them with the long-range variant of Root Swarm will knock them into the spikes and then back to you both dealing an additional 7 damage and bringing them back to you to continue the combo. ===='''Photosynthesis'''==== Using the domain-empowered Flower Beam on an opponent right as the awakening ends will almost fully restore the awakening meter, allowing you to reawaken within less than a minute. |-|Intermediate= ===='''Downslam Surf'''==== Du''e to the nature of the character's downslam, they can be surfed if landed while right on top of the enemy, allowing for easier combo extensions in some cases. ===='''Spike Uppercut'''==== Either after a spike sends a player into the air with aerial defense response or spike chains you can use an uppecut to delay the fall to the spike and get extra damage. |-|Advanced= ===='''Bud Spike'''==== Using Bud Shot with an aimed plant guidance (surging thorns) on the enemy can start a combo from afar or near. (3/20/2026 to 9/5/2026) *The music that plays during Root Rampage and Shining Sea of Growing Branches is called [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mDZb4Fs6G4E&t=94s Your Battle is My Battle], a ''Jujutsu Kaisen OST'' composed by Hiroaki Tsutsumi. **The domain's environment is based on the official game, {{Jjk|Jujutsu Kaisen: Phantom Parade|Jujutsu Kaisen: Phantom Parade}}. *The art of Unlicensed Rhythm Game's "Pass On" shows {{Disaster Plants}} taking the place of Meursault from Limbus Company. *Despite Hanami draining life from plants in the anime, Energy Absorb has no effects on the surrounding terrain whatsoever *Disaster Plants has one of the two longest named moves in the entire game, the other belonging to [[Register]] ==Gallery== File:HanamiJJK.png|Hanami, the inspiration for Disaster Plants. Rising from humanity's hate and fear towards cockroaches, Kurourushi is able to control swarms of roaches reinforced by cursed energy, all while wielding the Festering Life Sword, a cursed tool which is said to mix life and death.
