This ability has no endlag on miss and can be used through the user's own hitstun, meaning it can be used through their own block, skills, and even awakening. However, any of their ongoing actions will be interrupted if the grab is successful or blocked. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=2 for swing |Stat 2=INJURY |Stat 2 Value=2 |Stat 3=COOLDOWN |Stat 3 Value=16s |Image=Chokehold.gif}} {{Ability |Type=VARIANT |Type Color=red |Name='''Chokehold''' |Blockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Description=If used before the Festering Life Sword is reattached, then the user will instead bash the strangled enemy's skull with a heavy punch, sending them away without applying any injury. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=12 for punch |Stat 2=INJURY |Stat 3=COOLDOWN |Stat 3 Value=16s |Image=ChokeholdVariant.gif}} {{Ability |Name='''Roach Swarm''' |Unblockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Bullet=y |Description=The user motions for a horde of roaches to move 35 studs forwards and tear everything in front of them, ragdolling any targets away.
The swarm's hitbox does not account for targets to the right of the user, but the damage dealt by the roaches will increase with every injury on the target. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=6, +2 every 1.5 injuries (up to 14) |Stat 2=INJURY |Stat 3=COOLDOWN |Stat 3 Value=17s |Image=RoachSwarm.gif}} {{Ability |Type=AIR VARIANT |Type Color=red |Name='''Roach Swarm''' |Unblockable=y |Interruptible=y |Cannot Bypass Ragdoll=y |Bullet=y |Description=If the user was airborne, then they will ride the wave of roaches forwards after a slightly extended windup, traveling about 40 studs in a straight line and knocking anyone in their path down with shorter ragdoll. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=6, +2 every 1.5 injuries (up to 14) |Stat 2=INJURY |Stat 3=COOLDOWN |Stat 3 Value=17s |Image=RoachSwarmAir.gif}} {{Ability |Type=SPECIAL VARIANT |Type Color=red |Name='''Roach Swarm''' |Unblockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Explosion=y |Description=By using the special during the windup, the user instead orders the swarm to twirl in the air, becoming fully uncounterable and launching whoever they catch upwards at the cost of shorter range and a longer windup.

There exists a tiny gap in front of the user where targets can avoid the swarm, and using this variant while airborne will suspend the user in the air. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=9, +2 every 1.5 injuries (up to 17) |Stat 2=INJURY |Stat 3=COOLDOWN |Stat 3 Value=17s |Image=RoachSwarmVariant.gif}} {{Background|Kurourushi BG.png}} |-|Awakening Move= {{Ability |Type=AWAKENING ABILITY |Type Color=navy |Name='''Parthenogenesis''' |Interruptible=y |Description=The user stimulates their parthenogenesis process using all their accumulated cursed energy to split into two. They will gain total i-frames once they're highlighted in white, and if successful, they will effectively create an identical copy of themselves which, although not autonomous, can be helpful in battle: *On the first reproduction, the offspring will have 80 Max HP. Any offspring that follow will only have 50 Max HP. **As stated in Iron-Rich, eating a dead player will increase the maximum health of all upcoming offspring by 15 HP. This bonus stacks with each dead body, sealing at 130 HP. *At all times, the offspring will follow the user and face the same direction they're facing. However, they will prioritise any enemy targeted by Earthen Insects over their creator. *The offspring won't attack on its own. Instead, it will perform an M1 anytime their parent does, and will only use its moves if their parent inputted during stun from actions such as blocking. Its moveset will be visible whenever the cursor is hovered on it. **Note that any landed hit will not grant any Awakening progress or contribute to the anti-team burst. *The offspring cannot be harmed by its parent nor can it harm them, and will automatically die if their parent dies. *Using this awakening with an offspring will prompt for it to do the same, and the offspring will perform the process regardless of the user's interruption. However, the Awakening will default to Bugnado if there are 8 Black Deaths in total, or if the next Parthenogenesis would result in more than 7 offsprings at once. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 2=HEALING |Stat 2 Value=25 HP (offspring included) |Stat 3=AWAKENING REFUND |Stat 3 Value=50% on interruption |Image=Parthenogenesis.gif}} {{Ability |Type=AWAKENING VARIANT |Type Color=navy |Name='''Bugnado''' |Unblockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Swarm=y |Description=Pressing the special during the Parthenogenesis windup or awakening with the maximum amount of offspring will feint the duplication process and instead expend the user's cursed energy into producing and controlling an immense amount of roaches for 1.25 seconds.

These roaches will then fly in the air, forming two swirling roach pillars to catch any enemies 30 - 45 studs away then then mixing them into one giant tornado, all while the roaches bite away at the flesh of whoever got caught.

Targets caught by this are unable to ragdoll cancel until they are launched away, and unlike Parthenogenesis, offspring are unable to perform this attack. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=81.8, 46.8 for roaches (0.1 per tick), 35 for burst |Stat 2=HEALING |Stat 2 Value=25 HP on hit |Stat 3=AWAKENING REFUND |Image=Bugnado.gif}} {{Ability |Name='''Invasion''' |Type=DOMAIN INVASION |Type Color=black |Interruptible=y |Description=If Parthenogenesis is activated near a domain border, the user's swarm of roaches will be dedicated towards making a hole in the dome that the user will enter through. Right after, they will remain in a pose while even more bugs proceed to eat away at the invaded domain's border.

Note that the hole can be used by any other player who wishes to enter the domain, and the user is not immune to any sure-hit effects while inside. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=75% to domain lifetime |Stat 2=HEALING |Stat 3=AWAKENING REFUND |Stat 3 Value=60% once over |Image=Invasion.gif}} {{Background|Kurourushi BG.png}} |-|Finishers= {{Ability |Name='''Chokehold''' |Blockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Description=A simple swing of the Festering Life Sword splits the target's legs from their body. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=Insta-kill |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=16s |Image=ChokeholdFinisher.gif}} {{Ability |Name='''Roach Swarm''' |Unblockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Explosion=y |Description=Roaches swarm the target, eating the skin and leaving only the target's skeleton. This functions identically to Bugnado’s finisher. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=Insta-kill |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=17s |Image=RoachSwarmFinisher.gif}} ==Pros & Cons== {{ProsCons |pros= *Injury damage is impossible to avoid. *Chokehold can be used to surprise opponents, while Detach can be used to poke them and get them into close range. *Earthen Insect Trance provides unavoidable pressure and interrupts grab moves like Honored One's Rapid Punches if not dealt with. *Aerial Roach Swarm is a safe gap closing move with no endlag that either hits opponent's block or forces a dash to dodge it. *Can eat corpses to refresh cooldowns, helping to prepare for scenarios where you need to quickly get back to a battle. *Parthenogenesis can reach incredibly high damage output if used correctly, and its clones can extend combos. |cons= *Slightly long cooldowns on some moves. *The special's blinding effect seems to be useless as usernames remain visible, and most targets will manually kill Earthen Insects before you're able to engage. *Chokehold is uneffective against passive players, and has a slight evasion punish window which makes it a risky move to bait or end combos with. *Reattach cannot really be utilized as an M1 reset because of its lack of true stun. *Clones aren't exactly autonomous and won't fend for themselves if attacked. *Invading domains provides no advantage at all, and only puts your life at risk while wasting some of your Awakening meter. }} ==Combos== {{Combos |sequence1=3 M1s + Festering Strikes + Chokehold |damage1=30.5 |notes1=Chokehold should be used while the target is hit by Festering Strikes' final swing to catch them before they are able to evade, and trigger a hatch. |sequence2=3 M1s Uppercut + Festering Strikes + Detach + Roach Swarm (Special) + Chokehold + Reattach + 3 M1s Uppercut |damage2=78.5 |notes2=A hatch occurs during Reattach, incapacitating the target to make way for an M1 reset. |sequence3=3 M1s Uppercut + Roach Swarm (Special) + Fierce Strikes + M1 + Chokehold + Detach + Bugnado + Reattach |damage3=118 (injury excluded) |notes3=Fierce Strikes should be timed with the target's fall, and its ragdoll makes way for the first M1 to land and apply more injury. Later, Reattach can be used to pull the target back and force them to get grabbed by Bugnado. }} ==Tips & Techs== ===Tips=== *After Fierce Strikes' uppercut, the target's body will line up well enough for you to jump and sneak in an M1. The same thing can be done after Air Roach Swarm without the need to jump. *Chokehold's properties make it a pretty decent mixup tool as it can be done anytime during moves, which also allows for some unevadable combo paths and makes it difficult for enemies to win M1 trades. **An example of this is Festering Strikes into Chokehold, as you can catch the opponent as soon as they get knocked back. **Reattach also allows for the same thing if its timer gets to 0, but this can only be done by waiting the timer out since inputting Reattach manually will stop the user from stacking moves. Despite that, this remains a noteworthy tip as it can lead into an unavoidable Roach Swarm or Bugnado. *Using the special while holding a soda can (empty or full) will cause the player to eat the can and immediately regain 15 HP. This will grant the achievement: "I LOVE THE TASTE OF IRON!!!!" ===Techs=== |-|Beginner= ===='''Reattach Safety'''==== When using Reattach connected to a person while they are ragdolled, jump beforehand so that they go upwards and cannot punish you if you do not have any moves. You can, however, follow up with this with the Roach Swarm variant to try to catch them in it. |-|Intermediate= |-|Advanced= ===={{WdsTooltips |toggle = {{{basic-tooltip|'''Roach Ride'''}}} |content = [[File:Life_is_a_Highway_gif.gif|frameless|160x 90px]]}}==== While holding forward when landing the final hit of Festering Strikes, you are sometimes able to ride on your opponent's sliding body. This allows you to combo aerial Roach Swarm into Chokehold by using Roach Swarm near the end of your jump, but the tech is unnecessary if Detach is off cooldown. Your opponents are able to evasive and start a combo while you are riding on top of them though. ==Trivia== *{{Black Death}} is the fourth cursed spirit to be added to the game, after {{Perfection}}, {{Locust Guy}}, and {{Disaster Plants}} (including {{Head of the Hei}}'s Awakening, they would be the fifth). *{{Black Death}}'s title was going to be "Black Devil", which was scrapped by developers due to preference. *Parthenogenesis's clones will wear the user's selected [[Gamepasses|Awakening Outfit]], and like [[Dummy|dummies]], they will automatically pair up with any partner emotes. *It's possible to bypass the limit of 8 offspring in [[Private Servers]] by using the No Stun and Infinite Awakening options. *Earthen Insects are actually considered entities, and thus can be targeted by abilities such as Boogie Woogie and even lock on. *Chokehold's arm animation does play on other characters, but only on 4-handed ones, those being {{Locust Guy}} and {{Strongest Of History}}. *You can use the [[Emotes|Take My Hat emote]] on Earthern Insect Trance's little bugs to give them whatever accessory is on your head. This is because they are considered as entities due to their interactivity. ==Gallery== File:Kurourushi.png|Kurourushi, the inspiration for Black Death. File:Mangarushi.png|Kurourushi's look in the manga, holding the Festering Life Sword. File:Black Death Next to Dummy.png|Black Death's size in comparison to a [[Dummy|dummy]]. (does not affect combat in a major way.) {|class="fandom-table" !Update !Additions/Changes/Fixes |- |{{V|1.81}} | *[-] Reattach no longer pulls the target if the timer runs out. |- |{{V|1.81}} | *[+] Parthenogenesis and Bugnado now heal the user by 25 HP. *[+] Reattach now disables the target's use of skills for 0.5s. *[-] Detach is no longer unblockable. *[/] Fixed injuries still dealing damage on framed targets. |- |{{V|1.79}} | *[+] Increased the injury applied by 1 stack on the first M1 and Earthen Insects popped by the opponent. *[+] Increased the damage of hatches from 12 to 14, Fierce Strikes' last hit from 3 to 5, Chokehold's variant from 10 to 12, Roach Swarm's special variant from 6 to 9, and Bugnado's final burst from 10 to 35. *[+] Earthen Insects will now rotate around the target based on the user's direction. *[+] Reattach's timer will now last for 8 seconds regardless of what was hit. *[+] Detach will now impale through block. *[+] Reduced Chokehold's cooldown from 18s to 16s, and the move now lowers the enemy's injury drain by 33%. *[+] Air Roach Swarm is no longer blockable. *[+] Invasion will now refund 60% awakening back to the user. *[+] Increased Parthenogenesis' clone health from 40 HP to 80 HP for the first clone and to 50 HP for all additional clones. *[+] Parthenogenesis' clones no longer give burst, and their move cooldowns can be seen by hovering the cursor over them. *[-] Increased the windup of air Roach Swarm. *[-] Reduced the injury applied from 2 to 1 by a blocked Detach and/or Reattach. *[-] Heavily reduced Bugnado's damage to domains, and halved it for Invasion. *[-] Reduced the awakening refund of a failed Parthenogenesis from 80% to 50%. *[-] Lowered Bugnado's duration from 1.75s to 1.25s. *[-] Reduced the health boost of Iron-Rich from 20 HP to 15 HP. (unmentioned) *[/] Fixed Iron-Rich not increasing clone HP. |- |{{V|1.77}} | *[-] Reduced the injury applied from 2 stacks to 1 stack for the first M1 and Festering Strikes' last hit. *[-] Increased Festering Strikes' endlag on miss. *[-] Reduced the damage of Roach Swarm's special variant from 10 to 6. *[-] Air Roach Swarm is now blockable. *[-] Reduced Reattach's timer from 10 to 5 seconds on direct hits. |- |{{V|1.76.1}} | *[+] Increased Parthenogenesis' clone limit from 3 to 7. *[-] Decreased clone HP from 80 to 40. *[-] Clones no longer grant any awakening and can no longer be commanded in stun. *[-] Earthen Insect Trance now ends if the user gets ragdolled and no longer stuns. *[-] Reduced Detach's injury stacks from 3 to 2. *[-] Reattach now disables M1s for the duration of its pull. *[-] Roach Swarm's special variant now comes out slower. *[/] The "Flashing Lights" setting now applies to Earthen Insects. |- |{{V|1.76}} (extra) | *[+] Increased clone HP from 40 to 80. *[-] Decreased Parthenogenesis' clone limit from 15 to 3. *[/] Fixed head scale increasing when using Fusion Dance on Parthenogenesis clones. *[/] Fixed Bugnado not disappearing in rare cases. |- |{{V|1.76}} | *[/] Released to the public. *[/] Added 4 base moves: Festering Strikes, Detach, Chokehold, Roach Swarm. *[/] Added a new Awakening: Parthenogenesis, with a variant: Bugnado. *[/] Added a special: Earthen Insect Trance. |}

Build Mode/Presets.text:
{{DISPLAYTITLE:'''Presets'''}} Presets were Official pre-built custom maps created by select community members using the game's [[Build Mode]], Accessible via the [[Private Servers|Private Server]] menu. Presets allow server owners to instantly load detailed arenas, mini-games, and iconic locations without having to build them manually. You were unable to save presets to respect the builders efforts. Presets were coded into Jujutsu Shenanigans to load the preset owners' in-game slots, meaning if a slot was modified the preset would update as well however, preset owners could not alter the preset text or image. This allowed preset owners to update their maps but also posed a risk of inappropriate content being added, which is why presets remained exclusive to Patreon supporters or trusted friends of Tze. To open the Presets menu, you had to follow these steps: # Open or join a '''Private Server''' (Presets can only be accessed by the server owner or players with PS+ Permission). # Click the '''PS Menu''' button located on the top panel of your screen. # Click on the '''Presets''' tab along the top navigation bar of the menu. # Browse the list of available maps or custom builds and click the '''Load''' button on the bottom right of the desired preset card to import it into your server. Presets were originally added on '''3/24/2025''' and removed '''2/20/2026''' for the addition of the [[Build Mode/Workshop|Workshop]]. == Preset Catalog == A total of '''21''' JJS presets existed over the course of its run, with '''four''' of them never officially releasing. {| class="wikitable" style="width: 100%; text-align: center; border-collapse: collapse;" ! style="width: 25%; text-align: center;" | Preset ! style="width: 15%; text-align: center;" | Creator ! style="width: 35%; text-align: left;" | Description ! style="width: 25%; text-align: left;" | Notes |- | [[File:Brick Floor Preset.png|220px|center]]

[[Category:Characters]] {{DISPLAYTITLE:'''Hired Hunter'''}} {{EarlyAccess}} {{Character2 |title1={{Hired Hunter}} |image1= HiredKiller7.png |hp=100 |cost=Early Access |awakening='''Puppet of Carnage''' |special='''Hidden Inventory''' |previous={{Register}} |next={{Locust Guy}}}} {{Quote|But you guys with all your blessed talents, lost to a monkey like me who can't even use jujutsu.|Toji Fushiguro ({{Hired Hunter}}) to {{JJK|Suguru Geto}}}} ==Description== Hired Hunter is the 16th Early Access and 25th character that was added to ''Jujutsu Shenanigans''. ===Origin=== {{Origin|'''Hired Hunter''' is based off of Toji Fushiguro, a character from ''Jujutsu Kaisen''.|{{JJK|Toji Fushiguro}} served as an antagonist in the Hidden Inventory Arc, and even played a minor role in the Shibuya Incident Arc. He was an assassin for hire known as the Sorcerer Hunter, contracted by several groups despite having no cursed energy due to his Heavenly Restriction, hence the title: "Hired Hunter".}} ==Moveset== {{#tag:tabber |Base= |-|Split Soul Katana= {{Ability |Type=PASSIVE |Type Color=purple |Name='''Unrestricted''' |Description=Thanks to their Heavenly Restriction, the user's body has seen vast improvements that make them a fighter on par with sorcerers and curses alike. However, it utterly lacks any trace of cursed energy, which grants them exceptional countermeasures against domains: *All barriers become intangible go through borders of any and all domain expansions at will, and thus can enter whenever they wish. *Several [[Domain Expansion|Domain Expansions]] fail to recognize the user's presence and thus cannot target them with their effects. This includes 0.2 Domain and Jacob's Ladder, but not Malevolent Shrine, Deadly Sentencing, Authentic Mutual Love's katanas, and Incomplete Shrine. **In Malevolent Shrine's case, the toughness of the user's body ends up reducing the slash damage by 66.6% (from 2 to 0.66). **In Deadly Sentencing's case, the domain will prioritise confiscating the cursed tool that the user is currently holding instead of their skills. *Furthermore, the user cannot pick nor take advantage of any binding vows in Casual Duels. |Stat 1=EFFECT |Stat 1 Value=Allows the user to freely walk in domains and evade sure-hits |Image=RestrictionShowcase.gif}} {{Ability |Type=SPECIAL |Type Color=orange |Interruptible=y |Name='''Hidden Inventory''' |Description=As an experienced assassin, the user carries their stash of cursed tools within an inventory curse wrapped around their body.
Each press of the special will store the user's current weapon so they can pull out another, which affects their current moves, M1s, and front dash, but keeps their cooldowns shared. The chosen weapon will be obtained based on the following cycle: Split Soul Katana > Inverted Spear of Heaven > Chain of a Thousand Miles > Split Soul Katana.

To cycle back to a weapon, the user must hold block while pressing the special. Switching tools puts the user's M1s on cooldown for a moment, but its windup will be instant for a certain amount of time depending on the following moves that were used: *A successful Trick, Debilitate, Transcend, Rupture (QTE loss included), Lasso. *Ascend. *Reincarnate. *Whiplash. If the user is interrupted while switching tools, the special will stay off cooldown. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 2=AWAKENING COST |Stat 3=COOLDOWN |Stat 3 Value=5s |Image=SSKSwitch.gif}} {{Ability |Type=PASSIVE |Type Color=purple |Melee=y |Name='''Brig of Dread''' |Description=The Split Soul Katana's specialty is bypassing all physical resistance by cutting directly into one's soul.

and Transcend. *Split Soul Katana and Chain of a Thousand Miles both lack in mobility due to limiting the user to a single dash, which can also be very punishing if the altered dash was used by some skills, in the same exact manner that allows you to invade domains on other characters. *As a result of being unable to interact with binding vows, {{Hired Hunter}}'s moveset cannot be revealed by the Tinted Glasses item. ===Techs=== |-|Beginner= New techs wanted |-|Intermediate= New techs wanted |-|Advanced= ==='Blitz'=== Ascend can create a slightly untrue M1 reset if used to phase through the opponent, and then followed by a backdash M1. ==Trivia== *{{Hired Hunter}}'s title was going to be "Invisible Man", which was scrapped by developers due to preference. **It's also worth mentioning that the title was initially "Hired Killer" for a week after the character's release, but was changed to avoid keyword restrictions in Vietnam from getting ''Jujutsu Shenanigans'' taken down. *{{Hired Hunter}}'s restrictions are not all similar to Toji Fushiguro's, as the latter was able to make binding vows (namely Revealing One's Hand, which is included in Casual Duels' binding vow pool) and should hypothetically be untargetable by several techniques such as Boogie Woogie. Neither fact stands for his in-game counterpart. ==Gallery== File:Toji_Fushiguro_(Anime).png|Toji Fushiguro, the inspiration for Hired Hunter. ==History== To read about all of the character's changes, expand the collapsible below.

It is additionally the default character of the game that all new players will be using when first joining the game. ===Origin=== {{Origin |'''Honored One''' is based off of Satoru Gojo, a character from ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. |{{JJK|Satoru Gojo}} is one of the main supporting characters of the ''Jujutsu Kaisen'' series. He works as an instructor at {{JJK|Tokyo Metropolitan Curse Technical College|Tokyo Jujutsu High}} and is the current inheritor of both the Limitless technique and the Six Eyes trait which made him the strongest sorcerer in the modern era, to the point that he referred to himself as the "Honored One" during a battle, hence the title: "Honored One".}} ==Moveset== |-|Base= {{Ability |Type=COSMETIC |Type Color=mediumpurple |Name='''Infinity''' |Description=Using an application of their technique to protect themselves, the user has no need to actually guard, so they simply pose and hover on the ground when blocking.

|Stat 1 Value=Insta-kill |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=40s |Image=HollowPurpleFinisher.gif}} {{Background|Base gojo's bg.jpg}} ==Pros & Cons== {{ProsCons |pros= *Beginner-friendly moveset that works with most playstyles. *Can use Limitless and Reversal Red to start combos or mixups from afar, or safely bait out a ragdoll cancel. *Decent AoE Awakening with extremely destructive capabilities and a highly disruptive domain expansion. *0.2 Domain has a longer range than the regular Infinite Void and allows the user to kill at least two players if performed correctly, which ends in a finisher cutscene granting i-frames. |cons= *Limitless requires Awakening to use, which forces M1 trading early on as the user is limited. *Can have a difficult time extending after Lapse Blue and Face Grater as both throw the enemy too far to extend, and have punishable endlag. *Unlimited Purple pulls the user out of their Awakening and is unlikely to deal any meaningful damage due to its windup, and considering the user might have already finished off their target with Lapse Blue MAX. *Reversal Red MAX's damage decreases with distance, and its rebounding variant may fail to reach the target despite the base variant landing. *0.2 Domain can be canceled during its windup like any other domain, and sometimes even during the rush, as its i-frames are not constant. Additionally, its rush is entirely horizontal, meaning enemies can easily punish the user at the end of it. }} ==Combos== |-|Base= {{Combos/List|Honored One Base}} |-|Awakening= {{Combos/List|Honored One Awakening}} ==Tips & Techs== *Rather than dashing after Limitless' Air Kick, the user can simply roll to save their dash. *Turning the camera around before Limitless's glass-shattering screen effect appears materialize the user behind the target rather than in front of them. *Flicking the camera while pulling someone with Lapse Blue MAX will allow the player to throw opponents away. If the aerial was used, the orb can be aimed at the sky to make way for Limitless's Air Kick. *It is highly recommended to use Hollow Purple in the air. This makes it easier to hit nearby players, since they cannot stick to the user during the move's startup, or when either player is on elevated ground. The grounded variant has better horizontal aim, so it is best used when the target is further away. ===Techs=== |-|Neutral= *All of {{Honored One}}'s moves prove to somewhat lack in neutral engagements, except for Limitless since both its endlag and windup are low enough to make it an effective approach option, although slightly reactable. Using it in conjunction with a long distance Reversal Red proves to be a tricky situation for the enemy as they'll have to face two directions at the same time if the user appears from behind. |-|Ragdoll Cancel= *Turning back during Limitless's Air Kick can lead into an unavoidable, but counterable, Rapid Punches. The variant can be accessed using Lapse Blue, which means that if the opponent doesn't evade out of the first kick, they will be subjected to a short unpunishable combo. |-|Combos= *Several moves can allow the player to add an extra M1 to their combos for better extensions and somewhat better damage. **Jumping while holding M1 after a landed Twofold Kick lines up the punch's hitbox properly with the opponent, sneaking extra damage in. Using Reversal Red right after this can also lead into a downslam. **Holding M1 while approaching a target ragdolled Rapid Punches often makes way for an uppercut or neutral 4th M1 on wakeup. *Limitless's Air Kick does not solely require Lapse Blue or Twofold Kick to be accessed. Surfing an uppercutted enemy or even hitting them with Reversal Red after that will still trigger the air variant. ==Trivia== *{{Honored One}} is the second character to get an awakening variant, with {{Aspiring Mangaka}} being the first. *If a player equips a small enough avatar head, it can be seen that the blindfold is simply a flat, round disk. *Tze originally intended for Honored One to have a move called "Air Palm", but it was removed and replaced by "Twofold Kick" which was initially named "Rising Kick". *During the testing phases, blocking caused the player to fall more slowly, but this mechanic was scrapped for balancing reasons. *The musical cover used during Infinite Void and 0.2 Domain is called '''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PFYoofgbZlU&t=65s Limitless Gojo Satoru]''' by '''James Liam''', originating from the ''Jujutsu Kaisen'' anime track '''[https://youtu.be/dvUc9tozRE4&t=99 With Rage]''' by '''Yoshimasa Terui'''. **Terui also composed the music that plays after the Unlimited Purple detonates, titled '''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zWW75icDzCE&t=76s If I Am With You]'''. **The track accompanying Hollow Purple is fittingly titled '''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iwG36P3_sYo&t=143s Gojo Satoru Hollow Purple Theme]''', a cover made by '''Samuel Kim''' of '''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zcQvAy3oi0E&t=199s Hollow Purple]''' by '''Alisa Okehazama'''. **Moreover, Reversal Red's Black Flash theme comes directly from the anime as well, derived from the song '''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FtRp6svwSY4&t=154s REMEMBER]''', created by '''Hiroaki Tsutsumi''' and '''Masato Hayakawa'''. *{{Honored One}}'s [[Events#April_Fools_2026_Event|2026 April Fools]] name (blue judas) is based on the '''Lady Gaga''' song, [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9WfWnkVLwao Judas]. **This naming convention is shared with {{Vessel}} (red judas). **The name was chosen due to a multitude of animations and edits of {{Jjk|Satoru Gojo vs. Sukuna|The Battle Of The Strongest}} using the song, eventually devolving into both characters being called '''blue judas''' and '''red judas''' respectively. *The art for "Pass On" during the Unlicensed Rhythm Game shows {{Honored One}} at the back of Mephistopheles, taking the place of Heathcliff from Limbus Company. *If the user performs Lapse Blue MAX's finisher right before Infinite Void ends, they can create an invisible "Hollow Nuke" with no sound, music, or visual effects. ==Gallery== File:Image.png|Satoru Gojo, the inspiration for Honored One. {{DISPLAYTITLE:'''Map'''}} [[File:Mapfunimage.png|center|frameless|400x400px]] ==New Map/Halloween Map== ===Please note that most of the locations are unnamed, and have been replaced by placeholders. It is also incomplete as of now.=== ==Old Map== Since {{Update|1.03}}, this map has been the default fighting area in public servers. The train station is named "Shinjuku Station", suggesting that the map is part of Shinjuku, However, the map bears little resemblance to the actual ward. Almost all of the map is made of destructible parts, a feature inspired by a game called ''Combat Mayhem''. ===Top Down View=== Here's an entire top down view of the current ''Jujutsu Shenanigans'' map: [[File:Top view.png|227x227px]] Using the player's position as reference when in [[Map#Space|space]], it can be deduced that the main map is supposedly located somewhere in the North Pacific Ocean. ===Notable Locations=== While the map itself is basic, there are a number of buildings that are unique and/or notable in some way. |-|Towers= [[File:Towers.png|frameless|right|228x228px]] The tallest buildings in the game. 2 towers with 11 floors conjoined at the 9th floor by a bridge. Ladders can be found on the corners of each tower, allowing easy access to the roof, where fire extinguishers can be found. The second-to-last floors host a [[Interactables|vending machine]] each. As of {{Update|1.44}}, a [[Interactables|customizable billboard]] hangs on each tower. Their editing panels are located on the 4th floors. Destroying one section of the ladders will cause the rest of the handholds to collapse, rendering them unclimbable. |-|Shinjuku Station= A train station with a set of rails inside. Throwables (trash cans and fire extinguishers), vending machines and bathrooms can be found inside. It opens up at the end of the map and near the center of it, at the leaderboards. In the subway station, there is an area containing a control panel and a few rows of seats. The control panel has 2 buttons, one of which allows you to host a broadcast to the whole subway station, and another that calls a speeding train that will travel on the station's rails, heavily damaging everyone in its way. File:Shinjuku_Station.png|The Shinjuku Station's primary entrance. File:Entrance2.png|The Shinjuku Station's secondary entrance. The "Highest Kills" Leaderboard is visible to its side. File:Rails.png|The station's rails. Several trusses are placed near it. File:Bathrooms.png|Bathrooms, pink for women and blue for men. File:Control_Panel.png|The Shinjuku Station's control room. A panel sits with protective glass infront of it. File:Train.gif|The train passing at high speeds. |-|Graveyard= [[File:Graveyard.png|frameless|right|300x300px]] A simple cemetery on the left side of the arcade, featuring a few bare, dead trees and throwable gravestones. After {{Update|1.76}}, Rika Throw was removed and had its skill box pasted on its own gravestone. This gravestone was changed back in the following update, as Rika Throw was readded. |-|Mansion= [[File:Mansion.png|frameless|right|300x300px]] A mansion with two floors, a large garage on the side, and a small bedroom on the second floor. A trash can sits by the bottom of the staircase, and a green screen setup with good lighting for content creation can be found on the back. The garage itself is easy to bust in and out of, and holds shelves with empty boxes along with a stair case to the floor above. |-|Cafe= [[File:Cafe..png|right|200px]][[File:Cafe2.png|right|200px]] An open cafe at the center of the map, notable for being one of the most popular locations and the third tallest building in the game. Found diagonally from the middle of the plaza, it holds a kitchen opposite from the entrance separated by counters, while the rest of the place including the 2nd floor only consists of tables and throwable chairs. A vending machine sits in a corner of the cafe, visible from the outside by the few tall windows. The [[dummy]] will always spawn at the entrance, near a fire extinguisher. |-|Unlicensed Studios= [[File:Unlicensed_Studios.png|right|301x301px]] This location is situated between the graveyard and mansion. Inside, there is: a garbage can, NEP card, vending machine, and playable [[Interactables|arcade cabinets]] (currently, only '''Catch''' and '''Flight''' are playable without their respective emotes). Before an unknown update (likely {{Update|1.38), an invincible dummy sat behind the counter. |-|Tze's= [[File:Tze's.png|right|301x301px]][[File:TzesMenu.png|right|300x200px]] A restaurant adorned with [https://www.patreon.com/MaybeTze Tze]'s icon. This establishment can be found between the Shinjuku Station and the 2 Towers. In all, the premises holds 18 throwables: 1 trash can at the front, 1 fire extinguisher sat on the side of the wall the menu is attached to, and 16 chairs inside. A vending machine is set at the side facing the Towers. A Nep can be found behind the menu board. |-|Jail= [[File:Jail.png|frameless|right|301x301px]] A light purple 3-story house with a large cell built into its side, closed off by metal bars. Inside the cell there is a toilet and hanging bunk bed arrangement, and sits a fire extinguisher outside. |-|Convenience Store= [[File:Convenience store.png|right|301x301px]] A small store, accessible by 2 sets of glass double doors at its front and side. A fire extinguisher and a trash can are near the entrance, along with a soda machine. Inside, there are multiple stocked shelves, a wooden shelf stocked with cardboard boxes, a counter, and references left by Tze. It is worth noting that ruining the shelves will cause a very small lag spike. |-|Comedy Club= [[File:Stage.png|right|300x300px]] A simple purple house. While others may look similar outside, this one is unique, featuring a single floor and a stage inside with a usable microphone requiring voice chat, along with 2 speakers hanging on the ceiling over it, and an interactable piano at the corner. A Nep can be found behind the speaker on the side of the exit. |-|Court= [[File:OuterCourt.png|right|250px]][[File:InnerCourt.png|left|250px]]
A small white courthouse, inspired by the same courthouse ''Jujutsu Kaisen'' where Hiromi Higuruma first awakened his cursed technique. The court includes several microphones and speakers, not too dissimilar to that of the comedy club, usuable by having access to voice chat.
|-|Shenanigans Ball= [[File:shenanigansball.png|right|300x300px]] At the side exit of the Shinjuku Station lies a mall featuring several stores. The entrance to the mall has working escalators, and many graffitis. |-|JJS Book Store= [[File:Book.png|right|300px]][[File:Store.png|left|300px]]
A modest book store with several shelves containing novels from famous writers like Chesstozoid and Rick Riordan.
|-|Sorcerer Appliances= [[File:Sasa.png|right|200px]][[File:Lele.png|right|200px]] An appliance store with everything a jujutsu sorcerer needs on sale. Past the counter lies a backroom with an out of order vending machine and a desk where frostvpn's victims attempt to lift the curse of eot. [[File:Backappliances.png|200px]] |-|SorceWay= [[File:Sorce.png|right|150px]][[File:Way.png|right|150px]] A small fast food restaurant specializing in customizable sorcemarine sandwiches (sorces), salads and wraps. 2 tables and 4 chairs sit outside, while the inner part of the store holds several tables where employees make the orders. A giant bottle of mustard is hidden from view in a corner. |-|Joyful Jolly Sweets= [[File:Joyful.png|right|150px]] A regular candy store with decorations and shelves showcasing many delicacies, a counter in the middle, and a hanged picture of the unemployee of the month. [[File:Jolly.png|left|150px]] |-|Bowling Alley= [[File:Bowling.png|left|225px]][[File:Shoes.png|225px|right]]
A bowling alley with shelves for shoes and a counter. All lanes end with a gap to the void, and the scoreboards are locked on a previous game between testers, contributors, and moderators. Several imed balls can also be found.
[[File:Bowler.png|center|200px]] |-|The Sewers= Can be accessed through the Shenanigans Mall by breaking a wall on the Sorcerer Appliances or Karaoke areas, or by breaking the hatch walls on the Shinjuku Station to reveal the sewer's hallways where lies a seemingly broken, but functional, radio. The sewers are filled with lights and stairs, along with walls connected to sewage pipes, pillars, 2 bridges and giant bars blocking another entrance. Don't touch the cheese in the corner. File:Entrance1.png|A hole in the store can be used to access the sewers. File:Entrance3.png|The Shinjuku Station's walls also make way for a second entrance. File:Entrance4.png|The hallways abrupty end with a ladder to a hall blocked off of the sewers by giant bars. File:Thesewers.png|The main sewer area. ===Hidden Areas & References=== |-|Space= [[File:SPACE.png|right|300x300px]] Space is a secret location accessible by going ~15000 studs above spawn, and appears as a pitch-black void with a few stars drifting away in the distance, and the Earth you've left below. Going even higher does not seem to do anything except cause Earth's model to shrink or grow depending on the direction traveled. |-|Nep= The feline. (the original Duels map) ==Roulette== ===Roulette Voting Lobby=== After picking [[Gamemodes#Roulette Overview|Roulette]] on the gamemodes tab, you'll spawn in a place similar to other popular roblox game MM2, where you can vote your desired Roulette minigames with other players. Roulette minigames are hosted in uniquely different recurring locations, split into 2 categories: '''Large Maps''' (used for the ''SWP, SRC, FSD, EOJ, and AMS'' gamemodes), and '''Small Maps''' (used for the ''FTT, OBA, PFT, and PFC'' gamemodes). All of these maps are based on locations from the ''Jujutsu Kaisen'' series. |-|Detention Center= A vast old hall with a giant hole, opening up on a few platforms towering over a lower, much bigger area covered in water. This location's walls and floors are made from dark grey panels, and its lower floor has ladders that allow you to climb back up to the platforms. This location is categorized as a large map. |-|Shipping Yard= A vast open shipping yard, with large stacked containers blocking a side of it, and many cranes, trucks and forklifts (sometimes holding other large containers) populating the area. This location is categorized as a large map, and has noticeable performance issues when heavy destruction occurs. This map is likely based off of '''''(SPOILERS FOR JUJUTSU KAISEN)'''''Hajime Kashimo's first appearance and fight with Panda and Hakari. |-|Shinjuku's Fallout= Leftovers of a city, previously used as a battlefield for a legendary fight. Most buildings have been torn down to the ground, others stand ruined. Several road barriers have been placed, remaining untouched. Has small easter eggs on skyscrapers like cartoon characters in some camp and Switcher that going Plus Ultra. This location is categorized as a small map. |-|Shibuya Station (1)= A train station floor, connected to 2 elevated platforms via escalators and stairs, granting easy transfer access. A large painting covers one of the floor's walls. This location is categorized as a small map. |-|Shibuya Station (2)= An average underground-level subway station, divided into 2 clean and dilapidated portions. Some walls and floors are broken down, as if a previous fight was held here. This location is categorized as a large map. |-|Theater= A regular theatre with a stage, most likely inspired by '''''(SPOILERS FOR JUJUTSU KAISEN)'''''Yuji Itadori's fight with Hiromi Higuruma in the Culling Games. |-|Construction Site=

 ==Original Map== Prior to {{Update|1.03}}, the ''Jujutsu Shenanigans'' map was based off the Apocalypse Rising map Kin Reborn. The map lacked barriers on the edges. ===Top Down View=== Here's an entire top down view of the old ''Jujutsu Shenanigans'' map, along with the same view of the map, but devoid of destructible blocks: [[File:TopView.png|216x216px]][[File:Destroyed_OldMap.png|227x227px]] ===Notable Locations=== The old map features a number of unique buildings other than the generic apartments. |-|Center= [[File:OldMapMiddle.png|right|frameless|300px]] The middle of the map. Resembles an army camp with 2 military tents and a medical tent (distinguishable by the red "+" on it), along with 4 short wooden outposts on each corner for area surveillance. Barriers have also been placed on one side of the middle. The dummy spawns close to the spawnpoint standing behind one of the tents, while another one can be seen covering the Weekly and All-Time leaderboards. |-|Church= [[File:Chapel.png|right|frameless|250px]] A white small chapel with a grey roof and a welcoming door, oddly having no outer decoration or windows. Inside are 4 rows of long wooden chairs (2 each), facing a stage with a podium and an interactable piano to its right. [[File:Chapel2.png|left|frameless|250px]] |-|Barn= [[File:Barn.png|right|frameless|300x300px]] A red standard barn near the cabins, unsurprisingly with no livestock, but with hay bales scattered inside each of the wooden stalls within. One of the stalls has a truss, which leads to the second floor with the 2 windows. [[File:Barn2.png|left|frameless|300x300px]] |-|Police Station= [[File:FireStation1.png|right|frameless|300x300px]][[File:FireStation1Back.png|right|frameless|300x300px]] A large grey fire station, which has 2 wide open entrances both speculated to be for vehicle entry due to having ramps. The inner premises hold 6 fire extinguishers, each row of 3 backed up against a wall facing the exit. On the outer premises, a grey truss can be found, reaching for the roof. |-|Fire Station= [[File:FireStation2.png|right|frameless|300x300px]] A second fire station with only one entrance, and no fire extinguishers. Instead, it possesses a red line on its outer walls that circles around it, a vending machine, and several red doors that open up to the same room with a staircase leading to the higher floors. A truss sits at the top of its lower roof, for those who wish to get a better look of the outskirts. |-|Tower= [[File:OldTower.png|right|frameless|300x300px]] A single tower, and the tallest building in the map, with only one truss and a vending machine on the outside. The tower has 9 floors, each usually coming with a peculiar room layout composed of 2 parallel walls. |-|Camp= [[File:Cabins.png|right|frameless|300x300px]] Near the barn, 2 small brown red cabins, with white glass and nothing inside, are positioned around a "campfire", which is actually a clump of grass around 2 arcade machines, red and blue, with light smoke coming out of them. |-|Hospital= [[File:Hospital.png|right|frameless|300x300px]] A medium sized hospital, hosting multiple pillars all the way to each room, 2 tables, and many windows covered by the hospital's symbol (-) on the outside. The hospital also features a second floor, empty on the inside, with large glass panes allowing for an elevated view. |-|Extra= [[File:Bruhwhat.png|left|frameless|300x300px]][[File:Whatisthisbruh.png|right|frameless|300x300px]] __NOTOC__

Private Servers.text: {{DISPLAYTITLE:'''Private Servers'''}} Private Servers are free to buy in ''Jujutsu Shenanigans'' and can offer a wide variety of unique commands that allow the owner to customize their experience. ==Private Server Settings== The owner of a private server will have a "'''+'''" icon on their top bar, which, will open a menu with several commands split into 4 sections when clicked. ==='''Server Section'''=== *'''Destruction Respawns''': Toggles automatic world reload. If off, all destructible blocks in the map will not respawn after being destroyed. *'''Destruction''': Toggles world destruction. If off, none of the destructible blocks in the map can be destroyed. *'''Overpowered''': Adds [[Characters#Overpowered|characters]] to the character selection menu. If a player was previously using an overpowered character and spawns in a server with this setting off, their character will automatically be changed to {{Honored One}}. *'''Friendly Fire''': Toggles the ability for teammates to hit each other. *'''Team Icons''': Toggles the visibility of team icons above the heads of players. *'''Item Delivery''': Toggles the ability for players to order items. *'''Gravity''': Changes the world’s gravity. (196.2 by default) *'''Debree Fidelity''': Changes the size of debris in studs. (2 by default) *'''Knockback Multiplier''': Multiplies all knockback velocity by a certain value. (1 by default) *'''Damage Multiplier''': Multiplies all damages by a certain value. (1 by default) *'''Walk Speed''': Changes how fast all players walk. (16 by default) *'''Jump Power''': Changes how high all players can jump. (40 by default) *'''Server Name''': Changes the name of the server on the custom server list. *'''Server Icon''': Changes the icon of the server on the custom server list. *'''Tick Speed''': Changes the tick speed of Logic Blocks. (20 by default) *'''Spawn [[Dummy]]''': Spawns a normal dummy. *'''Spawn [[Dummy|Attacking Dummy]]''': Spawns a dummy that punches using {{Vessel}}’s M1s. *'''Spawn [[Dummy|Low HP Dummy]]''': Spawns a 1 Max HP dummy. *'''Spawn [[Dummy|Immortal Dummy]]''': Spawns a dummy with nearly infinite HP. *'''Spawn [[Dummy|Bullet Dummy]]''': Spawns a dummy that shoots {{Restless Gambler}}’s Reserve Balls. *'''Spawn [[Dummy|Blocking Dummy]]''': Spawns a dummy that holds block. *'''Spawn [[Dummy|Counter Dummy]]''': Spawns a dummy that counters using {{Vessel}}’s Manji Kick. *'''Spawn [[Dummy|Evasive Dummy]]''': Spawns a dummy that use evasive dash when available, a evasion bar that functions similarly to a player's bar, and will be showed for everyone. The bar will be full when spawned. *'''Clear All Dummies''': Removes all dummies from the map. The normal dummy will still respawn in their usual spot. ==='''Moderation Section'''=== * '''Lock Server''': Prevents all players from joining the server when toggled on. * '''Whitelist Voice Chat''': Prevents players who have Voice Chat disabled from joining the server when toggled on. * '''Roulette Changes''': Applies Roulette's balance measures to your server (disabling Absolute, Unrestricted Density, Frame Freeze..). * '''Creator Clash Changes''': Applies Creator Clash's balance measures to your server (disabling overbearing visuals, one-shot hitboxes, etc...). * '''Damage per Second''': Sets a timer for a second (DPS) in which the damage cannot exceed the set value in the DPS setting during that second, otherwise it'll be nullified. * '''Votekick''': Allows players to votekick people. * '''Voteban''': Allows players to voteban people. * '''Killfeed''': Implements a feed on the bottom right of the screen to show who has killed who. '''Only players can make the killfeed pop up, NPC's will not make the feed say anything.''' ==='''Preset Section'''=== This section will pull up the [[Build Mode/Workshop|Workshop]] tab, which allows the player to load community-made builds or characters in their server. Note that these builds cannot be saved using [[Build Mode|Build Tools]]. Before {{update|1.72}}, it allowed the server owner to load several popular community-made builds in their server and would appear outside of the map borders. [[File:Private_server_command_v2.png|frameless|right|180x180px]] ==='''Players Section'''=== On the left side of the menu, you can select the targeted player that you wish to apply these options to, including all players in the server. *'''Apply To New Users''': Only available when selecting "All Players". Automatically applies any other setting to new players, even those who just respawned, without needing to turn off then on the other setting. *'''PS+ Menu''': Grants private server "+" commands to the selected player. *'''Flight''': Give the power to fly to a selected player. *'''[[Build Mode|Free Build]]''': Grant build tools to the selected player. *'''Workshop Access''': Grants access to the [[Build Mode/Workshop|Workshop]] by adding its icon to the top bar. *'''Kick''': Kicks the selected player from the server. *'''Reset''': Resets all of the selected player's cooldowns. *'''No Cooldowns''': Remove the selected player's cooldowns from all moves. *'''Infinite Awakening''': Keeps the Awakening Bar of the selected player filled, even during the Awakened state. *'''Heal''': Restore selected player health to full. *'''Kill''': Set selected player's health to 0. *'''Respawn''': Resets the selected player. *'''Bring''': Brings the selected player to you. *'''Go''': Brings you to the selected player. *'''No Stun''': The selected player can now activate moves without restrictions, and they are able to spam click the same move, this also applies to M1s too. (Except for domain expansions if the player is already in a domain). *'''Respawns''': The selected player will not respawn if this setting is off. *'''Kick on Death''': If the selected player dies, they will be automatically kicked from the server. *'''Skills''': When off, takes away the ability to '''use moves and dashes''' from the selected player. *'''Melee''': When off, takes away the ability to '''M1''' from the selected player. *'''Parkour''': When off, takes away the ability to '''parkour''' from the selected player. *'''Evade''': When off, takes away the ability to use the '''evasive''' from the selected player. *'''Awakening''': When off, takes takes away the ability to '''awaken''' from the selected player. ==Notes== *In private servers, items and sodas are free to buy from the shop or vending machines. The same applies to Untitled Studios' arcade machines. *All dummies spawned using the private server functions button will not automatically respawn. *The Immortal Dummy has approximately 9 billion max health. *'''Keyboard Shortcuts:''' **Pressing "Left Ctrl + P" will enable Free Cam, which switches movement control from the character to the camera. ***While in Free Cam, "Q" and "E" will lose their old functions and respectively begin lowering or elevating the camera. **Pressing "N" toggles Flight. **Pressing "M" toggles Free Build. **Pressing "V" resets all cooldowns. **In "Free Build", you can select and interact with more objects at once by ''holding Ctrl'' and using the ''left mouse button (LMB)'' to activate ''Multi-Select'', while ''Ctrl + C, Ctrl + V and Ctrl + X'' all function as expected (''Copy, Paste, and Cut'', respectively). ***Pressing "T" cycles between the Build Tools: Position, Size, and Rotation.

Interactables.text: {{DISPLAYTITLE:'''Interactables'''}} '''Interactables''' are certain objects around the map that can be interacted with in special ways. ==Throwables== Throwables were added in {{V|1.12}}, spread around the map and able to be picked up and thrown by using the melee button when standing next to them. While in motion, a throwable will deal 15 unblockable bullet damage to the first person it collides with, ragdolling them as it breaks. The following abilities can interact with throwables: Combat Instincts ({{Vessel}}), Lurking Shadow ({{Ten Shadows}}), Boogie Woogie ({{Switcher}}), Severance Kick ({{Salaryman}}), Homerun ({{Register}}), and Lasso ({{Hired Hunter}}). {{Throwables | throwablename=Fire Extinguisher | image1=Fire extinguisher.png | locations=The 2 Towers, Shinjuku Station, Cafe, TZE's | special_effect=Explodes into white mist when it breaks.}} [[File:Arcade machine helded.png|border|199x199px]] [[File:Playmachine thingy.gif|border|frameless|280x280px]] [[File:Blue Arcade machine.png|border|left|195x195px]] [[File:Blue Arcade machine helded.png|border|196x196px]] [[File:Blue machine thingy arcade.gif|border|frameless|280x280px]] Walking up to an arcade machine will pull up an interaction prompt that allows the user to operate the machine and play one of two games: *'''Unlicensed Catch Game'''. *'''Unlicensed Flight Game'''. Be aware that arcade machines can be picked up even while someone's playing on them. |-|Piano= {{Throwables | throwablename=Piano | image1=File:UprightPianoInteractable.png | locations=Stage, Karaoke | special_effect=Plays an unpleasant chord when it breaks.}} Walking up to a piano will pull up an interaction prompt that enables the user to take a seat on the instrument and use it, even allowing them to switch between basic or more complicated notes similarly to the "Piano" emote. Be aware that pianos can be picked up even while someone's playing them. |-|Pumpkin= {{Throwables | throwablename=Pumpkin | image1=File:-3 Pumpkin.jpeg | locations=All around the Halloween (2026) map. | special_effect=Plays the sound of a breaking pumpkin.}} ==Billboards== [[File:Towers.png|right|frameless|200px]] Billboards were added in {{V|1.41}}, and display a default image of a "[https://tenor.com/view/kenepter-cat-cat-meme-cat-tongue-tongue-out-cat-gif-11256565871894817744 silly cat]" that can be changed using an Image ID with the cost of 15$, along with the name of the last person who edited the billboard. This option is free on [[Private Servers]]. [[File:Billban.png|right|frameless|200px]] As of {{V|1.44}}, billboards have a kill requirement that needs to be fulfilled before being used by a player. Using the panel of a billboard displays a message stating you can and will be banned for putting inappropriate images. There are currently 2 billboards on the [[map]], each hung on one of the 2 towers with an editing panel on its 4th floor. ==Vending Machines== [[File:Vending Machine Locations.png|All of the dots represent a vending machine.|thumb|180px|right]]Vending machines are simple, red brick-like structures with small colorful items inside, found in/outside of buildings or in the Shinjuku Station. They were added in {{V|1.V1.20}}, but were non-functional up until {{V|1.37}}, when a proximity prompt was added to them, allowing players to buy a [[Items|soda]]. ==Unlicensed Rhythm Game== Going up to the Karaoke machine in the Shibuya Mall will allow the user to play a Yakuza-style rhythm game by picking one of five snippets: *[https://open.spotify.com/intl-fr/track/3Jore2oSmdOgTOLTG0Bozo?si=68fa3370110f48e4 Judgement -Shinpan-]. *[https://open.spotify.com/intl-fr/track/27VTtMt8bpMUQ2gox3mE3w?si=3e1e9c1166894e09 Tripping On Love]. *[https://open.spotify.com/intl-fr/track/5NwTVBAsSBzcHSRRLefTHU?si=0bd6938ff94844a5 Pass on]. *[https://youtu.be/0U8P7GJAEWM?si=f7tpWbC-agAjEY8S LARPZO] *[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c0o130kRvhk&t=34sIf I could love the one I love.] Do note that the user gains total i-frames while performing. Once the minigame concludes, the player's score will be displayed on their screen.

+ Dash + 3 M1s Uppercut + Face Blitz + Crushing Rushdown + Widespread Strikes |damage1=148.7 |notes1=N/A }} ==Tips & Techs== ===Tips=== *While Focus Strike doesn't reset your M1 count, it will set you to the 4th M1 if it's used after finishing an M1 set. And by uppercutting into Focus Strike, you may follow up with another uppercut or even a downslam. *Chainwhip should mostly be used at a fair distance away from a ragdolled opponent, as they can be pulled away from you if used up close. *You can turn during Body Repel to change the direction of the worm-body amalgamation. By turning around to the opposite direction after hitting someone in front of you, they can sometimes be dragged and fall right in front of you, allowing you to combo extend. *Body Repel's variant can be used to invade domains if used upclose. *If Idle Transfiguration is confiscated by {{Defense Attorney}}'s Deadly Sentencing, then the Awakening Black Flash will be confiscated as well. *Body Disfigure's Force Grab can be used to guarantee a kill inside of your domain expansion if push the arm against its border. However, you must throw the target after draining their bar, as they won't die if still in your grasp when the domain breaks. **Similiar to this, Body Disfigure's Drill Splitter can also be used to guarantee a kill inside of your domain expansion **Speaking of the domain expansion, it cannot be confirmed out of downslams due to its long windup. However, uppercuts still work. It can also be confirmed out of base by launching the enemy using Essence of the Soul's sequence. *Head Splitter's stance resembles the Super Awakening block animation, which makes it able to trick some enemies into second-guessing themselves. *While Transfigured Humans cannot be recycled to give the item, they can be finished off with Focus Strike's Black Flash in order to grant Transfigured Flesh, which can serve as extra bullets for Soul Fire. *Using Idle Transfiguration to finish someone off is an easy way to proc the cooldown reset, allowing for potentially great rampages for absolutely free. **Alternatively, you can simply pay 5$ to keep the move off cooldown via the delivery drone, or use a Transfigured Human. ===Techs=== |-|Beginner= ===={{WdsTooltips |toggle = {{{basic-tooltip|'''Essence Extender'''}}} |content = [[File:EssenceExtenderDemonstration.gif|frameless|240x240px]]}}==== Because of the unique properties of Perfection's first Awakening animation, it's possible to extend off of it using the ragdoll from the explosion of worms or use it as a combo ender after a downslam or uppercut. ===={{WdsTooltips |toggle = {{{basic-tooltip|'''360 Repel'''}}} |content = [[File:360RepelDemonstration.gif|frameless|240x240px]]}}==== If the Body Repel has captured your opponent, swiftly flicking your camera to the opposite direction allows you to extend off of it with any move of your choice. This can also be done to ensure the Body Repel captures an opponent, and you can wind up a downslam, Stockpile aerial/ground variant (rarely), Blade/Club mode Focus Strike or Soul Fire while they're stunned from the Body Repel. It's also even better to unshiftlock and turn your camera to your face and as soon as you catch your opp, you'll reshiftlock in the opposite direction of your body repel. |-|Intermediate= ===='''Focused Uppercut'''==== After landing an uppercut, it is possible to land Focus Strike as well as an additional uppercut after Focus Strike with the right timing (jump after landing Focus Strike to land uppercut). A way to land the second uppercut more easily is by moving directly under the target before using Focus Strike. |-|Advanced= ===={{WdsTooltips |toggle = {{{basic-tooltip|'''BodyPile Slam'''}}} |content = [[File:BodyPileSlamDemonstration.gif|frameless|240x240px]]}}==== After landing Stockpile on a target without ragdoll cancel, you are able to land a true downslam if you start M1ing while the opponent is in the air, then side dash to downslam them after they land. The downslam must be reached with Blade M1s, but it is possible to switch to Clubs after the 3rd M1 to deal extra damage. ==Trivia== *Coincidentally, {{Perfection}} and Register share a move name called '''"Homerun"'''. *{{Perfection}}'s awakening is the first in the game to deal damage to others and used to be titled '''Inspiration''' back before {{V|1.26}}. **The Awakening Outfits gamepass only applies to {{Perfection}}'s Super Awakening. *{{Perfection}} is the character who had been in Early Access for the longest. Official UGC.text:
[[File:Mahoraga Wheel.webp|thumb|One of the UGC items available from the in-game shop.]]

'''UGC''' (User Generated Content) refers to a collection of Roblox avatar items based on ''{{jjk|Jujutsu Kaisen}}'' and designed in the modeling style of ''Jujutsu Shenanigans''. Many of the items use pixelated 3D models similar to those seen in the game.

All official ''Jujutsu Shenanigans'' UGC items are uploaded by the [https://www.roblox.com/groups/33324262/Jujutsu-Shenanigans-UGC#!/about Jujutsu Shenanigans UGC group]. They can be viewed and purchased through the in-game shop using {{Robux}}.

==Shop==
The in-game shop includes various UGC items themed around characters, abilities, and other elements from ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. Selecting an available item allows players to view its Roblox listing and purchase it with {{Robux}}.

==Quests==
[[File:UGCNPC.png|thumb|140px|The NPC formerly used to access the UGC quest menu.]]

In the {{Update|1.38}} patch update, an NPC was added near the leaderboards that allowed players to access '''UGC quests'''. Interacting with the NPC opened a menu containing two quests.

Completing these quests rewarded players with free limited UGC items. The NPC and its quest system were later removed in the {{Update|1.41}} update.

Furthermore, the shikigami's right arm is equipped with the Sword of Extermination, which effectively increases the range and destruction capabilities of its M1s, along with the knockback of Uppercuts. |Stat 1=EFFECT |Stat 1 Value=2x size increase, 1.5x the regular M1 range, and destruction on each M1 |Image=Big raga 22.png}} {{Ability |Type=PASSIVE |Type Color=purple |Name='''Ritual''' |Description=Instead of a regular Awakening Bar, the user possesses a Ritual Bar that will indicate the cursed energy put towards sustaining the shikigami. It starts out depending on the summoner's Awakening progress (although it will always be above 40%), and if empty, their health will start rapidly depleting. However, the Ritual can be refilled by landing any ability, with the exception of Ground Pitch and World Slash. |Stat 1=EFFECT |Stat 1 Value=Replaces Awakening with "Ritual", draining HP whenever empty and lasting for 25s |Image=RitualDemonstration.gif}} {{Ability |Type=SPECIAL |Type Color=orange |Name='''Adaptation Wheel''' |Description=Above the Ritual Bar lies a white wheel adorned by an icon that indicates the user's current mode. Each press of the Awakening button will cycle to another mode, while the Special button will either confirm the selected mode, or quickswap to the next one if the current was already confirmed. Mahoraga possesses a total of 3 modes, all affecting their M1 properties and fourth move: *The '''Attack Mode''', represented by a red sword. *The '''Defense Mode''', represented by a green shield. *The '''Special Mode''', represented by a four-pointed blue star. Keep in mind that swapping modes won't refresh the fourth skill's ongoing cooldown, as it is shared between all 3 variants. |Stat 1=EFFECT |Stat 1 Value=Alters the user M1s and fourth skill |Image=RobloxPlayerBeta_Zhip8pXslp.gif}} {{Ability |Type=PASSIVE |Type Color=purple |Name='''Attack Mode: Sword of Extermination''' |Melee=y |Description=While in Attack Mode, Mahoraga's basic attacks get a much shorter windup than normal. |Stat 1=EFFECT |Stat 1 Value=Significantly reduces M1 start up durations |Image=MahoragaAttackModeMelee.gif}} {{Ability |Type=PASSIVE |Type Color=purple |Name='''Defense Mode: Parry''' |Uninterruptible=y |Description=While in Defense Mode, the user's basic attack will change to a swift block stance, bracing for any incoming hit. If the Divine General is hit during this stance, it will swing its arms outwards, harming anyone in front of it while withstanding the hit.

Some ranged attacks will be deflected in the direction the user faces, redirecting them to harm others. |Stat 1=EFFECT |Stat 1 Value=Switches M1s to a counter with a 0.35s window and 15 damage |Image=MahoragaDefenseModeMelee.gif}} {{Ability |Type=PASSIVE |Type Color=purple |Name='''Special Mode: Sword of Extermination''' |Melee=y |Description=While in Special Mode, Mahoraga's third and fourth basic attacks are able to bypass block entirely. |Stat 1=EFFECT |Stat 1 Value=Makes the last two M1s unblockable |Image=MahoragaSpecialModeMelee.gif}} {{Ability |Name='''Divine Pummel''' |Unblockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Description=The user swings their arm to grab forwards. Any opponent caught within their grasp will get slammed on the ground twice before they are punched out of the grab. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=15, 3 for grab, 4 per slam, 4 for punch |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=12s |Image=DivinePummel.gif}} {{Ability |Name='''Ground Pitch''' |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Unblockable=y |Interruptible=y |Melee=y |Bullet=y |Description=The user grabs a chunk of debris from the surrounding environment to throw it at the nearest target in its field of vision, with a hitbox scaling with the debris' size.
If a target is close enough, they will also be picked up and trapped within the debris then thrown away. If nothing was picked up, the move will get canceled. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=25, 5 for grab, 20 for debris |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=20s |Image=GroundPitch.gif}} {{Ability |Name='''Earthquake''' |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Blockable=y |Melee=y |Description=The user slams their fist into the floor, smashing anyone infront of it. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=12.5 |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=15s |Image=Earthquake.gif}} {{Ability |Type=VARIANT |Type Color=red |Name='''Earthquake''' |Unblockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Bullet=y |Description=By holding the move's input and releasing after 0.8 to 0.9 seconds, the user's fist will release a second larger bullet shockwave that will lift enemies off the ground. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=12.5, totaling 25 |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=15s |Image=EarthquakeVariant.gif}} {{Ability |Name='''Takedown''' |Unblockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Description=After setting their eyes on an opponent within 70 studs, the user momentarily crouches before vanishing then reappearing near the target in a split second with a prepared uppercut to launch them away.

If struck during window this, the wheel will turn, signifying the user's successful adaptation process as they gain several buffs: *Healing, a full Ritual Bar refill, a cooldown reduction on Adaptation, and permanent damage reduction to the attack's type (Melee, Bullet, Explosion, Swarm, and Domain) starting from 10%, and increasing by 20% for each subsequent adaptation to the same type, up to a maximum of 70%. **Adapting to a different attack type overrides the previous damage reduction with the new 10% reduction. |Unblockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Explosion=y |Description=The World Slash rips the enemy's body apart, splitting them into two. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=Insta-kill |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=30s |Image=WorldSlashFinisher.gif}} ==Pros & Cons== {{ProsCons |pros= *Many AOE moves with varying ranges, high damage output and moderate cooldowns. *Strong M1s with destruction, allowing entry to tight spaces, with longer range and the last 2 M1s breaking block, allowing you win every M1 trade. *Possibility of going infinitely thanks to moves and M1s greatly refilling the Ritual Bar, with a successful Adaptation refilling it to the brim, and Takedown granting enough Ritual to stay alive if used out of desperation. *Higher Max HP than all other characters, being 150, along with increased movement speed and better wallbounces. *Summoning Mahoraga gives you i-frames after the third blink, and freezes your opponent in place, making it useful for surviving domains, as it can also count as getting healed to 150 HP. *Parry is the best counter in the game, as it can negate damage from all moves (except domains, counters, and World Cutting Slashes) with the right timing, dealing decent damage or deflecting projectiles while also refilling some of the Ritual Bar. *Divine Pummel operates on a short cooldown, grants immunity to M1 AND each slam can hit multiple people. *Adaptation can aid in lengthening your lifetime, as it reduces damage, heals, and fully charges the Ritual Bar. |cons= *The user will have to pay attention to the Ritual progress on top of the HP, as death is almost guaranteed if the bar is emptied. *Adaptation has low active frames (as well as Parry), and the move requires you to take damage to be able to adapt successfully. It also becomes useless once you reach 70% reduction for an attack type. *Giant hitbox, making it harder to dodge incoming attacks. *Moves give low Ritual energy, so you'll have to be reliant on M1s to restore any Ritual lost. *Divine Pummel and Earthquake have minimal range and can be punished on miss. *Ground Pitch has a large interruption window, leaving the user vulnerable if they didn't pick up an opponent. *Missing Takedown or Adaptation punishes you by granting both of the moves longer cooldowns, while World Slash has a long windup and cooldown regardless of its success. }} ==Combos== {{Combo |sequence1=3 M1s Uppercut / Downslam + Earthquake (Hold) + Divine Pummel + Ground Pitch + World Slash |damage1=119 |notes1=An easy }} ==Tips & Techs== ===Tips=== *It's best to adapt to Melee Attacks, as most moves in the game count as them, along with M1s. *Ground Pitch can get its maximum hitbox size by picking up debris from roads near and directly above the [[map]]'s station, [[Interactables|Vending Machines]], and corners of some buildings. *Parrying works against any move, including Explosive and Swarm Attacks like Unlimited Purple, Body Repel.. except for Dismantle Net and World Cutting Slash ({{Vessel}}'s and {{Strongest Of History}}'s), some counters, and domains. *Before going into a fight, it's recommended to use Special Mode's moveset while keeping Defense Mode on standby by cycling to it with the Awakening button and only selecting it with the special when you're caught in a domain, about to be attacked by a high damaging move, or to quickly attempt to deflect a move on other players. Going into Attack Mode should only be in dire situations to gain access to Takedown, in order to run away (unlikely) or refill your Ritual Bar. *Turning into Mahoraga won't reset your Idle Transfiguration or Execution stacks. ===Techs=== |-|Beginner= ===={{WdsTooltips |toggle = {{{basic-tooltip|'''World Pitch'''}}} |content = [[File:GroundSlashDemonstration.gif|frameless|240x240px]]}}==== The best way to confirm World Slash's success, is by using it after throwing a player with Ground Pitch, to gain enough distance and ragdoll time to land the move without risk of having it canceled. World Slash can also be confirmed after an uppercut or timed Earthquake. |-|Intermediate= ===={{WdsTooltips |toggle = {{{basic-tooltip|'''Ershiks Drop'''}}} |content = [[File:ErshiksDrop.gif|frameless|150x150px]]}}==== Dash on your opponent, press M1 once and immediately press Ground Pitch. |-|Advanced= ===='''Parry Reflex'''==== As Mahoraga, you should be keeping Defense Mode on standby (by having it appear on the wheel, but still unconfirmed.) This isn't much of a tech, however, being able to switch the mode in order to predict an attack or adaptable domain expansion is no easy task, especially when you're getting teamed on in a public server (e.g. a surprise Infinite Void.) ==Trivia== *{{Mahoraga}} has the Lenny Face: ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°). *When using your microphone as {{Mahoraga}}, your speech will play with a deeper tone to other players. *Due to how Mahoraga functions, he technically has the longest in-game awakening, with the possibility of going infinitely. *When {{Mahoraga}} dies, he leaves behind the eight-handled wheel. This is a reference to Mahoraga vs Sukuna in ''Jujutsu Kaisen'', where when Mahoraga died, all that was left of it was its eight-handled wheel. *Once {{Mahoraga}}'s ritual successfully starts, a short soundtrack made by '''Yoshimasa Terui''' starts playing, originating from the ''Jujutsu Kaisen anime,'' and possessing the same name as Vessel's domain expansion: '''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?t=122&v=MB-HTGzd2lg&feature=youtu.be Malevolent Shrine]''', which plays a similar soundtrack, but for an extended time due to the domain lasting longer than the ritual. **On '''November 11th, 2024,''' {{Mahoraga}}'s summoning music was changed to fit the Christmas style. He would also appear to have a PNG image of a beard and Santa's hat on him. This has been removed in {{V|1.50}}, but returned on '''November 27th, 2025,''' 20 updates later. **On '''October 26th, 2025,''' {{Mahoraga}} would appear to have a PNG image of a carved pumpkin on its face. It would also play a snippet of the old ROBLOX [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dBvlnyvgOnw '''Horror'''] theme just before the Malevolent Shrine theme played. Shop.text:
{{DISPLAYTITLE:'''Shop'''}} Among the many icons on the top bar sits the Shop icon, that resembles a store front, with the player's current cash amount ($) to its right. ==Cash== '''''Cash''''' (or '''''Shenaniyen''''') is a currency that can only be used for [[Emotes]], Skins, [[Items#Soda|Soda]], [[Items]], Victory Flashes, [[Customizable Billboards]], and [[Build Mode#Workshop|Workshop Upload Slots]]. Primary means of acquiring cash include: *Killing another player in a [[Gamemodes|Public or Ranked]] server grants 5$. Finishing off a low HP player is not guaranteed to grant the reward, to deal the highest damage to a player before they die for you to get rewarded. Dying before your enemy is finished off will cause the damage dealt to be unaccounted for. **If the enemy ends up dying to the void or leaving the game before getting finished off properly, then the cash reward will only be granted if ?? damage was dealt to them. *Upon the completion of a Roulette minigame, players will receive currency rewards based on their total points earned in said minigame, capping at 50$ every round. Feel free to view the Roulette point system [[Gamemodes#Rewards|here]]. *Completing a [[Achievements|daily quest]] rewards players with 15$, meaning they can earn up to 45$ every day. *Completing a [[Achievements|weekly quest]] rewards players with 100$, meaning they can earn up to 300$ every week. *Petting [[Kogane]] rewards players with 5$, which increases by $1 each consecutive day it is claimed, to a maximum of $15 every day. *Redeeming an admissible code in the Shop, possibly granting a cash bonus. ==Shop== Upon pressing the shop icon, a menu with many purchasable luxuries and services to buy with cash will appear, assorted in 4 sections: |-|Shop= [[File:Reducedpriceshop!itemdeliveryforonly25$!!!we'regonnabeRICH!!OHYEAHHHHDELIVERYSERVICES!.png|200x200px]]
Offers the choice to buy either Emotes, Victory Flashes, Soda, and Items, or to redeem a code. ==Soda Delivery== Upon buying a soda for 5$, a delivery drone will drop off a soda for you to claim, which will give various positive effects when drunk. To learn more about [[Items#Soda|soda]], click the highlighted link. ==Item Delivery== Upon buying an item for 5$, a delivery drone will drop off an item randomly chosen from a predetermined pool. To learn more about [[Items|items]], click the highlighted link. ==Emotes== Emotes are cosmetic taunts/dances that can be used for shenanigans. While performing an emote, your character will play an animation (often with sound and/or visual effects) that lasts until the emote ends.
Due to the sheer amount of emotes, the list of [[Emotes]] has been assigned to a different page. Click the highlighted link if you wish to check them out. ==Skins== '''Skins''' are cosmetic items that customize a character or item's appearance without affecting its core mechanics. These can be equipped on the inventory, split in tabs for every in game character and item with a skin, along with [[Kogane]]. Skins are purchased at the same price as emotes. ==Victory Flashes== Victory Flashes are brief cutscenes that play after winning a [[Gamemodes#Duels|Duel]] or [[Gamemodes#Roulette Overview|Roulette]] match that can be bought for $1000 or 100 {{Robux}}. [[File:Victory Flash Menu.png|right|frameless|300x300px]] To equip Victory Flashes, head over to your inventory then select the "Victories" tab, and choose your preferred Victory Flash. There are currently 9 Victory Flashes in the game: King Of Curses, Stand Proud, Domain Invasion, Watch Your Head, Phenomenal, Meditation, Stalemate Collapse, True Value and Final Dessert. File:Kingofcursesvictory.gif|The default Victory Flash, "King of Curses". File:Domain Invasion.gif|"Domain Invasion". File:Stand Proud Victory Flash.gif||"Stand Proud". File:Watch Your Head Victory Flash.gif|"Watch Your Head". File:Phenomenal Victory Flash.gif|"Phenomenal". File:Meditation Victory Flash.gif|"Meditation". File:Stalemate Collapse.gif|"Stalemate Collapse". File:Parfait.gif|"True Value". File:Finaldessert .gif|"Final Dessert". ==Codes== [[File:Code menu.png|thumb|'''The "Codes" Section in the Shop.'''|540x540px|center]] Currently, the only way to get codes is through the [[Update Log|update notes]] that are either accessible using the Notebook icon on the top bar or in the [https://discord.gg/thezs Discord Server]. Sometimes, the update notes will only mention that a code has been added, and that it's hidden around the map. ===Active Codes===
