Settings.text:
{{DISPLAYTITLE:'''Settings'''}} [[File:SettingsCog.png|center|frameless|120x120px]] '''Settings''' are a feature in ''Jujutsu Shenanigans'' that allow you to customize and optimize your gameplay experience. The settings menu provides players with a range of adjustable options to tailor the game to their preferences for a smooth personalized playstyle. |-|General= ===Game Info=== *Will take you to an info guide consisting of overviews about some of the [[Controls & Mechanics|game's mechanics]], along with some tips and tricks. ===Damage Counter=== *When on, displays a red damage counter (? DMG) to the right of your screen. This counter goes up in total the more damage you deal within a combo while the enemy is in stun, lingering a few seconds before resetting. *Above the counter is the exact damage you dealt within that one hitbox/attack you used. **Strangely, the counter activates on 0 Damage hitboxes from [[Skill Builder|Skill Builder]]. ===Blood=== *When on, blood will show on dead players. When de-activated, blood will not be visible. **Even when disabled, blood still shows up in few moves, but will be recolored. ===Screen Shake=== *When on, will enable the ability for the screen to shake during some moves. ===Server Region[[File:Image 2024-12-18 160958947.png|right|172x172px]]=== *When on, it will add a region indicator at the top right of the screen, depending on the server you currently are. ===Camera Follow=== *When turned on, the camera will focus on the player's head. ===Hide Kills=== *Replaces the total kill count of the player with a "-" on the leaderboard. If every player has this enabled, the leaderboard will only display the name of players, and the teams that are present. ===[[Gamepasses#Awakening_Outfits|Awakening Outfit]]=== *Only appears when owning the gamepass. Pulls up a menu of your saved Roblox avatars that you can pick to wear during your Awakening. ===Flashing Lights=== *Removes screen flashes and impact frames from several moves when off. |-|Controls= ===Auto Use=== *When on, you will automatically use a move when you press its key. When off, you must press the key and then manually click to use the move. ===Auto Run=== *When on, you will automatically run when moving forward. When off, you must press the key twice and hold it for however long you want to run for (Only for PC, as other platforms have no other way). ===UI Scaling=== *Allows you to set the size of certain user interfaces (awakening bar, skill boxes...). ===Menu Scaling=== *Allows you to set the size of certain menus (settings, inventory, achievements..). ===Keybinds=== *Allows you to customize the inputs for skills, basic attacks, blocking and others. ===Sensitivity=== *Acts as a multiplier for the camera sensitivity setting, adjustable between 1 and 10. ===Toolbar Offset=== *Controls the horizontal position of the toolbar. |-|Audio= The volume for all audio settings can be adjusted between '''0''' and '''2.0'''. ===Effect=== *When configured, changes the in-game volume of each sound effect, such as the hits from Cursed Strikes. ===Music=== *When configured, changes the in-game volume of each soundtrack, such as the soundtracks that play when using Malevolent Shrine or after a Hollow Nuke blew up. ===Background Music=== *When configured, changes the in-game volume of background soundtracks, such as the soundtracks that play during a Roulette minigame. ===Voice=== *When configured, changes the volume of in-game voicelines, such as the "Domain Expansion" voicelines or emote sounds. ===Taunts=== *When configured, changes the volume of taunts. ===Custom Sounds=== *When toggled on, will allow you to hear all killsounds. ===[[Custom Kill Sound]]=== *Only appears when owning the gamepass. Grants a space to enter an audio ID that will play from a player killed by you. ===[[Custom Kill Sound|Custom Death Sound]]=== *Only appears when owning the kill sound gamepass. Grants a space to enter an audio ID that will play when you die. ===TTS=== *Stands for "Text To Speech Shenanigans". When on, all nearby players will have a random voice play their chat text out loud. The voice will change every respawn.
(typing "Gaster" playing random bleeps from W. D. Gaster's [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PQziLKn0egY&pp=ygUPZW50cnkgbnVtYmVyIDE3 entry number 17], an Undertale reference.) |-|Performance= ===See FPS (Frames Per Second)=== *See your current framerate, which appears in the top-left corner of your screen. ===Shadows=== *When enabled, this setting will render shadows to make the game feel more realistic. Turning this off may improve performance on low-end devices. ===Destruction Smoke=== *When enabled, this setting creates smoke effects when you destroy walls, floors etc. The effects are inspired from Minecraft's death effects. ===Destruction Interpolation=== *Smoothens debris while using more performance, turning off may reduce lag. ===Physics VFX=== *Toggles the use of heavy special effects, turning off may reduce lag. ===Ragdoll SFX=== *Toggles the audios that play when limbs collide with parts, turning off may reduce lag. |-|Fun= Culmination of effects that alter how you see the game, and only affect your screen once turned on. Only one "time of day" effect (Goodnight, Sunset, Darkness) can be on at a time. ===Invert=== *When activated, reverses every color in the game, making red colors become blue, and so on. ===Gravity=== *When activated, flips your screen upside-down. ===Goodnight=== *When activated, turns the atmosphere to night-time. ===Rain=== *When activated, the weather becomes rainy. ===Cherry=== *When activated, gives the map a pink-ish tint and occasional falling flowers. ===Jolly=== *When activated, the environment becomes slightly foggy and snowflakes start falling from the sky. ===Bloodbath=== *When activated, blood will take much longer to despawn from the environment. ===Bloom=== *When activated, the map will begin to glow very bright. ===Sunset=== *When activated, the sun will be visible from one side of the map, and the atmosphere will be yellowish. ===Darkness=== *When activated, all lights will be very faint, and your field of vision will be limited. The sky shows a starry night with a full moon. ===Headcam=== *When activated, puts the player in an accurate first person view without getting hiding their body. __NOTOC__

Miscellaneous.text:
{{DISPLAYTITLE:Miscellaneous}}
''This page regroups all the game's different fun facts and trivia.''
==Black Flashes== "'''''Black Flash'''''" is a phenomenon from the ''[https://jujutsu-kaisen.fandom.com/wiki/Jujutsu_Kaisen Jujutsu Kaisen]'' series that amplifies the user's physical strike by the power of 2.5 when cursed energy is applied to it within 0.000001 seconds (1 microsecond), resulting in the creation of black and red lightning-like sparks. In the game, it is utilized by {{Honored One}}, {{Vessel}}, {{Perfection}}, {{Switcher}}, {{Cursed Partners}}, {{Salaryman}}, and {{Strongest Of History}}. Some Black Flash variants can be achieved by using two different moves. For example, {{Switcher}}'s Brute Force Black Flash can be activated without the need of Pebble Throw. By using Brute Force then either "Earthquake", "Divergent Fist", or "Focus Strike" right before the blow lands, you can unleash a Black Flash. The same thing can be done with Divergent Fist, Focus Strike, and even Idle Transfiguration's removed Black Flash. ==Glitches== Information here may be patched in future update, and most glitches can only be done in [[Private Servers]]. |-|Domain Invasion= Normally, the only way to enter a domain is by being caught inside during the windup. However, other methods exist that allow you to go inside if you missed the opportunity to do so before the domain was expanded: *When directly next to and facing a domain, get hit by: **{{Honored One}} ***Lapse Blue ***Rapid Punches ***Twofold Kick **{{Vessel}} ***Cursed Strikes ***Rush **{{Restless Gambler}} ***Fever Breaker ***Lucky Rushdown ***Energy Surge **{{Ten Shadows}} ***Great Serpent ***Shadow Swarm ***Ground Pitch **{{Perfection}} ***Body Repel ***Heart Piercer ***Face Blitz ***Crushing Rushdown **{{Blood Manipulator}} ***Flowing Red Scale **{{Switcher}} ***Swift Kick **{{Cursed Partners}} ***Severing Path ***Elbow Rush **{{Head of the Hei}} ***Bleedout ***Decisive Strikes ***Cursory Impact **{{Locust Guy}} ***Wing Throw **{{Aspiring Mangaka}} ***Shut Up! **{{Crow Charmer}} ***Circling *When directly next to and facing a domain, use: **{{Honored One}} ***0.2 Domain **{{Ten Shadows}} ***Nue's variant ***Great Serpent ***Shadow Swarm, triggering Chimera Shadow Garden **{{Perfection}} ***Body Repel's variant ***Body Disfigure's variant, Heart Piercer ***Face Blitz **{{Switcher}} ***Brutal Impact **{{Defense Attorney}} ***Triple Sentence's finisher **{{Cursed Partners}} ***Resolute Slash ***Rika Throw **{{Puppet Master}} ***Ultra Spin, by facing away from the domain during the windup **{{Head of the Hei}} ***Acceleration **{{Crow Charmer}} ***Circling **{{Black Death}} ***Parthenogenesis, triggering Invasion **{{Strongest Of History}} ***Cleave Rush *By walking straight towards a domain border, using the emote "Yamcha", "Guy", "Tired", "Bathtub", "Clash", "Clash2" or "Garbage," then disabling shiftlock, looking in the opposite direction and shiftlocking again, you can clip yourself behind the border and into the domain, completely invading once you cancel the emote. **This also works with "Bow3" and "A Mimir?", but you will have to look in the opposite direction after walking straight to the domain. **Moreover, the "Stylish" emote can also clip you inside by having your left arm stick out of the domain, waiting for the part where you go sideways, then activating shiftlock. **The "Looping" emote can also clip you inside the domain by looking to the left of the domain then cancelling the emote after the first movement. *By using the "Dream Friends", "Mochi Maker", "High Five", "Clash", "Clash2", "Fusion Dance", or "Places" emotes near a domain while facing its border, anyone who joins in on the emote will glitch inside, successfully invading the domain. |-|Visual Bugs= These bugs can be done in both public servers and private ones, but need some preparation to be done consistently: ===Domain Clashes=== [[File:Mahito and Gojo clash.png|right|frameless|218x218px]] Domain clashing still works with other characters, but {{Honored One}} is needed for this to work. The user has to cast their domain while the Honored One isn't in its range, who then gets closer and casts Infinite Void, causing its stun to be canceled but not its visual effects that can only be perceived by the Honored One user, allowing him to see a hybrid domain. However, this is likely irrelevant now due to the actual additions of domain (referred to by TZE as "dough main") clashing. ===Invisible Nuke=== [[File:Hollow Nuke invis .gif|frameless|right]] During {{Honored One}}'s Awakening, waiting until the final notes of Infinite Void's theme (just before the high note), then finishing a low HP target with Lapse Blue MAX and firing Reversal Red MAX at its last position may cause the Unlimited Purple to become invisible while still allowing it to activate outside. ===Invisibility=== While hardly possible in public servers, players can become invisible in [[Private Servers]] thanks to the No Cooldowns and No Stun commands, by repeatedly spamming one of these specific abilities: *Lurking Shadow. *Shadow Swarm. *Takedown. *Widespread Strikes. *Resolute Slash. [[File:Shadow swarm invis.gif|frameless|right]] [[File:Mahito invis glitch kinda.gif|frameless|right]] [[File:Yutaglitch.gif|right|frameless]] |-|Load Failure= Sometimes, when joining Jujutsu Shenanigans, your data which is stored in the servers fails to be retrieved for some reason. If this ever happens, you will get kicked from the game. ==Old Generations== This section is dedicated to ''Scrapped, Reworked, and'' ''Replaced'' mechanics. *{{Vessel}} Removed Variant - Crushing Blow: Upon missing, would make the player grab a chunk from the ground and throw it, similarly to {{Mahoraga}}'s Ground Pitch. *{{Vessel}} Scrapped Move - Slaughter Demon: You slash and stab a couple times with the Slaughter Demon. Note that the animation is still in skill builder. *{{Vessel}} Scrapped Move - Cursed Punches: The user would punch with cursed energy and knock the opponent away. *{{Vessel}} Scrapped Move - Cranium Smash: The user would grab the opponent and headbutt them. *{{Vessel}} Scrapped Move - Triple Kick: The user would kick the opponent three times. *Scrapped ''"Nobara Kugisaki"'': Had a full base moveset, but the only move that shown was {{WdsTooltips|toggle = {{{basic-tooltip|'''''Exorcise'''''}}}|content = [[File:Exorcise.gif|frameless|240px]]}}. The file for her moveset was apparently lost. *{{Honored One}} Scrapped Move - Air Palm: The player would punch the target into the air and kick them like when using '''"Twofold Kick"''' or '''"Lapse Blue"''' with '''"Limitless."''' *{{Honored One}} Old Lapse Blue MAX: The player would suck up chunks of a structure or the ground and throw it at other players. *{{Honored One}} Old Lapse Blue: The player would pull debris out of buildings. *{{Honored One}} Renamed Move - Rising Kick: Twofold Kick used to be named Rising Kick. *{{Ten Shadows}} Old Visual - Domain Invasion: Chimera Shadow Garden: There used to be a domain popup for chimera shadow garden, however it was removed for unknown reasons. *{{Ten Shadows}} Scrapped Move - Domain Expansion: Chimera Shadow Garden: Flood the nearby environment with shadows, did not have a barrier and added shadows to the existing environment. It is currently unknown what it did, and was removed for technical reasons combined with it being difficult to actually lead a fight into an enclosed area to use it in. *Old {{Perfection}} Awakening Move: Head Splitter - The user proceeds to pop their head off and grow legs from it, running around without being able to use abilities or block for a certain time. Meanwhile, their body is given snail-like eyes emerging from the neck, as their body's arms turn into flails and swing around, dealing damage to the surrounding area before their body falls over and explodes. *Old {{Perfection}} Awakening Move Variant - Idle Transfiguration Black Flash: By using Idle Transfiguration again right before impact, you would instead Black Flash the target and fill half of your Super Ultimate meter. This can still be performed by using Idle Transfiguration, but substituting the reuse with Focus Strike. *Old {{Perfection}} Awakening: Required the user to hit a person with a Black Flash in order to progress to their Awakening moveset. If the user missed their Black Flash, 50% of their Awakening Bar would be drained. *Old {{Defense Attorney}} Reworked Move - Extended Swings: The move used to not confirm itself, in exchange for allowing the user to press R to do a sweep instead of a slam. Using it normally would result in it being blockable, and using the sweep would result in it only working if the opponent blocked. *Older {{Defense Attorney}} Reworked Move - Justice Served: The user steps forward while performing 2 forward punches, before spinning around and ending the move with a ragdolling gavel swing. By pressing R, the user will instead swing their gavel to the right instead of forwards, extending its end to ragdoll anyone hit to their side, while also bypassing block to stun the target. *Old {{Defense Attorney}} Removed Variant - Justice Served: If the slam didn't hit anybody, then it will create a large shockwave to travel forwards, creating havoc on anything in the way. If a non-blocking target stood in its path, they will be lifted in the air, as the user swiftly spins towards them with a hammer swing. *Old {{Defense Attorney}} Replaced Move - Grapple: The user shapes their gavel into a grappling hook, then tosses it towards a target on their cursor, causing it to latch onto them as the user pulls the target, stunning them for an extended period. The grapple is blockable from all sides. By pressing R, the user would instead pull themselves to the opponent. This is unblockable, but harmless on its own. *Old {{Defense Attorney}} Replaced Move - Twirling Strikes: The user twirls their gavel while stepping forward before delivering a powerful uppercut that sends anyone caught in it upward. *Old {{Defense Attorney}} Reworked Move - Judgement's Reach: The user lengthens their gavel into a hammer, and prepares a forward lunge. Once landed, they will pull the opponent to them using their gavel and send a heavy blow to their chest before twirling their gavel and unleashing the same punch to the target's face ragdolling them away. *{{Cursed Partners}} Old Cosmetic - Steel Arm: Cursed Partners used to possess a gray steel casing on their right arm throughout all gameplay. This was removed, then added to Elbow Rush exclusively, before finally becoming how it is now; given to the user by Rika when they use their ultimate, and going away when it ends. *{{Cursed Partners}} Relocated Move - Rika Throw: Rika throw used to be in base. *{{Cursed Partners}} Removed Move - Rika Grab: Rika grabs a ragdolled target for a short moment or until they take damage. This was originally in Rika's base moveset, before being moved to her ultimate moveset, and then removed entirely. *{{Cursed Partners}} Reworked Move - Rika Downslam: Used to be in both ultimate and base, did a different animation and dealt 10 blockable damage without stunning the user. *{{Puppet Master}} Reworked Move - Boost On: Dash move with a punch at the end instead of close-range grab, could be used again to do the punch early in exchange for it being blockable. *{{Star Rage}} Reworked Ultimate - Unrestricted Density: The user could activate ultimate and summon a black hole without needing to die, however at the cost of a longer windup and being interruptible. Was likely reworked due to being near useless for the user; being easy to escape and interrupt if not trapped in a domain cast sequence, and even if successful, kills the user. *{{Strongest Of History}} Old Visual - Think Fast: Used to say "Think Fast" when casting Dismantle Net.

Locust Guy.text:
[[Category:Characters]][[Category:Base Only Characters]] {{DISPLAYTITLE:'''Locust Guy'''}} {{Character2 |title1={{Locust_Guy}} |cost=Free |awakening='''Directed Poison''' |special='''Fluttering Pounce''' |hp=90 |image1=CleverBoy.png |previous={{Hired Hunter}} |next={{Star Rage}} }} {{Quote|Those who aren't clever are the first to die!|Ko-Guy ({{Locust Guy}}) to Yuji Itadori ({{Vessel}})}} ==Description== Locust Guy is the 9th [[Characters|character]] and the first [[Characters#Base Only|base-only]] that was added to ''Jujutsu Shenanigans''. ===Origin=== {{Origin |Locust Guy is based off of Ko-Guy, a character from ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. |{{Jjk|Ko-Guy}} is a minor antagonist from ''Jujutsu Kaisen'' that Yuji Itadori encountered him on B2F of the Meiji-Jingumae Station while guarding the commissioned curtain during the Shibuya Incident arc. He is a semi-grade 1 cursed spirit, born from humanity's deep-rooted hatred and fear of locust plagues, hence the title "Locust Guy". }} ==Moveset== |-|Base= {{Ability |Type=COSMETIC |Type Color=mediumpurple |Name='''Naturally Selected''' |Description=Since they derive from the hate towards locusts, the user's physiology tends to resemble such insects, giving them two antennas that protrude from the top of their head, an extra pair of arms, and two pairs of pink wings that will flap during moves and front dashes. |Stat 1=EFFECT |Stat 1 Value=Grants an additional pair of arms, antennas and wings |Image=LocustGuyCosmeticsShowcase.png}} {{Ability |Type=SPECIAL |Type Color=orange |Name='''Fluttering Pounce''' |Interruptible=y |Description=The user spreads their wings, flying about 25 studs in the direction they're facing and carrying some momentum wherever they go. Using an M1 will cancel the flight early. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 2=AWAKENING COST |Stat 3=COOLDOWN |Stat 3 Value=16s |Image=FlutteringPounce.gif}} {{Ability |Type=SPECIAL VARIANT |Type Color=orange |Name='''Fluttering Pounce''' |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Description=If the user aims at a ragdolled airborne enemy within 80 studs, they will initiate an air combo by flying to them and suspending both parties in the air while forcing the enemy to wakeup with stun. Although their basic attack count will be set to the third, the user is free to attack as they wish, but the air combo will end if they do not act within a second, or if they ragdoll the enemy.
The special isn't required to be off cooldown when initiating an air combo after a Crushing Jaws or Wing Throw, but it will go on cooldown anytime it is used. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 2=AWAKENING COST |Stat 2 Value=6% |Stat 3=COOLDOWN |Stat 3 Value=16s |Image=FlutteringPounceVariant.gif}} {{Ability |Name='''Clever''' |Blockable=y |Interruptible=y |Cannot Bypass Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Description=The user crouches, getting ready to charge forward with a barrage of punches that ragdoll the target then leaves them stunned in place. This move will save the user's M1 count, and will stop them from moving around during air combos or if the barrage gets blocked even for a moment. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=14.2, 1.1 per hit, 1 for last hit |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=15s |Image=Clever.gif}} {{Ability |Name='''Black Mucus''' |Unblockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Bullet=y |Description=The user winds their head back before spitting out a ball of dark mucus that will travel a maximum of 60 studs forwards, ragdolling anyone it hits and applying a 15% stackable damage reduction on their attacks for about 13 seconds. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=8 |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=17s |Image=BlackMucus.gif}} {{Ability |Name='''Crushing Jaws''' |Semi Blockable=y |Cannot Bypass Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Melee Armor=y |Total Armor=y |Description=The user swings their head back and forth 3 times while biting. If the third bite connects, the user will gain melee i-frames as they grab the target to drag them along for a short distance, as their armor evolves into total i-frames, before throwing the enemy in the air to grab them yet again and slam their head into the ground, causing a shockwave to bounce them up and away.

Note that the throw is unable to harm the grabbed victim, but can hit any enemies that are close enough, launching them away with true ragdoll.

Only the first bite is blockable, and if it fails to hit an enemy, the rest of the windup will slow down by 40%. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=16, 4 per bite, 4 for slam, 3 for throw (other targets) |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=17s |Image=CrushingJaws.gif}} {{Ability |Name='''Wing Throw''' |Blockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Description=The user winds their arm back before reaching forward to grab their opponent, gaining free flight and melee i-frames shortly before tossing their target away. The grab will persist even if the target cancels their ragdoll, and won't move the user if blocked. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=8, 3 for grab, 5 for throw |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=15s |Image=WingThrow.gif}} {{Background|Ko's background.png}} |-|Awakening Move= {{Ability |Type=AWAKENING ATTACK |Type Color=navy |Name='''Directed Poison''' |Unblockable=y |Uninterruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Explosion=y |Description=The user extends their insect abdomen which is equipped with a sharp end, while exclaiming "俺の勝ち!" (pronounced "Ore no kachi!", which is Japanese for "I win!") before stinging the area in front of them.
This attack is uncounterable, grants total i-frames, and will inflict any opponent unlucky enough to be stung with a poison effect that will drain their health for 10 seconds. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=None for sting, 90 for poison (9/s) |Stat 2=HEALING |Stat 2 Value=25 HP if landed |Stat 3=AWAKENING REFUND |Stat 3 Value=50% if missed |Image=DirectedPoison.gif}} {{Background|DirectPoisonAnime.png}} |-|Finishers= {{Ability |Name='''Crushing Jaws''' |Semi Blockable=y |Interruptible=y |Cannot Bypass Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Description=On the third bite, the user bites the target's head clean off, holding it with their jaw for a bit before letting it go. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=Insta-kill |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=17s |Image=CrushingJawsFinisher.gif}} ==Pros & Cons== {{ProsCons |pros= *Strong base moveset with great combo potential and good mobility. *Best evaisve bait tools out of any character with guaranteed safety from evasive punishes. *Directed Poison can '''almost''' guarantee death. *One of the easiest combos in the game. |cons= *Lacks an actual Awakening moveset. *Long cooldowns on abilities that can be easily punished when missed or blocked due to their endlag, forcing the user to somewhat rely on M1s in neutral. *Directed Poison takes a long time to kill targets, allowing them to outheal its damage using their Awakening or a soda. }} ==Combos== {{Combos |sequence1=M1 + Clever + 3 M1s + Crushing Jaws |damage1=43.2 |notes1=A short unescapable combo that takes advantage of the fact that Clever guarantees a full M1 reset only if used after the first M1. |sequence2=3 M1s + Fluttering Pounce + M1 (Fluttering Pounce cancel) + Uppercut + Clever + Crushing Jaws + Fluttering Pounce + 2 M1s Downslam (M1 early) + Wing Throw (aim up) + 3 M1s + Black Mucus |damage2=89.2 |notes2=After reaching the third M1, using Fluttering Pounce allows for an immediate cancel triggering that same M1, while M1ing early before starting an air combo will initiate it with the 2nd M1. Finally, M1ing at the right time after Wing Throw will allow for an M1 reset. |sequence3=3 M1s Uppercut + Directed Poison + Wing Throw (aim up) + Clever + 3 M1s + Crushing Jaws |damage3=152.2 |notes3=Unlike Black Mucus, Directed Poison's ragdoll time lasts long enough to reliably lead into Wing Throw which should be used to extend Clever to make the poison last, as the lack of awakening does not permit for any air combos. }} ==Tips & Techs== ===Tips=== *Clever has a large frontal hitbox and a sudden windup which can be easily taken advantage of to cancel moves. *Crushing Jaws' hitbox is almost entirely in front of the user and may be difficult to land if they are too close to an enemy. It is highly recommended to keep a small gap between the user and the target before using it. *Black Mucus serves as a good long range interruption move due to its short startup. ===Techs=== |-|Beginner= ===='''Clever Retrieval'''==== By throwing an enemy directly upwards using Wing Throw and then catching them with Clever as they fall, you will have fully reset your M1s. ===='''Fluttering Strike'''==== Holding M1s then using Fluttering Pounce somehow causes the same M1 to be initiated twice in succession. This can allow you to hit the third or fourth M1 twice in a single M1 string. |-|Intermediate= ===='''Superior Reset'''==== By doing a single M1 then using Clever right after, the user gets their M1s fully reset, letting them do 4 M1s instead of 3. ===='''Surfing Pounce'''==== Successfully landing an uppercut surf allows for an easy air combo, although it will require the special to be off cooldown unlike using it after the last 2 moves. |-|Advanced= ===='''Melee Pounce'''==== Using an M1 before an air combo will override the 2 M1s that the player should be getting, and instead allow them to initiate any air combo with the 2nd M1. ===='''Winged Retrieval'''==== After aiming Wing Throw's toss in the air, correctly timing an M1 to hit the falling target will cause that hit's stun to carry over to their wakeup, confirming the rest of the M1 chain if done right. However this can fail due to ragdoll physics, or mechanics such as direction influence. ==Trivia== *{{Locust Guy}}'s title on the game's Roblox menu was simply "Locust". *{{Locust Guy}} is the second character to have an extra pair of arms (the first being {{Strongest Of History}}, and the third being {{Black Death}}), although it's also the only character between the three to never use them. **While generally considered the first base-only character to be released, he is technically the second, as {{Strongest Of History}} also launched without an Awakening moveset. *If Black Mucus is stacked at least 7 times, the target will start healing anyone they hit. Keep in mind that this is highly unlikely to happen in regular public servers, as a target would need to be hit by Black Mucus several times in a very short time frame for this to momentarily occur. *{{Locust Guy}}'s 2026 April Fools name ('''MIT Researcher''') is a direct reference to a satirical short video made by the YouTube channel '''AniDiscourse'''. **These origins are shared with {{Lucky Coward}} (kind scholar), {{Defense Attorney}} (greedy lawyer), {{Switcher}} (menace to society), {{Blood Manipulator}} (loving and caring brother), {{Perfection}} (purifier), {{Salaryman}} (enjoys beating the life out of), and {{Disaster Plants}} (peaceful gardener). ==Gallery== File:KoGuy.png|Ko-Guy, the inspiration behind Locust Guy. ==History== To read about all of the character's changes, expand the collapsible below.
*'''[+]''' : Buff or late addition (after release). *'''[-]''' : Nerf. *'''[/]''' : Bug fix, miscellanous change.. Does not affect combat in a major way. {|class="fandom-table" !Update !Additions/Changes/Fixes |- |{{V|1.79}} | *[/] Fixed Crushing Jaws's run keeping the user airborne. |- |{{V|1.71}} | *[-] Reduced Max HP to 90. *[-] Reduced Crushing Jaws' forward hitbox by 3 studs, increased its endlag on miss by 0.15s, and all subsequent bites will be slowed by 40% if the first misses. *[-] Removed Wing Throw's velocity on block. |- |{{V|1.70}} (extra) | *[/] Fixed Crushing Jaws' third bite being blockable. *[/] Fixed Fluttering Pounce not starting air combos in skill builder. |- |{{V|1.70}} | *[+] Fluttering Pounce's flight can now be ended early with M1s, its cooldown was decreased by 1s, its air-combos no longer require the special to be off cooldown if used after Crushing Jaws or Wing Throw. *[+] Increased Clever's stun duration by 0.15s, decreased its endlag on block by 0.175s, and cooldown from 17s to 15s. *[+] Black Mucus is now unblockable, its debuff duration has been increased by 3s, its cooldown has been decreased from 25s to 17s, and its endlag has been decreased by 20%. *[+] Crushing Jaws' second and third hits are now unblockable, and its cooldown has been decreased from 20s to 17s. *[+] Directed Poison no longer deals damage scaling with the amount of targets, will refund half of the user's Awakening if missed, and heal 25 HP if landed. *[-] Fluttering Pounce's air combos now set to the third M1 rather than the second. *[-] Wing Throw is now blockable. |- |{{V|1.67}} | *[-] Clever saves the user's M1s for longer. |- |{{V|1.63}} | *[+] Decreased the cooldown of Clever to 17s. *[+] Decreased the cooldown of Black Mucus from 30s to 25s. *[-] Increased the cooldown of Fluttering Pounce from 10s to 18s. *[-] Increased the cooldown of Crushing Jaws 15s to 20s, decreased the damage of each hit from 5 to 4, and added endlag to its last hit. ({{V|1.63}} stated "Reduced Crushing Jaw's damage to 15" but that was false) *[-] Decreased the damage of Wing Throw's throw from 7 to 5. *[-] You can no longer start an air combo with M1s. ({{V|1.63}} stated "from jump height", but that was false) |- |{{V|1.59}} | *[/] Fixed a softlock. |- |{{V|1.58}} | *[+] Clever can now extend during air combos. *[+] Hitting an enemy with an M1 can now start air combos. *[/] Fixed a few visual glitches when being grabbed by Crushing Jaws. |- |{{V|1.56}} | *[/] Added new melee animations. *[/] Added a finisher to Crushing Jaws. |- |{{V|1.54}} | *[/] Increased Max HP from 85 to 100. |- |{{V|1.52}} | *[/] Fixed Clever being affected by melee stun immunity. |- |{{V|1.50}} | *[+] Air combos are now more consistent if the target was recently launched by an attack. *[/] Fixed air combos being affected by melee stun immunity. |- |{{V|1.49}} | *[/] Released to the public. *[/] Added 4 base moves: Clever, Black Mucus, Crushing Jaws, Wing Throw. *[/] Added an Awakening: Directed Poison. *[/] Added a special: Fluttering Pounce. |}

Items.text:
{{DISPLAYTITLE:'''Items'''}} [[File:TransfiguredFleshSucks.png|500px|center|link=]] ==What are Items?== Items were introduced in {{Update|1.54}}, which range from tools with miscellaneous uses, to weapons focused around combat. [[File:Itemspawns.png|All of the red dots represent an item spawn on the surface, while the blue dots represent an item spawn underground.|thumb|right|180px]] Items naturally spawn around specific spots on the main map in 10 minute intervals, but can be bought from the shop for $5 at a random chance. There are currently '''20''' in the game, 15 of which are obtainable in public servers: Soda, Coin, Jet Black, Gun, Playful Cloud, Transfigured Flesh, Voice Recorder, Hazenoki's Eye, Sniper, Transfigured Human, Tinted Glasses, TNT, Banana Peel, Naginata, Bowling Ball, and Crowbar. The remaining 5 make up all the [[Build Mode|private server]] exclusive items that can be obtained using Item Blocks alone: Broom, Flashlight, Snowball, Tiantui Star's Blade, and Tiansha Star's Blade. Generally, items will "replace" the user's M1 once picked up, and will fall off the user's hands if they are hit (or in some cases, ragdolled). They can be manually dropped on PC by using the backspace button ("⟵"), and will despawn in 10 seconds if nobody picks them up. Items can also be stored in {{Ten Shadows}}' Lurking Shadow, similarly to throwables. ==List of Items== |-|Soda= {{Items |Name=Soda |Image Item=SodaDrink.png |Image Held=SodaStillPreview.png |Image Used=DrinkingSoda.gif |Damage=15 (can toss) |Durability=One-time use (drink)
Infinite (can toss) |Description=When a basic attack is used while the item is held, the soda's contents will be drank, granting the following effects: *+800% Health regeneration. *Evasive regeneration, specifically at ~7.7 damage dealt/s. **This value does not change regardless of the user's current health. *+200% Projection drain. *These effects are highlighted by white smoke coming out of the user, stack with passive regeneration/drain, but will be lost if the user gets hit.
*If the user was low, the soda can will become usable as a weapon that can be thrown forwards. The can is unblockable and bypasses ragdoll, yet only stuns. *Disables running, jumping, and the use of skills while held. |Trivia= Unlike other items, soda can be bought from vending machines for $2 or separately from the shop for $5. *While playing as {{Black Death}}, the user is able to eat the soda by using the special, instantly regaining 15 HP. An empty soda can also works. *Soda has 2 random colors at the bottom and at the top. This does not affect its behavior. }} |-|Jet Black= {{Items |Name=Jet Black |Image Held=JetBlackStillPreview.png |Image Use=Jetblackuse.gif |Damage=14 (5 + 5 + 4) |Durability=Infinite |Description=Initiating a single basic attack will start a quick 3-slash combo. *Despite giving no armor, the attack is uninterruptible, and will place no cooldown on the user's melee if the last hit lands, which ragdolls enemies up and slightly away. **Uppercuts and downslams are disabled, and all attacks are blockable and cannot bypass ragdoll. *Gets dropped only after ragdoll. |Trivia=Based off of a cursed tool that was once used by {{Jjk|Megumi Fushiguro}} in ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. *Can be obtained using the rainbow seal variant of {{Register}}’s Homerun. }} |-|Coin= {{Items |Name=Coin |Image Held=CoinStillPreview.png |Image Use=Coinuse.gif |Damage=Depends on reflected projectile |Durability=3 successful uses |Description=Initiating a basic attack will flick the coin forwards. *While in motion, the coin is able to deflect most projectiles towards the nearest enemy to it. **This won't exclude the user if no enemy is in range. *The coin can also be donated to the giant Reimu plush by flicking it in its wooden box, causing the plushie to fly away and disappear, then reappear after a few seconds to thank the user. *Disables the use of skills while held. |Trivia=Based off of the Robux icon: [[File:Robux.png|30px]], while its effect it based off of Ultrakill's [https://ultrakill.fandom.com/wiki/Coin Coin]. *Back before {{Update|1.56}}, donating the coin to the Reimu plushie gave $2. *Can be obtained using the rainbow seal variant of {{Register}}’s Fleche. }} |-|Gun= {{Items |Name=Gun |Image Held=GunStillPreview.png |Image Use=Gunuse.gif |Damage=10 per shot |Durability=6 shots |Description=Initiating a basic attack will shoot a bullet 85 studs forwards. *Each bullet can bypass ragdoll yet is blockable. |Trivia=Based off of a weapon used by {{Jjk|Mai Zenin}} in ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. *Can be obtained using the rainbow seal variant of {{Register}}’s Garage Sale, yet will only have 2 bullets. }} |-|Playful Cloud= {{Items |Name=Playful Cloud |Image Held=PlayfulCloudStillPreview.png |Image Use=Playful Cloud.gif |Damage=18 (3 + 3 + (4 + 4) + 4)
8 per projectile |Durability=53 M1s
2 staves |Description=Changes the basic attack string to a 5-hit combo with only 4 inputs, as the 3rd M1 triggers 2 separate hits. *While already higher than normal, the damage dealt by the item will increase the lower the user's health percentage gets. This can scale up to +115% when the user reaches critical health. *The item can be forcibly broken by holding block while initiating the fourth M1. *Only gets dropped after ragdoll. *Once broken (either forcibly or by reaching its natural durability), the middle staff of the item will shatter, separating the other two pieces and rendering them usable as projectiles that can be hurled 120 studs forwards. **A thrown staff will pierce the torso of any enemy in its way then drag them for a long distance, before either letting them go, or staking them to the first wall they meet. |Trivia=Based off of a weapon used by many characters in ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. *Can be obtained using the rainbow seal variant of {{Register}}’s Blunt Trauma. }} |-|Transfigured Flesh= {{Items |Name=Transfigured Flesh |Image Held=TransfiguredFleshStillPreview.png |Image Use=Transfigured human wall.gif |Damage=None |Durability=One-time use |Description=Initiating a basic attack will throw the item and force it to morph into a rectangular wall. *The wall is the same as any surface, is breakable, and will disappear after 10 seconds. *Disables the use of skills while held. |Trivia=Based off of {{Jjk|Mahito}}'s soul distorted victims in ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. *Can only be obtained by landing Focus Strike's Black Flash finisher on an enemy, granting 1-2 Transfigured Flesh. **The color of the item will be the same the target's skin color. *Can be stored by a {{Perfection}} player by using the special while holding the item. It can then either be used as an extra Soul Fire bullet or pulled out by using block and M1 at the same time. }} |-|Voice Recorder= {{Items |Name=Voice Recorder |Image Held=VoiceRecorderStillPreview.png |Image Use=Ifyoumoveyouregay.gif |Damage=None ("Don't Move")
14 ("Plummet")
20 ("Blast Away") |Cooldown=30s |Durability=Infinite |Description=Initiating a basic attack will throw the item and cause a saved recording to play. *The item contains 3 recordings that can be cycled through using the special while holding the item. Each recording causes the item to shine in a distinct color: **Don't Move: All players will immediately freeze for 3 seconds. **Plummet: All players will get forcefully slammed into the ground. **Blast Away: All players will get flung skywards. *Everyone within the 15 stud radius, including the user, will be compelled to follow what the recording says, as its effect is unblockable and bypasses ragdoll. *Disables the use of skills while held. |Trivia=Based off of {{Jjk|Toge Inumaki}}'s cursed technique, "Cursed Speech", from ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. Specifically how {{Jjk|Yuta Okkotsu}} utilized it during a certain fight. }} |-|Hazenoki's Eye= {{Items |Name=Hazenoki's Eye |Image Held=HazenikosEyeStillPreview.png |Image Use=Somegrenadefromeyethingamajig.gif |Damage=15 |Durability=One-time use |Description=Initiating a basic attack will throw the item forwards. *Once it loses momentum or collides with a target, the item will cause an explosion that will blast everything in a 17.5 stud radius, including the user. **The area damage is unblockable and bypasses ragdoll *Disables the use of skills while held. |Trivia=Based off of {{Jjk|Iori Hazenoki}}'s cursed technique, "Explosive Flesh", from ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. }} |-|Sniper= {{Items |Name=Sniper |Image Held=SniperStillPreview.png |Image Use=SniperAimStillPreview.gif |Damage=30 per shot |Durability=3 shots |Description=To use the item properly, the user must aim and look through the scope by pressing the special. Following up with a basic attack will shoot a bullet from the rifle. *Vertical aim is unavailable, but every bullet is unblockable, bypasses ragdoll, and will pierce through players until it reaches a wall or its maximum distance of 350 studs. **After the third shot, the user will get ragdolled backwards from the recoil. *Disables the use of skills while held. |Trivia=Based off of a weapon used by {{Jjk|Mai Zenin}} in ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. *Killing a player with the item will decapitate them. *Can be obtained using the rainbow seal variant of {{Register}}’s Drone Strike, yet will have only one bullet. }} |-|Transfigured Human= {{Items |Name=Transfigured Human |Image Held=TransfiguredHumanStillPreview.png |Durability=One-time use |Description=Initiating a basic attack will throw the item and force it to morph into an aggressive NPC, targeting the nearest opponent. *Transfigured Human NPCs can come in two different sizes that determine their health and moveset: **1.1x: The NPC will have 20 HP and its moveset will consist of: Swift Kick, Brute Force, Justice Served, and Elbow Drop. **0.9x: The NPC will have 15 HP and its moveset will consist of: Clever, Black Mucus, and Brute Force. *NPCs cannot regenerate health or use evasive, and will die if no opponent is within their targeting range. *Disables the use of skills while held. |Trivia=Based off of {{Jjk|Mahito}}'s soul distorted victims in ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. *Can be obtained by landing base Focus Strike's finisher on an enemy, granting 1-2 Transfigured Humans. **The color of the item will be the same the target's skin color. *Can be stored by a {{Perfection}} player by using the special while holding the item. It can then either be used as an extra Soul Fire bullet or pulled out by using block and M1 at the same time. **If the bullet misses, it will count as a regular use of the item, thus morphing into an NPC. *Transfigured Human NPCs do not give any Super Awakening progress or Transfigured Humans, but can give Transfigured Flesh. *Can be obtained using the rainbow seal variant of {{Register}}’s Littering. }} |-|Tinted Glasses= {{Items |Name=Tinted Glasses |Image Held=TintedGlassesStillPreview.png |Durability=Infinite |Description=Initiating a basic attack will equip the item. *Despite granting no armor, this action cannot be interrupted. *While equipped, the user to can see the skill cooldowns, Awakening Bar progress, and evasive bar progress of all players within 85 studs of their camera, similarly to the Casual Duels' binding vow: [[Gamemodes#Casual_Mechanics|Revealing One's Hand]]. *Drops after getting ragdolled for the 11th time. *Disables running and the use of skills while held. |Trivia=Based off of {{Jjk|Satoru Gojo}}'s old glasses from ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. *Players using {{Hired Hunter}} will not show any bars or cooldowns on the tinted glasses. }} |-|TNT= {{Items |Name=TNT |Image Held=TNTStillPreview.png |Damage=20 |Durability=One-time use |Description=Initiating a basic attack will throw the item forwards, priming it for detonation. *The item will explode after 3 seconds of being activated, destroying everything within a 20 stud radius of it. **However, it can still be picked up and tossed again before that happens. **Note that its damage is unblockable and bypasses ragdoll. *If landed directly to a player, the item will stick to them until it explodes. *Disables running and the use of skills while held. |Trivia=Used to be based off of Minecraft's TNT Block, until it was redesigned in {{Update|1.77}}. *Can be targeted by {{Switcher}}'s Boogie Woogie while active. *Can be obtained using the rainbow seal variant of {{Register}}’s Speed Crash. }} |-|Banana Peel= {{Items |Name=Banana Peel |Image Held=BananaPeelStillPreview.png |Damage=None |Durability=One-time use |Description=Initiating a basic attack will throw the item. *Once it makes contact with the ground, the item will remain there for 25 seconds and cannot be moved. Anybody making contact with the item will get ragdolled and flung away. **The flinging conserves the target's momentum, as it will launch them farther the faster they were going. The effect can be blocked though. *Disables running and the use of skills while held. |Trivia=References the comedic gag of slipping on bananas. *Can be targeted by {{Switcher}}'s special while active. }} |-|Naginata= {{Items |Name=Naginata |Image Item=NaginataStillPreview2.png |Image Held=NaginataStillPreview.png |Damage=14 (4 + 5 + 5) for M1 set
8 (4 + 4) for front dash
4 for stab, 4 for slam (special) |Cooldown=12s (special) |Durability=Infinite |Description=The item alters several of the user's attributes: *Basic attacks are limited to 3 M1s instead of the usual 4. *Landing a front dash triggers a secondary attack, consisting of an unblockable slice that cannot bypass ragdoll. *When activating the special, the user will stab the ground before them to lift themselves off the ground, spinning 55 studs forwards to wind up a sudden slam that crushes everything in a 10 stud radius. **Unlike the slam, the stab is unblockable, and will pierce whoever stands before the user to carry them along and confirm the slam. *Only drops when ragdolled. |Trivia=Based off of a cursed tool used by {{Jjk|Maki Zenin}} in ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. *Can be obtained using the rainbow seal variant of {{Register}}’s Pole Vault. }} |-|Bowling Ball= {{Items |Name=Bowling Ball |Image Held=BowlingBallStillPreview.png |Damage=20 |Durability=One-time use |Description=Initiating a basic attack will roll the bowling ball forwards. *The item will travel 200 studs in the direction it was aimed at, destroying walls in its way and bypassing both block and ragdoll. *Any target in the way will get ragdolled upwards, causing the ball to change course towards another target if one is near. *Disables running and the use of skills while held. |Trivia=Can be found in Shenanigan Ball's Bowling Alley, being called an "imed ball". *The bowling ball's texture can be either that of a watermelon, a golf ball, a soccer ball, a gubby or imed. *Can be obtained using the rainbow seal variant of {{Register}}’s Piano Drop. }} |-|Crowbar= {{Items |Name=Crowbar |Image Held=CrowbarStillPreview.png |Cooldown=4s |Damage=10 |Durability=Infinite |Description=Initiating a basic attack will wind up an unblockable swing with the item. *Any target hit by the swing will get grounded with true ragdoll. After getting up, they will lose the ability to run and jump for 10 seconds. **If the target was blocking, then they will additionally be inflicted with a Bleed stack. This is able to progress into Hemorrhage, although the effect will be lifted after the target removes the Bleed stack. *Only drops when ragdolled. |Trivia=Based off of the crowbar used by Billy Butcher, in ''The Boys''. *Can be obtained using the rainbow seal variant of {{Register}}’s Gushing Wound. }} |-|Broom= {{Items |Name=Broom |Image Item=BroomStillPreview2.png |Image Held=BroomStillPreview.png |Durability=Infinite |Description=Initiating a basic attack will cause the player to sit on the item, gaining the ability to fly. *While riding the broom, a meter will appear the user's right, indicating how much power the item has before it forcibly dismounts the user. **The meter will last for a maximum of 8 seconds, and will recharge whenever the broom is not ridden. Keep in mind that the item's power will always be as long as the time it took to recharge. |Trivia=Based off of {{Jjk|Momo Nishimiya}}'s cursed technique, "Tool Manipulation", in ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. *Used to be obtainable in public servers during the 2025 Halloween Event for 15 candy, and currently is for the 2026 Halloween Event. }} |-|Flashlight= {{Items |Name=Flashlight |Image Item=JJSFlashlight.png |Durability=Infinite |Description=Initiating a basic attack will turn on the item, lighting the way forwards. *Initiating another basic attack will toggle the item off. *Pressing the special will drop the item. *Disables the use of skills while held. }} |-|Tiantui Star's Blade= {{Items |Name=Tiantui Star's Blade |Image Held=TiantuiStarsBladeStillPreview.png |Damage=10 per hit, 20 when reloaded |Durability=Infinite |Description=Limits the basic attack string to 3 M1s, but with forward lunges ending with a swing. *Only the final lunge is able to bypass ragdoll, and while each hit is unblockable, they can all parry melee attacks, leaving the target unaffected as a result. *Using the special will reload the item with 6 bullets, each bullet doubling the next hit's damage. **An indicator will lie under the user, showing how many bullets the blade currently holds. *Only drops when ragdolled. |Trivia=Based off the weapon used by Lei Heng in Limbus Company. *Plays Lei Heng's [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X70m65dSM7g Limbus Company theme] when held. *Using the special while the item is already fully reloaded will cause an overlay to cover the user's screen. This also happens when the item is dropped and picked up again. }} |-|Tiansha Star's Blade= {{Items |Name=Tiansha Star's Blade |Image Held=TianshaStarsBladeStillPreview.png |Damage=10 per hit, 20 when reloaded |Durability=Infinite |Description=The item alters several of the user's attributes: *The basic attack string is limited to 3 hits instead of 4, which each M1 triggering a lunging slash. **Each M1 is perfect-blockable but can parry melee attacks, leaving the target unaffected. *Front dashing will start a quick lunge backed up by a succession of slashes. *Blocking is also replaced, as it will initiate two delayed swings, followed with a short barrage of slashes. *The special will trigger a long sequence consisting of multiple horizontal slashes, before the final vertical cut. *The item has an effect on both the user and target it lands on: **Each slash landed on a target will take away a word from their username. If their username loses all of its letters, they will be erased and kicked out of the server. **Every attack done by the user will take away a letter from their moveset. If a skill loses all of its letters, it will be taken away from the moveset. ***After using up all their skills, the item will move on to the user's Awakening Bar. Once every letter has been expended, the next use of the item will stun the user in place, give them total i-frames, and force them to throw out countless slashes in a circle around them for an infinite amount of time. |Trivia=Based on the Ōdachi that Ryōshū uses in ''Limbus Company''. *Plays [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b8fKDXWH-kI the Canto IX 10th Boss Theme] when obtained, and does a clash sound from Limbus Company after each parry. **Also plays [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h0djuhl97Kw SAIKAI by Mili] once the user's Awakening Bar loses all of its letters. *Used to be called "Arayashiki" before {{Update|1.82}}. }} |-|C4= {{Items |Name=C4 |Image Item=C4.png |Image Held=C4Held.png |Image Used=C4Detonate.gif |Damage=35 (on the ground), 10 (on player) |Durability=11 rounds |Description=Picking up the initial C4 detonator, the wielder can place up to 11 C4s almost anywhere, including players. |Trivia=Each detonation gives about 3.45% awakening bar, meaning it takes around 29 C4 detonation to get full awakening from them. }} |-|RPG= {{Items |Name=RPG |Image Item=RPG.png |Image Held=RPGHeld.png |Image Used=RPGUsed.gif |Damage=15 |Durability=1 round |Description=Picking up the RPG gives the holder one round of a aimable rocket. |Trivia= }}

Star Rage.text:
[[Category:Characters]][[Category:Base Only Characters]] {{DISPLAYTITLE:'''Star Rage'''}} {{Character2 |title1={{Star Rage}} |cost=Free |awakening='''Unrestricted Density''' |special='''Mass Buildup''' |hp=100 |image1=Mrsbassdada.png |previous={{Locust Guy}} |next = {{Aspiring Mangaka}} }} {{Quote|What kind of woman is your type?|Yuki Tsukumo ({{Star Rage}}) to Aoi Todo ({{Switcher}}) }} ==Description== Star Rage is the 12th [[Characters|character]] and 2nd [[Characters#Base Only|base-only]] that was added to ''Jujutsu Shenanigans''. ===Origin=== {{Origin |Star Rage is based off of {{Jjk|Yuki Tsukumo}}, a character from ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. |{{Jjk|Yuki Tsukumo}} is a supporting character from ''Jujutsu Kaisen'' and a special grade sorcerer who mentored {{Jjk|Aoi Todo}}. She can add virtual mass to herself or her shikigami Garuda to increase the lethality of her attacks without affecting herself (below a certain limit) using her Star Rage technique, hence the title: "Star Rage". }} ==Moves== |-|Base= {{Ability |Name='''Garuda''' |Type=COSMETIC |Type Color=mediumpurple |Description=The user possesses an animated serpentine shikigami, Garuda, that will keep floating around them and aid them in their offense during Garuda Rebound and Garuda Stab. |Stat 1=EFFECT |Stat 1 Value=Grants a shikigami cosmetic that orbits around the user |Image=GarudaCosmetic.gif}} {{Ability |Type=SPECIAL |Type Color=orange |Name='''Mass Buildup''' |Description=When '''held''', the user will convert their cursed energy into virtual mass to fill up a "Mass" bar to their right. 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=15s |Image=MassBreakerFinisher.gif}} ==Pros & Cons== {{ProsCons |pros= *Versatile ranged moveset with constant and quick pressure tools, characterised by its strong neutral control and evasive bait. *Allows for a variety of mixups and techs by using Garuda's slowed return in tandem with other moves. *Has the highest damage unescapable combo in the entire game due to having true ragdoll moves, an M1 reset tech, and a high damage combo ender. *One-shot AoE Awakening move, always guaranteeing a kill when activated. |cons= *Lacks a full Awakening, instead having a last ditch attack with several conditions. *Many moves have notable endlag while others have long telegraphed windups, giving the target an opportunity to punish you. *While accessing Mass variants requires a lot of Awakening, most of the variants themselves don't really grant any, which makes Mass Buildup require several engagements to be useful. *Garuda Rebound's second hit is susceptible to counters or parries, setting the user up for combos instead. *On top of being counterable, Unrestricted Density's grab will still consume the entire Awakening Bar despite not activating the black hole. }} ==Combos== {{Combo |sequence1=---- |damage1='''''This character Combos are currently being reworked.
Please don't add any combos whatsoever.''''' |notes1=---- }} ==Tips & Misc== ===Tips=== *Garuda Rebound's variant is a very effective combo extender for other moves due to its long range and ragdoll trajectory, while also allowing you to use a move without it going on cooldown. **It can also be "parried" by blocking when it's about to land, causing it to get deflected back to the user who can also re-parry it back as well. *Mass Breaker doesn't lose momentum when used from ledges and can hit enemies midair, meaning it can combo off of Garuda Rebound or Rising Rage if you are able to aim properly. This is a great way to bypass its long startup, as it can be easily countered if used out of 3 M1s. *It's very easy for Star Rage to bypass neutral play with the slowed down version of Garuda Rebound, being able to threaten a full combo as you approach the enemy. *When attempting to grab someone for Unrestricted Density, the user is susceptible to counters. This is because the grab itself counts as a melee attack, and will trigger all in game counters along with any finishers they have. **Due to this, a few counters can negate this Awakening, such as Head Splitter as it ends up beheading you. Others will just knock you very far. *When missing Garuda Rebound's mass charged hit, Garuda will ricochet on walls until it hits the target. It can stop if it reaches its maximum travel distance before contact with a wall though. Nonetheless, being in an area with tight spaces like a building or the station's train tracks can almost confirm the hit no matter what. **Garuda can also ricochet after the finisher is landed, as it completely goes through the target. *Unrestricted Density can still be used despite being decapitated, burned, or flat out disintegrated. The only exception is being sliced into pieces by finisher from moves such as Dismantle or Garuda Rebound. **In cases where the user loses their right arm (typically from a Supernova or Cheap Shot finisher), the arm can still attach to an opponent, but the body will remain on the floor and turn into a black hole, which allows the grabbed opponent to escape from its range. *As Unrestricted Density's black hole counts as a domain attack, it can be survived through various ways: domains (either Idle Death Gamble or Deadly Sentencing), swapping with others, or ragdolling the grabbed target away from you, but these can only be done before the black hole fully forms, since specials, moves and M1s are all disabled once it becomes active. **For example, Foresight's damage will be nullified if a black hole is in range, despite its cutscene showing the attacker getting impaled. ===Techs=== |-|Beginner= ===='''Wakeup Stab'''==== Timing Garuda Stab with the enemy's wakeup from ragdoll will result in a successful hit as the opponent does not have the time to counter this attack. ===='''Rising Rage Extend'''==== It's possible to extend into Garuda Stab on wakeup after rising rage if you hold forwards and delay your side dash, albeit with a rather tight timing. Is not true against counters but it is mostly guaranteed otherwise. |-|Intermediate= ===='''Extended Rage'''==== After the uppercut of Rising Rage, you can use Mass Breaker's variant and aim at the airborne enemy to connect the blow, use Garuda Rebound to juggle the opponent in the air, or time their fall with Garuda Stab. This might require some practice for you to get the correct timing for it and is unachievable if the target uses their evasive. ===='''Rebound Extend'''==== As the target gets launched towards you by Garuda Rebound's variant, you can land almost any other move in your kit while they're airborne. Keep in mind that this needs timing and positioning. ===='''CURSE'''==== CURSE (Cool Upper Rebound Stab Extend) is a way to land Garuda Stab after Garuda Rebound's 2nd usage semi-consistently. Land an uppercut and use Garuda Rebound once, hitting the victim as they fall. Walk backwards while using it the 1st time and stop walking after using it again. Use Garuda Stab as they fly towards you. Doesn't work with Garuda Stab's mass variant and requires movement space. ===='''Ping-Pong'''==== If your opponent parries your Garuda Rebound's second use, you can parry it back by timing your block. If they adapt, hit it back again. This also works with Garuda Rebound's charged variant. |-|Advanced= ===='''Garuda Reset'''==== Using Garuda Rebound's variant during a move's execution will cause said move to get canceled. If the canceled move was either Rising Rage or Mass breaker, their cooldown will be reset. This essentially allows you to use a move twice and can be achieved by slowing down Garuda's return after throwing him the first time. Doing this with Rising Rage proves to be consistent as the move has a slow execution, and canceling its double charged variant before the final kick allows you to M1 reset off of the third (if you miss Garuda Rebound's variant). ===='''Garuda Rage'''==== Cancelling Rising Rage's 2nd mass variant after it's third kick has the target stunned for around 1.5 seconds, allowing you to dash and get an m1 reset, or land any other moves. This also allows for you to charge your bar to max safely without worrying about it being cancelled. ==Trivia== *{{Star Rage}} is the first finished character to have no special, as it was added in {{Update|1.61}}, along with an Unrestricted Density rework. **It is the 4th character to have a move with self-inflicted damage (other 3 being {{Honored One}}, {{Ten Shadows}}, and {{Blood Manipulator}}) **The old awakening, before the Unrestricted Density rework, could be activated at will without needing the requirement of it's user to die. *{{Star Rage}} was the first to be based on a female ''Jujutsu Kaisen'' character. **It's also the third character to utilize shikigami, right after {{Ten Shadows}} and {{Defense Attorney}}. *Garuda Rebound's variant has negative knockback as setting the Knockback Multiplier to a negative number in the PS+ settings, most moves will attract the target towards you, but the second hit actually starts pushing them away. *At random, Garuda Rebound's mass charged kick will play a voiceline of Isagi Yoichi from ''Blue Lock'' saying "MOVE IT." **Its finisher uses the flash and sound effect of a parry from ''ULTRAKILL,'' just before the impact. *The music that plays during Unrestricted Density is called '''[https://youtu.be/mDZb4Fs6G4E?t=187 Your Battle Is My Battle]''', a song from the first season of ''Jujutsu Kaisen's anime'', composed by '''Hiroaki Tsutsumi''' and voiced by '''Chica'''. **Initiating Unrestricted Density's grab will play Hunter's scream from ''Left 4 Dead 2''. *{{Star Rage}}'s 2026 April Fools name (bass da da da) is based off the song [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=urcYI48g5_w Bass da da da]. **The name was chosen due to the edits surfacing around platforms, using the song in tandem with clips of nsnlxd's [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G3r-nC-F6es Yuki Tsukomo & Choso vs. Kenjaku] video. This eventually devolved into edits based around "the best jumper" or "generating electricity in japan", causing her to be called '''bass da da da''' in "larp culture." *The art for "Pass On" during the Unlicensed Rhythm Game shows {{Star Rage}} conversing with {{Blood Manipulator}}, taking the place of Outis from Limbus Company. ==Gallery== File:YUKIOH.jpeg|Yuki Tsukumo, the inspiration for Star Rage. |Image=AbsoluteDestructionFinisher.gif}} {{Background|Mechamaru's background.png}} ==Pros & Cons== {{ProsCons|pros= *Strong neutral due to Heat Emission (both offload and normal variants), offload Ultra Spin, and pressure via puppet barrage. *Hard to punish due to his offload variants being safe on whiff upon block or counters, especially since they are ranged. *Heavy tank of an Awakening due to the increased stats and super armor, along with the healing it gives (upon activation and once more at the end of the awakening, on top of being able to revive with full HP upon death while awakened). *High mobility whilst in Awakening allows you to juke out moves with longer side dashes and a jump that allows you to leap over horizontal hitboxes, such as grounded Hollow Purple and Open. *Awakening can last up to 180s, 3 times the length of most other awakenings. |cons= *Much lower HP (85) than other characters (100). *Due to how offload puppets interact with debris, combos can be really inconsistent with destruction on. *Absolute is hard to reach due to the requirement of filling up the energy reserves to stay active for longer which are lost on death, along with Übercharge using up awakening. *Absolute's effectiveness often relies on you filling your energy reserves up to at least 125-150%, which means if you end up needing to quickly activate it to get out of a bad situation without proper setup, at most you will be able to get a couple M1 strings off before it runs out. *Absolute has long spawn animation, making it easy to run, cast domains or heavy attacks during it. }} ==Combos== |-|Base= {{Combo |sequence1=M1 x3 + 2 + R + R + Backwards Dash + R + 4 + 3 (Full hold variant) |damage1=66.15 |notes1=This combo requires at least 30% awakening meter |sequence2= 3 M1 and R at the same time + R and uppercut + 2 + R + 4 + 1 + 3 (full hold) + R + 4 + Downslam |damage2=103.65 |notes2=It's possible to add another 2 (Boost On) after the downslam if you stall enough, adding another 10 damage |sequence3=M1x3 + 1 + R1 + 2 + R4 + 3 (full hold) |damage3=74.15 (i think) |notes3=Offload 4 may be unreliable in places with debris, to mitigate this use it while still airborne }} |-|Awakening= {{Combo |sequence1=---- |damage1='''''This character Combos are currently being reworked.
Please don't add any combos whatsoever.''''' |notes1=---- }} ==Tips & Techs== ===Tips=== *Take note that all Offload variants cannot get you punished if countered or blocked. The cursed corpses will instead be the ones taking the hit. **This is useful if the opponent possesses a precious counter such as Foresight or Head Splitter, and means that you can go in with no fear. *If you have 15 Offload puppets charging up Ultra Cannons in one spot, all of their blasts can deal enough combined damage to kill someone in an instant. In other words, you can execute someone with an Ultra Cannon firing squad if you have enough preparation time. **Note that Ultra Cannon's puppets will automatically shoot if you die. *When Mode Absolute ends, the player's Max HP gets set to 100 rather than 85, likely due to a bug as this does not happen when dying while awakened. *Pigeon Viola's tracking is flawed as its bullets take a long path to get to the target, and may collide with debris that will cause them to disappear. It's best to use Technique Charge as it has better accuracy when fully locked on. *Technique Charge's Simple Domain isn't able to shatter all domain expansion borders, as Deadly Sentencing's invulnerability prohibits the blast from landing, while Incomplete Shrine has no border to shatter. *Ultra Spin's ragdoll time allows for an easy downslam while they're floored, but be aware of the target's ragdoll cancel. *Aside from offensive and mixup purposes, the Puppets have many more defensive purposes as well and can act as shields or sacrifices against troublesome attacks. ===Techs=== |-|Beginner= ===={{WdsTooltips |toggle = {{{basic-tooltip|'''Fried to Perfection / Chucked into the Woodchipper'''}}} |content = [[File:OffloadCatch.gif|frameless|240x240]]}}==== After using an Offload / Ubercharge Heat Emission, you can extend / end your combo by holding Ultra Cannon while they’re still in the air with the puppet, letting you catch them with the big beam before they hit the ground. You can also use Ultra Drill to catch them when they bounce up from the ground. Two tips relating to this tech: *Relating to Ultra Cannon. Because your puppet will throw the unfortunate victim onto the ground right in front of you regardless of where you stand, it is best to have distance between the airborne puppet and you to avoid the victim landing behind you, which essentially makes you whiff your Ultra Cannon *The best time to start charging your Ultra Cannon is when the puppet starts making the spinning / whirling sound in the air before they drop it onto you. Note that this tech is extremely punishable if it is whiffed. ===={{WdsTooltips |toggle = {{{basic-tooltip|'''Sundering Spin'''}}} |content = [[File:Spinabout.gif|frameless|240x240]]}}==== You can use the dash part of Ultra Spin to spin around someone's block in order hit them in the back and break through their block. ===={{WdsTooltips |toggle = {{{basic-tooltip|'''Blow Dry'''}}} |content = [[File:Cannon_Cut.gif|frameless|240x240]]}}==== If you immediately start charging up your Ultra Cannon right after uppercutting someone, the knockback caused by transitioning from Ultra Cannon to Ultimate Cannon will keep the person ragdolled for long enough to land the move. The same notion applies to Ultra Cannon; if you catch someone in Offload / Ubercharge Ultra Spin, Ultra Cannon can be held to catch them after they get uppercutted by the Ultra Spin. |-|Intermediate= ===={{WdsTooltips |toggle = {{{basic-tooltip|'''Human Shield'''}}} |content = [[File:PuppetCounter.gif|frameless|240x240]]}}==== Using any form of your Offload variants, you can counter grab moves by having the puppet get hit instead, or you can get out of stun with the puppet's explosion. ===='''Emission-Cut'''==== After using Offload / Ubercharge Heat Emission, you can uppercut the enemy while they're thrown at you. This uppercut won't give the enemy any extra evasive, and allows for longer stun time and extra damage ===='''Meat Grinder'''==== As soon as the keybind for Ultra Spin is used, activate an Offload / Ubercharge Ultra Spin heading the other direction towards your opponent to guarantee a hit on them, even if they are blocking. This can be used as a surprise combo starter, as well as an effective way to finish off an opponent. Note that this tech does not work against counters, and stops working as soon as your opponent changes direction or moves out of your way. Usually they won’t and will instinctively try to block. ===='''Skewered'''==== When using Ultra Spin, right before the sawing sound of Ultra Spin ends, it is possible to release an Offload / Ubercharge Ultra Spin in the other direction, allowing you to Ultra Drill your opponent again and do slightly less than double the damage with a single move. It’s not that punishable compared to some other techs. Practice is necessary when perfecting the timing. Note: People can still evade out of the combo after the first Ultra Drill. ===='''Rapid Offload'''==== If you use Offload and wait a couple of seconds, offload will get off cooldown and you will have around 5.4 seconds to do two Offload move variance, you can additionally use Übercharge to do a third move variance but putting that move on cooldown. Note: Slightly hard to do in a fight. |-|Advanced= ===='''Emission Surf'''==== After using the Offload variant of Heat Emission, you can jump on it's head and have it carry you with it; allowing for greater mobility. This tech is very ping-based, so trying to do this might take a couple of tries. ===='''Yanked Off the Rotisserie'''==== After using the Offload variant of Ultra Spin, you can slowly M1 3 times during the puppet's animation, and time an uppercut while the target is falling back down. This does not add extra evasive, and can be a free 4 damage before a non-offload ultraspin, or combo directly into a charged Ultra Cannon, among other things. Ping dependant, but uppercut window scales with ping to an extent. ===='''Uberstacking'''==== Waiting for Ubercharge windup allows a second Offload variant of any move to be used with Offload on cooldown, if done quickly. The setup is: R > Wait for Ubercharge windup > Move > R > Move. ===='''Marionette's Guard'''==== The puppets can be used as shields from attacks like Open, Mass Breaker, and more. They can also help you win M1 trades in many ways as well. You can use Offload Ultra Cannon's puppet before initiating an M1 trade. When you block, the puppet will fire during your opponent's turn in attacking, effectively attacking while blocking. Might even force them to go defensive and let you put more pressure on them. ==Trivia== *While the character is called Puppet Master, the character is actually the puppet itself (Mechamaru). The player plays as the puppet, and during Absolute the puppet pilots Ultimate Mechamaru, coming out after the mech is defeated or the timer runs out. **This is a reference to Kokichi Muta piloting Ultimate Mechamaru from the inside right at the end of his fight with Mahito. *Offload's cursed corpses will use the Awakening avatar selected from the [[Awakening Outfits]] gamepass, as Absolute will always use the same mech avatar. Not equipping an Awakening outfit instead uses the avatar you currently have equipped in-game. *The art during Unlicensed Rhythm Game's "Pass On" shows {{Puppet Master}} taking the place of Ishmael from Limbus Company, next to {{Switcher}} yawning in the front seat. ==Gallery== File:Muta.png|Kokichi Muta, the inspiration for Puppet Master. Note that Awakening drain is halted during the full move.

The punch cannot kill, but if the target is marked by Ratio, their left leg will be staggered 7 seconds, and they won't be able to evade out of the hit if they were at critical health. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=4 for grab, 10 for punch |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=20s |Image=Interrogate.gif}} {{Ability |Name='''Interrogate''' |Blockable=y |Bullet Armor=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Melee=y |Description=Right after the punch, the user will begins pursuing their target at full speed. This finisher bypasses {{Lucky Coward}}'s Miracles entirely. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=Insta-kill |Stat 2=DAMAGE |Stat 2 Value=20s |Image=InterrogateFinisher.gif}} {{Ability |Type=USE AGAIN VARIANT |Type Color=red |Name='''Collapse''' |Unblockable=y |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Explosion=y |Description=The target's body cannot handle the crushing weight of the debris, as it also collapses into pieces and [https://library-of-ruina.fandom.com/wiki/Kali '''red mist''']. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=Insta-kill |Stat 2=DAMAGE |Stat 2 Value=22s |Image=CollapseFinisher.gif}} {{Background|NanamiBG.png}} ==Pros & Cons== {{ProsCons |pros= *Base moveset with slightly low cooldowns and short strong combos. *A ratio stagger gives a clear advantage in M1 trades by limiting the enemy's aggressiveness if it was on their leg, and/or making it harder for them to play passively if it was on their arm. *Reverse Kick and Stabilize act as a decent neutral tools, and delaying the back kick in combos to M1 reset is both safe and rewarding if the target has no counter. *Can combo into Awakening, which grants easy access to a one shot move. |cons= *Ratio Point is not entirely timing based, and due to its visible/audible cues, targets can avoid contact until it ends. *Staggering an enemy will only happen if they are able to act, in which case they are also able to dash away or counter. *Possesses some punish windows such as after a Blunt Cut or Cross Cut. *Ratio Breaker's final stage is not as easy to access, and the opponent could already be dead before reaching it. *Interrogate's first hit knockback makes the follow-up dash impossible to land without a wall. }} ==Combos== |-|Base= {{Combo |sequence1=---- |damage1='''''This character Combos are currently being reworked.
Please don't add any combos whatsoever.''''' |notes1=---- }} |-|Awakening= {{Combo |sequence1=---- |damage1='''''This character Combos are currently being reworked.
Please don't add any combos whatsoever.''''' |notes1=---- }} ==Tips & Techs== ===Tips=== *While several moves do feel like they're usable in neutral, they are somewhat risky to throw out. It's best to rely on limb stagger by doing M1 trades instead of constantly throwing out moves. *Stabilize's stun isn't normally long enough to follow up with attacks, but it is long enough to mark the enemy with Ratio Point. This makes the followup unavoidable if the enemy has no counter in hand. *Ratio is extremely effective against passive enemies. The best approach against these players is to focus on landing as many debuffs as possible, preferably the leg-stagger, as they cannot front or sidedash to punish moves anymore. *If the enemy is close enough to a throwable, Severance Kick will weaponize the item while tossing the enemy to it at the same time, dealing much more damage. *Interrogate's first punch knocks the target too far for its follow up to land. It's advised to only use it when near obstacles to mitigate the knockback. *While at a certain distance from a domain border, Collapse's dive can be used to glitch within. **Additionally both Collapse's debris and Erosion's Ratio variant can deal critical damage to domains. *Ratio Breaker III and Collapse will not travel their full distance if the user hits a roof. This allows them to combo properly in exchange for mobility. ===Techs=== |-|Beginner= ===={{WdsTooltips |toggle = {{{basic-tooltip|'''Mid-Punch Ratio'''}}} |content = [[File:SalarymanTech-RatioM1s.gif|frameless|240x240px]]}}==== If you are trying to perform the Special M1 variant, activate Ratio Point as soon as you begin your M1 string. You'll only have to focus on hitting Ratio Point correctly since you can hold the M1 button down while timing, which is quite easy. This tech is harder to do on mobile. |-|Intermediate= ===='''Stabilizing Dive'''==== Use the Uppercut Surf tech to be mid-air with the opponent after an uppercut, then use Stabilize. As you're still mid-air, use Blunt Cut's aerial variant, which if done right will be red. |-|Advanced= ===='''Severance/Reverse Sliding'''==== If you stand on an enemy and use Severance kick/Reverse kick, you can slide along with the enemy making a red extender. ==Trivia== *Overtime stands for the binding vow that Kento Nanami placed on himself, that restricts his cursed energy to 80% - 90% during work hours, in exchange for boosting it to 110% - 120% while working on overtime hours. **Similarly to {{Cursed Partners}}, this binding vow makes up the character's awakening, and is also one of the binding vows included in [[Gamemodes#Casual Duels|Casual Duels]]. *{{Salaryman}}'s awakening music is '''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cmk6csJvfIc We Are Stop The Attack]''' by '''Yoshimasa Terui''', taken from the ''Jujutsu Kaisen 0'' movie. **Additionally, the music is dynamic, changing stages according to the last variant of Ratio Breaker landed. Nonetheless, the music will loop indefinitely. **This also means that {{Salaryman}} is the third character to have music while awakened, with the first being {{Restless Gambler}}, and the second being {{Switcher}}. *Wall of Stone is a reference to when Kento Nanami was unfazed by Haruta Shigemo's slash and kick in ''Jujutsu Kaisen Season 2's Shibuya Incident'', while Interrogate, alongside its finisher interaction with {{Lucky Coward}}, is a reference to the beating that ensued right after. **Similarly, Ratio Breaker is a direct nod to the quad Black Flash chain that Nanami lands in ''Jujutsu Kaisen 0's Night Parade of 100 Demons''. *{{Salaryman}}'s [[Events#April Fools 2026 Event|2026 April Fools Name]] (enjoys beating the life out of) is based off of AniDiscourse's [https://www.youtube.com/shorts/5lOJXY3MwE8 "Terrorist Nanami"] short. **These origins are shared with {{Lucky Coward}} (kind scholar), {{Defense Attorney}} (greedy lawyer), {{Switcher}} (menace to society), {{Blood Manipulator}} (loving and caring brother), {{Perfection}} (purifier), and {{Disaster Plants}} (peaceful gardener). *The art during Unlicensed Rhythm Game's "Pass On" shows {{Salaryman}} taking the place of Faust from Limbus Company, next to {{Defense Attorney}}. *{{Salaryman}} is the fifth character to have an Awakening variant, right after {{Aspiring Mangaka}}, {{Honored One}}, {{Black Death}}, and {{True Cannon}}. ==Gallery== File:AnimeNanami.png|Kento Nanami, the inspiration for Salaryman.
