'''''Most of {{Strongest Of History}}'s finishers are the exact same as {{Vessel}}'s Awakening finishers, apart from Disgraced Sovereign, Dismantle Net, and Cleave Rush which sever all of the target's limbs.'''''
 ==Pros & Cons== {{ProsCons|pros= *Base moveset on par with or even superior to most Awakenings, composed of several AOE moves, a one-shot attack, and 4 overpowered variants (2 of which are also one-shot AOE moves), annihilating any player daring to meet your sight in seconds. *Excels at crowd control with Strong Dismantle, Kamutoke and Open FURNACE that can also be used if you want to play Zoner. *Greatly increased health and walk speed. *Strongest domain expansion in the game, having the longest range ever and being immune to outside attacks due to the lack of a border. *Very low cooldowns, allowing you to rely on moves more than M1s, and combo without needing to worry about ragdoll cancel or counters (most of the time). *Can accumulate Awakening easily by landing Cleave Rush. |cons= *Character limited to the FSD gamemode (and Private Servers), meaning you'll be facing countless players that know your current location, HP and Awakening Bar progress, along with each player having 3 lives, and you possessing only one. *Each chant requires a portion of your Awakening Bar to use, and you lose out on an actual Awakening due to it being replaced with a domain expansion. *Long windup on some moves. *2 out of 3 one-shot moves require you to use your special, which takes away a bit of your Awakening Bar, and upon utilizing the moves, you won't get any awakening meter. }} ==Tips & Techs== ===Tips=== *In FSD, you have to be cautious around characters like {{Honored One}} or {{Ten Shadows}}, as they can easily pull you into the horde of players and cancel your moves from afar, {{True Cannon}} will snipe you with granite blast and kill you if you don't focus, use a range attack out of the range from granite blast and knock them away (you can also do a 1 chant Strong Dismantle into Open Furnace if you want to make sure they won't get to you). Make sure to prioritise them over others such as {{Vessel}} or {{Switcher}}, who aren't as much of a threat when further. *While you have higher health than normal in FSD, you still have one life, and like the Sorcerers team, you can't regenerate lost health over time even with evasives. *Chants are cancellable, but you can walk or possibly M1 during them, so it's best if you camp a zone while using your AOE moves to slow down the progression of enemies in FSD, then take care of them using a Strong Dismantle variant or a Dismantle Net. *Evasive or ragdoll cancel should always be followed by an immediate Kamutoke to blast away all nearby opponents and give yourself a breather, as you can easily get spun back into a combo despite using ragdoll cancel properly. *Cleave Rush can be both used as an offensive attack and a defensive maneuver, as the distance traveled is very significant and allows you to break away from the pack. *Preparation is required to use World Cutting Slash, Dismantle Net, Incomplete Shrine or Open FURNACE, as they can be easily canceled and take a while for you to be able to use them again. Make sure you're a fair distance away (using Dismantle Barrage or Kamutoke) and that any ranged enemies are out of reach. *You shouldn't go easy on the remaining players if only few are left, as this means that you're less likely to gain evasive and more likely to fall for long combos. ===Techs=== |-|Beginner= ===='''Blast Away'''==== When you're surrounding by opponents, use Kamutoke to blast them away to give yourself breathing room. This can be used after activating burst, or even preemptively to prevent them from rushing you down. |-|Intermediate= ===='''Cleave Retreat'''==== You can make a tactical retreat with Cleave Rush by deliberately missing the grab, creating distance from opponents and allowing you to perform attacks from afar, such as Open FURNACE or a World Cutting Slash. |-|Advanced= ===='''Furnace Catch'''==== You can take advantage of Open FURNACE's knockback by catching an opponent as they fall with Cleave Rush, but requires precise timing. ==Trivia== *{{Strongest Of History}} is the only character that doesn't have M1 animations in {{Skill Builder}}, as they are the same as {{Vessel}}'s. *When Incomplete Shrine is cast, it will also target all other active domains in its destruction range, immediately destroying them. *In [[Private Servers]], you can become {{Strongest Of History}} only if the "Overpowered" setting is activated. **If a player was previously using this character, and spawns in a server with the "Overpowered" setting turned off, they will automatically be changed to {{Honored One}}. **This also applies if you reset after the "Overpowered" setting turns off. *While Incomplete Shrine seems to have limited range, you'll notice that you still get harmed, even outside the domain's destruction range. **Respawning (using the PS+ command) right as you're casting the domain will prohibit its use for the remainder of the private server's activity. *Strongest Of History's HP scales with the amount of active players facing off against him in the FSD gamemode, but will not regenerate at all even from evasives. However if used in a private server, the user's Max HP will be 100. *"Heian" is the 2nd title given to {{Strongest Of History}}, and could've been seen on the game's Roblox title before {{V|1.49}}. *Once Incomplete Shrine is cast, a long soundtrack named "'''[https://youtu.be/7Y3sIvGGUPE?t=94 Thunderclap]'''" by '''Yoshimasa Terui''' plays while it is active (along a maniacal laugh, likely the caster's). *{{Strongest Of History}} is technically the first [[Characters#Base Only|base-only]] character. ==Gallery== File:Trueheian.png|The inspiration for the Strongest Of History. File:SOH SIZE COMPORAZTION.png|Strongest of History's size in comparison to a dummy. File:Old Sukuna chants.gif|Old "'''Think Fast'''" incantation. (Reworked) File:JJS & JSD Strongest of History boss.png|Strongest Of History's appearance in Jump Showdown. ==History== To read about all of the character's changes, expand the collapsible below.
*'''[+]''' : Buff or late addition (after release.) *'''[-]''' : Nerf. *'''[/]''' : Bug fix, miscellanous change.. (does not affect combat in a major way.) {|class="fandom-table" !Update !Additions/Changes/Fixes |- |{{V|1.76}} | *[/] Incomplete Shrine creates smaller debris, and no longer creates any when far enough. |- |{{V|1.68}} | *[-] Decreased the health scaling in Roulette. |- |{{V|1.60}} | *[+] Added a new variant to Cleave Rush. *[+] Increased the speed and range of Disgraced Sovereign. *[-] Halved the damage of Disgraced Sovereign's first wave. (unmentioned) *[/] Added a voiceline to Open FURNACE, Strong Dismantle's special variants, and Dismantle Net. (unmentioned) *[/] Fixed moving during Cleave Rush. |- |{{V|1.58}} | *[+] World Cutting Slash and Dismantle Net are no longer counterable. *[+] Increased the startup speed of Cleave Rush. *[/] Remade the intro for Incomplete Shrine, reduced the amount of debris created by it, and disabled it when it is already active. *[/] Fixed Incomplete Shrine not abiding to the Physics Heavy VFX setting. |- |{{V|1.57.1}} | *[/] Fixed the extra arms not being animated when chanting. |- |{{V|1.57}} | *[-] Max HP now scales with in-game active players in Roulette. |- |{{V|1.49}} | *[/] Fixed flying when grabbed by an emote or move. |- |{{V|1.46}} | *[-] Increased the cooldown of Open FURNACE from 3s to 12s. *[/] Max HP now scales with the amount of players in Roulette. *[/] Released to the public as an Overpowered character. *[/] Reduced the amount of debris for Incomplete Shrine. *[/] Fixed blocking Incomplete Shrine giving Awakening progress. |- |{{V|1.45}} | *[/] Added as a Roulette Exclusive. *[/] Added 4 base moves: Strong Dismantle, Open FURNACE, Cleave Rush, Kamutoke. *[/] Added an Awakening: Incomplete Shrine. *[/] Added a special: Incantation. |}

Super Tze.|- Tze teasing his next form.}} ==Description== Super TZE is the very first [[:Category:Developer Only Characters|developer-only]] character that was added to ''Jujutsu Shenanigans'', as it can currently only be accessed by tze or people who ask to use it directly. ===Origin=== {{Origin |Super Tze is based off of ''[https://sonic.fandom.com/wiki/ Sonic The Hedgehog]''. |Spoilers=SONIC THE HEDGEHOG |Super TZE is a form that was inspired by the Super Sonic form from the ''[https://sonic.fandom.com/wiki/ Sonic The Hedgehog]'' series. When the 7 [https://sonic.fandom.com/wiki/Chaos_Emerald Chaos Emeralds] are collected, the user can absorb all of them once in order to evolve into a higher form. Sonic The Hedgehog was the first to do this in the series, transforming from his natural state to an ascended yellow "Super" form (thus the name: "Super TZE").}} ==Moves== {{Ability |Type=AWAKENING |Type Color=navy |Name='''Going Super''' |Description=Tze begins floating upwards while the seven Chaos Emeralds circle around him before he absorbs them, his hair becoming tainted with a golden yellow, as he emits a bright aura while leaving golden sparkles behind. |Stat 1=HEALING |Stat 1 Value=?? |Stat 2=DURATION |Stat 2 Value=?? |Image=Transformation.gif }} {{Ability |Type=PASSIVE |Type Color=purple |Name='''Sonic Boom''' |Interruptible=y |Description=Tze gains the ability to fly after transforming, allowing him to hover in the air and quickly move by dashing. When moving forwards, he will dive head first, moving faster than usual and occasionally glowing like a golden star while creating shockwaves around him from the sheer momentum. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=None |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=None |Image=SuperTzeFlight.gif }} {{Ability |Type=PASSIVE |Type Color=purple |Name='''Super Punch''' |Interruptible=y |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Description=Tze's basic melee attack combo has been replaced with a rapid lunge into any locked-on target with his fist wound up, followed up by a devastating strike that ragdolls them away. This has no endlag, infinite range, and can be repeated endlessly. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=?? |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=None |Image=SuperM1.gif }} {{Ability |Type=PASSIVE |Type Color=purple |Name='''Energy Volley''' |Bypasses Ragdoll=y |Description=By using his melee and dash at the same time, Tze will start rapidly firing a volley of bright yellow blasts that will home in on a target, before detonating on contact. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=?? |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=None |Image=SuperBlast.gif }} {{Ability |Type=SPECIAL |Type Color=orange |Name='''Lock-On''' |Description=In his Super form, Tze possesses a customized lock-on that allows him to select any target he wishes, even through walls. The selected target will be surrounded with a yellow circle that doesn't change size like console's lock-on, with an indicator in the middle pointing to the target at the center. This allows him to focus on individuals with his basic attack and energy volley. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=None |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=None |Image=SuperLockOn.gif }} ==Pros & Cons== {| class="borderless-fandom-table" !

Titles.text: {{DISPLAYTITLE:'''Titles'''}} ==What Are Titles?== Titles act as are cosmetic displays given to a handful of players to show off their status in the game. Some are only granted to in game staff, while others are earned by reaching the top of the Weekly/Highest Kills leaderboards lying near the center of the map. [[File:ModTitle.png|frameless|center|600px]] Once obtained, they can then be equipped from the inventory, on the Titles tab. [[File:Strongesttt.png|center|frameless|392x392px]] [[File:Divine.png|center|thumb|269x269px]] When a player equips a title, it will hover over their display name in brackets ("[]") and be visible for all players except the owner. The title will also precede the owner's username in the chat when sending a message. ==List Of Titles== {|class="fandom-table" !Category !Title !Requirement |- ! rowspan="9" |Kill Titles |THE STRONGEST OF HISTORY |Reach and maintain the top #1 spot on the Highest Kills Leaderboard |- |THE STRONGEST OF TODAY |Reach and maintain the top #2 spot on the Highest Kills Leaderboard |- |THE STRONGEST AVAILABLE |Reach and maintain the top #3 spot on the Highest Kills Leaderboard |- |SPECIAL GRADE |Reach and maintain the top #1 spot on the Weekly Kills Leaderboard |- |GRADE 1 |Reach and maintain the top #2 spot on the Weekly Kills Leaderboard |- |SEMI-GRADE 1 |Reach and maintain the top #3 spot on the Weekly Kills Leaderboard |- |GRADE 2 |Reach and maintain the top #4 spot on the Weekly Kills Leaderboard |- |SEMI-GRADE 2 |Reach and maintain the top #5 spot on the Weekly Kills Leaderboard |- |GRADE 3 |Reach and maintain the top #6 spot on the Weekly Kills Leaderboard |- ! rowspan="6" |Staff Titles |I AM NOT TZE |Reserved only to Tze. |- |HEAD MODERATOR |Reserved only to the game's head moderators. |- |DEVELOPER |Reserved only to the game's developers. |- |MODERATOR |Reserved only to the game's moderators. |- |CONTRIBUTOR |Reserved only to the game's contributors. |- |TESTER |Reserved only to the game's testers and balancers. |- ! rowspan="6" |Other |- |OVERCOOKER |Speculated to be a custom title for Frost, one of the game's head moderators. |- |GAMBLER |Obtained by the moderator, Alserex, after beating Tze in [https://www.roblox.com/games/16446180574/Twenty-One Twenty One] |- |CONTENT CREATOR |Reserved for Youtube or TikTok creators dedicated to making videos about ''Jujutsu Shenanigans''. |} ==Trivia== *Kill titles are generally not recommended, as the effort required often leads to increased attention from other players. Furthermore, maintaining the title necessitates consistently securing kills, making it an ongoing obligation rather than a single accomplishment. *Several requirements must be met to gain the Content Creator title. These can be verified by the moderator, @thehattedman or "Heat", who is in charge of granting said title. **Obtaining the title also grants the ability to use Free Cam in public servers.

If the user's Overheat Meter is between 80% and 99% before awakening, then they will enter their Awakening state right after their blast dies down, indicated by an overlay of "Let's use every last drop." momentarily covering their screen. |Stat 1=DAMAGE |Stat 1 Value=103.93 in total, ~7.42 per tick |Stat 2=OVERHEAT |Stat 2 Value=100% |Stat 3=HEALING |Stat 3 Value=25 HP |Stat 4=DURATION |Stat 4 Value=90s |Image=Awakening ryu last drop.gif}} {{Ability |Type=PASSIVE |Type Color=purple |Name='''Decadence''' |Description=Instead of tiring them out, using every last drop of their cursed energy made the user's hunger impossible to ignore, meaning: *Passive health regeneration is disabled. *If they reach critical health, any damage taken will reduce their Awakening meter, which is able to take 200 damage (natural drain unaccounted). **If the bar lacks enough meter to survive a fatal attack, the user will survive regardless and be put out of Awakening; however, they will not be able to survive multi-hit attacks and certain instakills (such as True Love Beam or Embodiment of Self Perfection). *They lose their Overheat Meter and are stuck at 100% Overheat, disabling their cursed energy discharge attack in favor of the third basic M1. **Furthermore, all final basic attacks will harbor negligible endlag on block or miss. |Stat 1=EFFECT |Stat 1 Value=Locks the user in overheat, disables passive healing, and turns the Awakening Bar to a second health bar when low |Image=Buffetryu.gif}} {{Ability |Type=PASSIVE |Type Color=purple |Name='''Decadence''' |Description=At the cost of health, the user may interrupt a move they are currently performing and put it on a lowered cooldown. |Stat 2=COOLDOWN |Stat 2 Value=20s |Image=Finisher ywi.gif}} ==Pros & Cons== {{ProsCons |pros= *Has high DPS potential in base due to Granite Blast having such a short cooldown. *Can play at range, especially with the hold variant for Granite Blast. *The third M1's extended range can be utilized at a safe distance, functioning as a pretty good neutral tool. *The Awakening sequence itself can be used as an attack to counter domains or other long windup moves. *"I had no idea..." is a perfect counter to long attacks, as it allows you to effectively surf them and punish your opponent. *Restyle in Awakening can significantly increase your ultimate duration. *Most players don't know about Granite Blasts dash variant as it can be a pretty neat dash extend to catch your opponent off guard. *Feinting during awakening can allow you to extend your combos, allowing you to overall deal more damage. *The damage done to self is always going to be two times less, or even three times less compared to the damage the moves do itself. |cons= *Overheat drastically reduces damage output, Completely losing access to the 1st move, while the 4th move loses half of its damage. *Restyle leaves you open and is risky to use, especially when using the comb. *The true Awakening can only be achieved with a specific window in the Overheat bar that lacks an accurate indicator, and failure to reach the Awakening will leave you with a full Overheat bar. *Proper combos in Awakening require wasting health with the feints, as the moves by themselves have very low stun durations. *The only way to gain health during Awakening is the R special, which also makes you vulnerable during the animation. }} ==Combos== |-|Base= {{Combo |sequence1=---- |damage1='''''This character Combos are currently being reworked.
Please don't add any combos whatsoever.''''' |notes1=---- }} |-|Awakening= {{Combo |sequence1=---- |damage1='''''This character Combos are currently being reworked.
Please don't add any combos whatsoever.''''' |notes1=---- }} ==Tips & Techs== ===Tips=== *Using the third M1 in neutral is handy, since most people won't expect the extended range. *Restyle is only ever safe when the opponent is ragdolled or extremely far away. **For a safe Restyle, use Unsatisfied after wasting evasive, as few characters like {{Head of the Hei}} with high mobility will be fast enough to reach you. **In case Restyle was used in Overheat, you can only rely on a long range Appetizer, which may still prove ineffective. Thus you must manage your resources better to avoid punishment. ===Techs=== |-|Beginner= ====''M1 Appetizer''==== Using Appetizer, the 4th move in True Cannons kit preferably on a ragdolled target, you can land an M1 and a downslam. If you use Appetizer as soon as the last blast lands and spam M1 as the ragdolled enemy goes towards you, the 2nd M1 hits them mid-air, and you can hit a downslam to extend it into Granite Blast, or second helping. ===='''Twin Blasts'''==== You can use an uncharged Granite Blast twice in a row if you land an uppercut and quickly use the air variant of Granite Blast to aim towards the opponent, being able to hit them twice before getup. It's recommended to spam the move as quickly as possible. ===='''"I'm after dessert!"'''==== Feinting "What are you after?" before its jump with "This is what dessert is like!" is a reliable way to confirm its swing. |-|Intermediate= |-|Advanced= ===='''Lemon Meringue Renewal'''==== By using an uncharged Granite Blast while performing an M1 string, you can reset your M1s. This requires correct timing, however, and can be difficult to pull off, but can be done repeatedly until the overheat meter is full. ====''Double Gun Volley!'''==== After performing two M1s, using Granite Blast offers a small window to land the third neutral M1. This method allows the use of two Granite Blasts and a full M1 string at the same time without losing out on the 3rd M1's damage boost. ==Trivia== *Unsatisfied's final blow effects will change colors if the target was using {{Cursed Partners}}, with parts of the energy being pink instead of light blue. *All awakening move names are quotes said by Ryu Ishigori in ''Jujutsu Kaisen's anime''. *A lot of {{True Cannon}}'s assets were copied from other characters, likely to save time as the character's moveset on release was made in 3 days. This is apparent with Second Helping having the same exact finisher as Justice Served, as well as its Hiromi Higuruma overlay that results from killing a beheaded opponent. Melee animations are also included: **The first M1 is {{Vessel}}'s second M1. **The second M1 is {{Head of the Hei}}'s final M1. **The neutral final M1 (at 90% Overheat) is {{Perfection}}'s third M1. *While awakened, [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zz2a9Q2Wru0 AIZO]'s instrumental will begin playing (137364280179144 in Roblox). The user will begin hearing the song's vocals when reaching 50 HP or under (73905683100406 in Roblox). **Interestingly, if the player awakens while under 50 HP, the music will start at a later part rather than the very beginning of the song, regardless on if the actual Awakening was achieved. **Additionally, the user has a 10% chance to say "Let's larp!" instead of "Let's use every last drop!". If they are to successfully enter the awakening state, an image of Ryu Ishigori (more accurately, Jane Juliet) repeating the statement will flash as opposed to the users dialogue in Japanese. Moreover, the awakening theme will be replaced by [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0U8P7GJAEWM LARPZO], voiced by Alserex. **This makes {{True Cannon}} the third character to have an awakening variant, right after {{Honored One}} and {{Aspiring Mangaka}}. *The art for "Pass On" during the Unlicensed Rhythm Game shows {{True Cannon}} taking the place of Rodion from Limbus Company, holding a menu infront of {{Restless Gambler}} and {{Vessel}}. *{{True Cannon}}'s 2026 April Fools name (jane juliet) was based off the songs, [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HydkjjDNTmY Jane!] by The Long Faces and [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yfgfYfS4XBo Hello Juliet] by Clarion. **The name was chosen due to the songs being used in tandem with NinjaristicNinja's [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eoJEn7MDht0 Culling Games MMV] animation, using parts of the beam clash between Ryu Ishigori and Okkotsu Yuta. This eventually devolved into him being called '''jane juliet'''. ==Gallery== File:Ryu Anime.png|Ryu Ishigori, the inspiration for True Cannon. Taunts.text:
{{DISPLAYTITLE:'''Taunts'''}} Taunts are sounds that the user can play by accessing the list of taunts on the top right of the screen, which were added in response to Roblox's chat restrictions. As of now, there are 38 taunts in the game, with only three being removed so far. The Forbidden Pen Quest.text:
{{Stub}} "The Forbidden Pen" is an [[Emotes|Emote]] obtainable through a special quest. ==Step 1: Locating NEPs== First of all you need to locate several feline images hidden around the [[Map|map]], their locations can be found in [[Map#Nep|Map]]. After you've found them all go to [[Map#The Sewers|Sewers]] walk to the radio and click it. It will start saying words: WIDENEP, NEP, LONGNEP, TOASTNEP, EVILNEP, NEPGD, ICENEP, ANGRYNEP. Remember in which order they go, and match their alphanumeric codes with the order in which they appear. Then go to [[Shop]] and [[Shop#Codes|Codes]]. Insert the code you got, you'll get the Woven Insight emote. ==Step 2: Chants== After you got the [[Emotes#S-Z|Woven Insight]] emote go Sewers again, and click the radio. Enter following [[Domain Expansion|domain expansions']] names: Authentic Mutual Love(or True Love Beam), Deadly Sentencing, Embodiment of Self Perfection. File:Firstline.png|First line. File:Secon.png|Second line. File:Three.png|Third line. File:Fourth.png|Fourth line File:Five.png|Fifth line. File:Six.png|Sixth line. [[File:Снимок экрана от 2026-09-11 12-52-22.png|thumb|Text after you interrupt signal.]] [[File:Eitght.png|thumb|Asking for code.]] After you inputted chants click the radio 17 times. It will start saying: "You're tuned into Indie Talents, where we show off the work of independent artists. I'm your host, [REDACTED], and today's Indie Talent will be the work of...Uh excuse me, who do you represent again...? Unlicensed Studios? Oh how delightful! DRIFTER HEMISPHERE. I WILL TRANSMIT A SIGNAL. PLEASE OFFSET THE FREQUENCY ONCE MORE WHEN YOU ARE READY TO RECEIVE." When lines will disappear you need to click radio again it will start emitting radio signal, you need to click again when you first start hearing it. It will interrupt the signal and say: "SIGNAL INTERRUPTED. WAIT TO LISTEN AGAIN OR PRESS AGAIN TO SUBMIT". You need to click it immediately after(it will emit short sound), and then again. It will ask you to name the code. You must put in word "Ungeziefer".






==Step 3: Nepcard== For this step you need to go in public server(as I don't know whether you can do it in private, if you could, then comment here). Go to the radio and click it. It will ask you to retrieve the "[[Items#Nepcard|key of the feline]]". For this you'll receive "[[Emotes#D-H|Feline Finder]]" emote. It is a paper on which written the coordinates of the location you need to visit for the Nepcard. So that you won't need to calculate those, you just need to know that it is the [[Map#Unlicensed Studios|Arcade]]. File:Ninenth.png File:Tenth.png|Nepcard location. File:Eleventh.png|Nepcard itself. File:Twelevfet.png|When coming to radio with nepcard. File:Thirthnt.png|Bringing to ground. File:Foutrhbn.png|After bursting. Go there and on the shelf above shopkeeper's counter behind a book there will be the item you need. Then again go to radio it will ask you to drop the key(press R for that). It will bring you to the ground, it is a good sign. Burst out of ragdoll, your character will be switched to [[Vessel]].




==Step 4: The Quiz== Note: Dying in this stage will require you to do everything from Step 3 again. Click on radio again. There will start the quiz. After every answer you need to click again. File:Subhay.png|First question. File:Fall.png|Second question. File:Megum.png|Third question. File:Light.png|Fourth question. File:Shapow.png|Fifth question. File:Fina.png|Final question. File:L.png ANSWER, WHERE IS THIS? -->🚉: Subway. ANSWER, WHEN WAS THIS --> 🍂🍬🍬?: Halloween ANSWER, WHO IS THIS --> ⬛⬛⬛?: [[Ten Shadows|Megumi]] ONE WORD, WHAT DOES LUMINESCENT PEAR EMIT?: Light WHAT SEEN AS A RESULT OF IT? IT IS CAST: Shadow FROM THE SHADOWS, A ROAR IS HEARD. REMEMBER THE NAME OF D2. SPEAK ITS NAME BACKWARDS, AND A VERMINOUS BEAST SHALL RISE: (spell name NEP backwards). IMPORTANT NOTE: After the final question almost immediately will spawn boss. ==Step 5: Defeat the Vermin== File:Quote.png|Radio's quote. File:Spawn.png|Ungezifier spawn anim. File:Pejn.png|The Forbidden Pen. After you input final answer, Radio will say you to defeat the vermin using your new [[Items#Pen|weapon]] and start to play music as Vermin rises from the ground similar to [[Puppet Master#Awakening|Puppet Master's awakening]]. You in the time will be granted with Pen. Boss itself is an [[Build Mode#Output Blocks|John Npc]] with something like fried chicken legs on his hands. It's base character is [[Locust Guy]], and he only M1's. When he will lose much of his health, he will start dodging, to kill him you need to use [[Vessel#Base|Manji Kick]] combined with your pen(as it's final m1 has similar animation to [[Head of the Hei#Base|Bleedout]], and somehow damages him). After you kill him you will get the emote. Hooray! == Trivia == The boss might be a reference to the Roach Emperor Gregor from Limbus Company game made by Project Moon. The Forbidden Pen used to drop the Pen item once it ends, which benefited Vessel and Disaster Plants, so Tze removed it.

After countless centuries as a cursed object, he learned how to effectively split his soul into one, an act which he demonstrated by cutting Yuji Itadori's finger and force feeding it to Megumi Fushiguro in order to possess his body.
